local recordAction=function() end
do
 local logs={}
 local characterSounds={Running=true,Jumping=true,FreeFalling=true,GettingUp=true,Landing=true,Splash=true,Swimming=true,Climbing=true,Died=true}
 local function remember(holder,kind,name)
  if not holder then holder=game:GetService(&quot;ReplicatedStorage&quot;):FindFirstChild(&quot;GameplayToolbox&quot;) end
  if not holder then return end
  local log=logs[holder] or {}
  logs[holder]=log
  table.insert(log,{kind=kind,name=name,at=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()})
  if #log&gt;100 then table.remove(log,1) end
  holder:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_ClientActionLog&quot;,game:GetService(&quot;HttpService&quot;):JSONEncode(log))
 end
 local function holderOf(object)
  local model=object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA(&quot;Model&quot;)
  while model and not model:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;) do model=model:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA(&quot;Model&quot;) end
  if model then return game:GetService(&quot;Players&quot;):GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) or model end
  return nil
 end
 local function watch(object)
  if object:IsA(&quot;Animator&quot;) then
   -- Only moves (Action priority and up): walking, running and standing (Core/Idle/Movement) would crowd them out.
   object.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
    local priority=track.Priority
    if priority~=Enum.AnimationPriority.Core and priority.Value&gt;=Enum.AnimationPriority.Action.Value then remember(holderOf(object),&quot;animation&quot;,(track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId or &quot;&quot;)..&quot; &quot;..track.Name) end
   end)
  elseif object:IsA(&quot;Sound&quot;) then
   -- Roblox&apos;s own footstep and jump sounds would crowd out the game&apos;s sounds.
   if characterSounds[object.Name] and object.Parent and object.Parent.Name==&quot;HumanoidRootPart&quot; then return end
   object.Played:Connect(function() remember(holderOf(object),&quot;sound&quot;,object.Name..&quot; &quot;..object.SoundId) end)
  elseif object:IsA(&quot;ParticleEmitter&quot;) or object:IsA(&quot;Beam&quot;) or object:IsA(&quot;Trail&quot;) or object:IsA(&quot;Explosion&quot;) or object:IsA(&quot;Highlight&quot;) then
   remember(holderOf(object),&quot;effect&quot;,object.ClassName..&quot;:&quot;..object.Name)
  end
 end
 if game:GetService(&quot;RunService&quot;):IsStudio() then
  recordAction=remember
  for _,root in {workspace,game:GetService(&quot;SoundService&quot;)} do
   for _,object in root:GetDescendants() do watch(object) end
   root.DescendantAdded:Connect(watch)
  end
 end
end

-- Position and anchor of something pinned at one of the nine places, margins kept; bottom places stay above the key
-- hints on a computer. Left and right sit at 38% of the height, above a phone&apos;s thumbstick and jump button.
local function slotPlace(at)
 local x=(at==&quot;topLeft&quot; or at==&quot;left&quot; or at==&quot;bottomLeft&quot;) and 0 or (at==&quot;topRight&quot; or at==&quot;right&quot; or at==&quot;bottomRight&quot;) and 1 or .5
 local y=(at==&quot;topLeft&quot; or at==&quot;top&quot; or at==&quot;topRight&quot;) and 0 or (at==&quot;bottomLeft&quot; or at==&quot;bottom&quot; or at==&quot;bottomRight&quot;) and 1 or .5
 local bottomGap=UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled and widgetSizes.keysGap or widgetSizes.margin
 local height=at==&quot;center&quot; and .5 or y==.5 and 0.38 or y
 return UDim2.new(x,(1-2*x)*widgetSizes.margin,height,y==0 and widgetSizes.margin or y==1 and -bottomGap or 0),Vector2.new(x,y)
end

local function keepFor(map,instance,value)
 if map[instance]==nil then instance.Destroying:Connect(function() map[instance]=nil end) end
 map[instance]=value
end

local function playLocalSound(category,position)
 local sound=sounds[category]
 if not sound then error(&quot;Unknown toolbox sound:&quot;..tostring(category)) end
 local holder=SoundService
 if position then holder=Instance.new(&quot;Attachment&quot;);holder.Name=&quot;TB_SoundSpot&quot;;holder.Parent=workspace.Terrain;holder.WorldPosition=position;Debris:AddItem(holder,sound.seconds+1) end
 local playing=Instance.new(&quot;Sound&quot;);playing.Name=&quot;TB_&quot;..category;playing.SoundId=sound.id;playing.Volume=sound.volume;playing.Parent=holder
 playing:Play();Debris:AddItem(playing,sound.seconds+1)
end

-- Theme: the game&apos;s panel, text, accent and danger colours, font, corner radius, outline and icon. Text and accent sit
-- on the panel (buttons put panel-coloured text on the accent), so each needs 4.5:1 contrast with it.
local fonts={GothamBold=true,GothamBlack=true,BuilderSansBold=true,FredokaOne=true,LuckiestGuy=true,Bangers=true,Cartoon=true,Arcade=true,SciFi=true,Michroma=true,Oswald=true,Nunito=true,Fantasy=true,Garamond=true,Antique=true,Creepster=true,PermanentMarker=true,SpecialElite=true}
local themeFields={panel=true,text=true,accent=true,danger=true,font=true,corner=true,stroke=true,strokeWidth=true,icon=true}
local function luminance(color)
 local function channel(value) return value&lt;=.03928 and value/12.92 or ((value+.055)/1.055)^2.4 end
 return .2126*channel(color.R)+.7152*channel(color.G)+.0722*channel(color.B)
end
local function contrast(first,second)
 local light,dark=luminance(first),luminance(second)
 if light&lt;dark then light,dark=dark,light end
 return (light+.05)/(dark+.05)
end
local function themeFrom(given)
 if type(given)~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&quot;ui.mount theme must be a table {panel,text,accent,danger,font,corner,stroke,strokeWidth,icon}; got &quot;..typeof(given)) end
 for key in given do if not themeFields[key] then error(&quot;ui.mount theme has no field &quot;..tostring(key)) end end
 local resolved={}
 for _,field in {&quot;panel&quot;,&quot;text&quot;,&quot;accent&quot;,&quot;danger&quot;,&quot;stroke&quot;} do
  local value=given[field]
  if type(value)~=&quot;string&quot; or not value:match(&quot;^#%x%x%x%x%x%x$&quot;) then error(&quot;ui.mount theme.&quot;..field..&apos; must be a colour &quot;#rrggbb&quot;; got &apos;..tostring(value)) end
  resolved[field]=Color3.fromHex(value)
 end
 if not fonts[given.font] then error(&quot;ui.mount theme.font must be one of Roblox&apos;s fonts such as GothamBold, FredokaOne, SciFi or Fantasy; got &quot;..tostring(given.font)) end
 resolved.font=Enum.Font[given.font]
 if type(given.corner)~=&quot;number&quot; or given.corner&lt;0 or given.corner&gt;24 then error(&quot;ui.mount theme.corner must be 0..24 pixels; got &quot;..tostring(given.corner)) end
 if type(given.strokeWidth)~=&quot;number&quot; or given.strokeWidth&lt;0 or given.strokeWidth&gt;4 then error(&quot;ui.mount theme.strokeWidth must be 0..4 pixels; got &quot;..tostring(given.strokeWidth)) end
 if type(given.icon)~=&quot;string&quot; or #given.icon==0 or #given.icon&gt;32 then error(&quot;ui.mount theme.icon must be a short symbol such as 🍬; got &quot;..tostring(given.icon)) end
 resolved.corner=given.corner;resolved.strokeWidth=given.strokeWidth;resolved.icon=given.icon
 for _,field in {&quot;text&quot;,&quot;accent&quot;} do
  local ratio=contrast(resolved[field],resolved.panel)
  if ratio&lt;4.5 then error(string.format(&quot;ui.mount theme.%s %s on panel %s has contrast %.2f:1; it needs at least 4.5:1 to be readable&quot;,field,given[field],given.panel,ratio)) end
 end
 return resolved
end
local theme=themeFrom({[&quot;\112\097\110\101\108&quot;]=&quot;\035\050\051\051\052\052\050&quot;,[&quot;\116\101\120\116&quot;]=&quot;\035\070\054\070\049\068\070&quot;,[&quot;\097\099\099\101\110\116&quot;]=&quot;\035\069\068\067\068\056\050&quot;,[&quot;\100\097\110\103\101\114&quot;]=&quot;\035\068\067\051\067\051\067&quot;,[&quot;\102\111\110\116&quot;]=&quot;\071\111\116\104\097\109\066\111\108\100&quot;,[&quot;\099\111\114\110\101\114&quot;]=14,[&quot;\115\116\114\111\107\101&quot;]=&quot;\035\048\048\048\048\048\048&quot;,[&quot;\115\116\114\111\107\101\087\105\100\116\104&quot;]=0,[&quot;\105\099\111\110&quot;]=&quot;\226\151\134&quot;})
-- Every themed element carries its role and is painted from the theme, so a new theme repaints the whole interface.
local function paint(item)
 local role=item:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_Role&quot;)
 if role==&quot;panel&quot; or role==&quot;button&quot; then
  item.BackgroundColor3=role==&quot;panel&quot; and theme.panel or theme.accent
  local corner=item:FindFirstChild(&quot;TB_Corner&quot;) or Instance.new(&quot;UICorner&quot;);corner.Name=&quot;TB_Corner&quot;;corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,theme.corner);corner.Parent=item
  local stroke=item:FindFirstChild(&quot;TB_Stroke&quot;) or Instance.new(&quot;UIStroke&quot;);stroke.Name=&quot;TB_Stroke&quot;;stroke.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border;stroke.Color=theme.stroke;stroke.Thickness=theme.strokeWidth;stroke.Enabled=role==&quot;panel&quot; and theme.strokeWidth&gt;0;stroke.Parent=item
 elseif role==&quot;danger&quot; then item.BackgroundColor3=theme.danger end
 if item:IsA(&quot;TextLabel&quot;) or item:IsA(&quot;TextButton&quot;) then
  item.Font=theme.font
  item.TextColor3=role==&quot;button&quot; and theme.panel or role==&quot;accent&quot; and theme.accent or theme.text
 end
end
local function styled(item,role) item:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Role&quot;,role);paint(item);return item end

 return styled(text,&quot;text&quot;)
end

 local frame=Instance.new(&quot;Frame&quot;);frame.Name=name;frame.Size=size;frame.Position=position;frame.AnchorPoint=anchor or Vector2.zero;frame.BackgroundTransparency=.08;frame.Parent=parent
 return styled(frame,&quot;panel&quot;)
end

 local pad=Instance.new(&quot;UIPadding&quot;);pad.PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,padding);pad.PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,padding);pad.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,padding+2);pad.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,padding+2);pad.Parent=frame

-- A round&apos;s end: the background (the ambience, and the music when there is any) steps back while the win or lose
-- sound plays, then comes back.
local function duckMusic(seconds)
 for _,sound in SoundService:GetChildren() do
  if sound:IsA(&quot;Sound&quot;) and sound:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_Background&quot;) then
   local normal=sound:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_NormalVolume&quot;) or sound.Volume
   sound:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_NormalVolume&quot;,normal)
   TweenService:Create(sound,TweenInfo.new(.3),{Volume=normal*.2}):Play()
   task.delay(seconds,function() if sound.Parent then TweenService:Create(sound,TweenInfo.new(1),{Volume=normal}):Play() end end)
  end
 end
end
local function clearSettlement()
 if settlement then settlement:Destroy();settlement=nil end
 if restartCorner then restartCorner:Destroy();restartCorner=nil end
 ContextActionService:UnbindAction(&quot;GameplayRestart&quot;)
end
local function requestRestart()
 clearSettlement()
 runtime.Restart:FireServer()
end
local function collapseSettlement()
 if settlement then settlement:Destroy();settlement=nil end
 if restartCorner then return end
 restartCorner=menuButton(gui,&quot;RestartCorner&quot;,&quot;Replay [R]&quot;,UDim2.fromOffset(150,44),UDim2.new(1,-12,.72,0),Vector2.new(1,.5))
 -- A game&apos;s own result screen folds where it sat (a centred one folds to the bottom middle).
 if layoutResult then
  restartCorner.Text=layoutResult.restart and layoutResult.restart..&quot; [R]&quot; or restartCorner.Text
  restartCorner.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(widgetSizes.restart[1],44)
  restartCorner.Position,restartCorner.AnchorPoint=slotPlace(layoutResult.fold)
 end
 restartCorner.Activated:Connect(requestRestart)
end

 local clickBound=false
 for _,action in boundActions do hint(action.key,action.label);clickBound=clickBound or action.key==&quot;MouseLeftButton&quot; end
 local held=Players.LocalPlayer.Character and Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Tool&quot;)
 local kind=held and held:GetAttribute(&quot;GameplayToolKind&quot;)
 if kind and not clickBound then hint(&quot;MouseLeftButton&quot;,toolVerbs[kind]..&quot; &quot;..held.Name) end
 if riding then for _,pair in ridingKeys do hint(pair[1],pair[2]) end end
end
-- Walk-up prompts are drawn here as &quot;[E] 打开 宝箱&quot; on the screen layer (screenshots and themes see them); a tap on
-- the hint triggers the prompt on phones. Each prompt is switched to Custom on this client only. The hint sits above
-- its object but never lower than just above the key hints along the bottom, nor off the sides of the screen.
local shownPrompts={}
local function showPromptHint(prompt)
 keepFor(shownPrompts,prompt,true)
 local parent=prompt.Parent
 local part=parent:IsA(&quot;Attachment&quot;) and parent or parent:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) and parent or parent:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;)
 if not part then return end
 local touch=UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
 local hint=Instance.new(&quot;TextButton&quot;);hint.Name=&quot;PromptHint&quot;;hint.Text=(touch and &quot;&quot; or &quot;[E] &quot;)..prompt.ActionText..&quot; &quot;..prompt.ObjectText;hint.TextSize=22;hint.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,44);hint.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.X;hint.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,1);hint.BackgroundTransparency=.1;hint.Parent=gui
 styled(hint,&quot;panel&quot;)
 local padding=Instance.new(&quot;UIPadding&quot;);padding.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,14);padding.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,14);padding.Parent=hint
 hint.Activated:Connect(function() playLocalSound(&quot;click&quot;);prompt:InputHoldBegin();task.wait(prompt.HoldDuration);prompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
 local follow=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
  local position=part:IsA(&quot;Attachment&quot;) and part.WorldPosition or part.Position+Vector3.new(0,part.Size.Y/2,0)
  local point,shown=workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(position+Vector3.new(0,1.5,0))
  local scale=gui.TB_Scale.Scale
  local x,bottom=point.X,point.Y-GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y
  if actionHints.Visible and #actionHints:GetChildren()&gt;1 then bottom=math.min(bottom,actionHints.AbsolutePosition.Y-8) end
  local half=hint.AbsoluteSize.X/2+8
  x=math.clamp(x,half,math.max(half,gui.AbsoluteSize.X-half))
  hint.Visible=shown;hint.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x/scale,bottom/scale)
 end)
 local hidden;hidden=prompt.PromptHidden:Connect(function() shownPrompts[prompt]=nil;follow:Disconnect();hidden:Disconnect();hint:Destroy() end)
end
-- A vehicle with an owner (tools.vehicle owner) shows its &quot;[E] 上车&quot; to that player alone: on every other screen the
-- prompt stays off, also after the server turns it back on when its rider gets off.
local function keepOwnersPrompt(prompt)
 local owner=prompt:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_Owner&quot;)
 if owner==nil or owner==Players.LocalPlayer.UserId then return end
 prompt.Enabled=false
 prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal(&quot;Enabled&quot;):Connect(function() if prompt.Enabled then prompt.Enabled=false end end)
end
local function customPrompt(object) if object:IsA(&quot;ProximityPrompt&quot;) then object.Style=Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom;keepOwnersPrompt(object) end end

-- Pickups: they spin, bob and glow; taking one hides it at once, bursts, floats &quot;+value&quot; and plays its sound.
local hiddenPickups,pickupFrames={},{}
local function setPickupShown(part,shown)
 keepFor(hiddenPickups,part,not shown)
 local link=part:FindFirstChild(&quot;GameplayAnchorModel&quot;)
 local subject=link and link.Value or part
 for _,item in {subject,table.unpack(subject:GetDescendants())} do
  if item:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) or item:IsA(&quot;Decal&quot;) then item.LocalTransparencyModifier=shown and 0 or 1
  elseif item:IsA(&quot;Light&quot;) or item:IsA(&quot;ParticleEmitter&quot;) or item:IsA(&quot;Beam&quot;) or item:IsA(&quot;Trail&quot;) or item:IsA(&quot;BillboardGui&quot;) or item:IsA(&quot;SurfaceGui&quot;) then item.Enabled=shown end
 end
end
local function burstAt(position,color,count)
 local holder=Instance.new(&quot;Attachment&quot;);holder.Name=&quot;TB_Effect&quot;;holder.Parent=workspace.Terrain;holder.WorldPosition=position
 local particles=Instance.new(&quot;ParticleEmitter&quot;);particles.Name=&quot;TB_pickup&quot;;particles.Texture=&quot;rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds&quot;;particles.Color=ColorSequence.new(color);particles.LightEmission=.8;particles.Rate=0
 particles.Size=NumberSequence.new(.7,0);particles.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.35,.6);particles.Speed=NumberRange.new(8,14);particles.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180);particles.Parent=holder
 particles:Emit(count);Debris:AddItem(holder,1)
end
local function floatText(position,text,color)
 local spot=Instance.new(&quot;Attachment&quot;);spot.Name=&quot;TB_FloatText&quot;;spot.Parent=workspace.Terrain;spot.WorldPosition=position
 local board=Instance.new(&quot;BillboardGui&quot;);board.Name=&quot;TB_FloatText&quot;;board.Adornee=spot;board.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(120,50);board.StudsOffsetWorldSpace=Vector3.new(0,1.5,0);board.LightInfluence=0;board.Parent=gui
 local words=Instance.new(&quot;TextLabel&quot;);words.BackgroundTransparency=1;words.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);words.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack;words.TextSize=34;words.TextColor3=color;words.TextStrokeTransparency=.2;words.Text=text;words.Parent=board
 TweenService:Create(board,TweenInfo.new(.9,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{StudsOffsetWorldSpace=Vector3.new(0,4.5,0)}):Play()
 TweenService:Create(words,TweenInfo.new(.9,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.In),{TextTransparency=1,TextStrokeTransparency=1}):Play()
 Debris:AddItem(board,1);Debris:AddItem(spot,1)
end
local function pickedUp(part,value,kind,mine,shared)
 local name=part:GetAttribute(&quot;GameplayAnchor&quot;) or part.Name
 if mine or shared then setPickupShown(part,false);recordAction(mine and Players.LocalPlayer or nil,&quot;effect&quot;,&quot;hidden &quot;..name) end
 local color=kind==&quot;coin&quot; and Color3.fromRGB(255,214,90) or Color3.fromRGB(150,220,255)
 if mine then
  burstAt(part.Position,color,18);floatText(part.Position,&quot;+&quot;..tostring(value),color)
  playLocalSound(kind==&quot;coin&quot; and &quot;pickup_coin&quot; or &quot;pickup_item&quot;,part.Position)
  recordAction(Players.LocalPlayer,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;picked &quot;..name);recordAction(Players.LocalPlayer,&quot;effect&quot;,&quot;float-text &quot;..name)
 elseif shared then burstAt(part.Position,color,10) end
end
local function showAllPickups() for part,hidden in hiddenPickups do if hidden then setPickupShown(part,true) end end end
-- A walk-in component collect sends only its anchor; coins are told apart by their anchor name.
local function componentCollected(anchor,value)
 for _,part in workspace:GetDescendants() do
  if part:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) and part:GetAttribute(&quot;GameplayAnchor&quot;)==anchor then
   local kind=(anchor:lower():find(&quot;coin&quot;) or anchor:lower():find(&quot;gold&quot;)) and &quot;coin&quot; or &quot;item&quot;
   pickedUp(part,value or 1,kind,true,false)
  end
 end
end
-- A once=true prompt this player has used: hidden on this screen only, until Play again.
local usedPrompts={}
local function hideUsedPrompt(prompt) prompt.Enabled=false;keepFor(usedPrompts,prompt,true) end
local function showUsedPrompts()
 for prompt in usedPrompts do prompt.Enabled=true end
 table.clear(usedPrompts)
end
-- A prompt with a ready condition (tools.prompt ready): what this player still misses goes after its object on this
-- screen only (&quot;电闸 - 还差 1 根保险丝&quot;), until they have it.
local promptObjects={}
local function showPromptMissing(prompt,missing)
 if promptObjects[prompt]==nil then keepFor(promptObjects,prompt,prompt.ObjectText) end
 prompt.ObjectText=missing and promptObjects[prompt]..&quot; - &quot;..missing or promptObjects[prompt]
end
local function watchComponents(child)
 if child.Name~=&quot;ForgeGameplay&quot; then return end
 local feedback=child:WaitForChild(&quot;Feedback&quot;,10)
 if not feedback then error(&quot;ForgeGameplay started without its Feedback event&quot;) end
 feedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind,value,amount)
  if kind==&quot;collected&quot; then componentCollected(value,amount) elseif kind==&quot;reset&quot; then showAllPickups() end
 end)
end
local function animatePickups()
 local t=os.clock()
 for _,part in CollectionService:GetTagged(&quot;GameplayPickup&quot;) do
  if part:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) and not hiddenPickups[part] then
   if not pickupFrames[part] then keepFor(pickupFrames,part,part.CFrame) end
   local resting=pickupFrames[part]
   local frame=CFrame.new(resting.Position+Vector3.new(0,math.sin(t*2.2)*.35,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,t*2,0)*resting.Rotation
   local link=part:FindFirstChild(&quot;GameplayAnchorModel&quot;)
   local subject=link and link.Value or part
   subject:PivotTo(frame*part.CFrame:Inverse()*subject:GetPivot())
  end
 end
end

local function hurtFlash()
 if not hurtEdges then
  hurtEdges={}
  for _,edge in {{UDim2.fromScale(1,.14),UDim2.fromScale(0,0),90},{UDim2.fromScale(1,.14),UDim2.fromScale(0,.86),270},{UDim2.fromScale(.1,1),UDim2.fromScale(0,0),0},{UDim2.fromScale(.1,1),UDim2.fromScale(.9,0),180}} do
   local glow=Instance.new(&quot;Frame&quot;);glow.Name=&quot;HurtFlash&quot;;glow.BorderSizePixel=0;glow.BackgroundTransparency=1;glow.Size=edge[1];glow.Position=edge[2];glow.ZIndex=50;glow.Active=false;glow.Parent=gui
   styled(glow,&quot;danger&quot;)
   local fade=Instance.new(&quot;UIGradient&quot;);fade.Rotation=edge[3];fade.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(0,1);fade.Parent=glow
   table.insert(hurtEdges,glow)
  end
 end
 for _,glow in hurtEdges do glow.BackgroundTransparency=.3;TweenService:Create(glow,TweenInfo.new(.6),{BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play() end
end
-- Riding a toolbox vehicle or mount, this computer runs its physics, so it also drives its wheels from the keys
-- (the server does whenever no player rides); the chassis is read from the vehicle model tools.vehicle built.

-- W drives forward; S brakes while moving forward, then reverses at half speed; letting go slows it to a stop. The
-- wheels&apos; speed moves toward that smoothly (studs/s² below) and the motors follow it with full torque; in a bend each
-- wheel turns at the speed of its own path (radius from the rear axle&apos;s centre), so the four motors do not fight.
local function driveVehicle(v,throttle,steer,dt)
 if v.model:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_Recovering&quot;) then
  v.drive=0
  for _,motor in v.motors do motor.hinge.AngularVelocity=0 end
  return
 end
 local serial=v.model:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_RecoverySerial&quot;)
 if serial~=v.recoverySerial then v.recoverySerial=serial;v.drive=0 end
 local forward=v.frame.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Dot(v.frame.CFrame.LookVector)
 local goal,rate=0,30
 if throttle&gt;0 then goal,rate=throttle*v.speed,45
 elseif throttle&lt;0 and forward&gt;2 then goal,rate=0,80
 elseif throttle&lt;0 then goal,rate=throttle*v.speed*.5,30 end
 -- Changing direction (backing away from a wall it was pushing): the wheels start from how fast it really goes, not
 -- from the speed they were still asked for, so the reverse takes at once.
 if goal*v.drive&lt;0 then v.drive=math.clamp(v.drive,forward-3,forward+3) end
 v.drive+=math.clamp(goal-v.drive,-rate*dt,rate*dt)
 -- A step no higher than a player steps up (a kerb, the edge of a raised road or yard) just ahead as it drives at it:
 -- it hops up onto the step whole, as a horse would; wheels this size cannot roll up so high, and one wheel climbing
 -- first tips it over. A wall, a higher ledge, a slope, a fence or a post (no level ground on top for it) does not, nor
-- a step with no room for the whole vehicle on it (a house&apos;s floor behind its wall, a rope or a roof above).
 if math.abs(throttle)&gt;.1 and goal~=0 and os.clock()-(v.hoppedAt or 0)&gt;1 then
  local look=v.frame.CFrame.LookVector
  local ahead=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z).Unit*math.sign(goal)
  local base=v.frame.Position-v.frame.CFrame.UpVector*v.radius
  local clear=v.wheelbase/2+v.radius+.5
  local edge=workspace:Raycast(base+Vector3.new(0,.5,0),ahead*(clear+.3),v.cast)
  if edge and math.abs(edge.Normal.Y)&lt;.3 then
   -- The step&apos;s own top just past its edge, and where it would stand (under its middle and both axles), all level:
   -- not a fence or a wall with higher ground behind it, not a fence&apos;s top.
   local function riseAt(point)
    local top=workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(point.X,base.Y+3,point.Z),Vector3.new(0,-3.5,0),v.cast)
    return top and top.Normal.Y&gt;.7 and top.Position.Y-base.Y
   end
   local landing=edge.Position+ahead*clear
   local rise,front,back,lip=riseAt(landing),riseAt(landing+ahead*v.wheelbase/2),riseAt(landing-ahead*v.wheelbase/2),riseAt(edge.Position+ahead*.3)
   local level=rise and front and back and lip and rise&gt;.4 and rise&lt;=2.6 and math.abs(front-rise)&lt;.8 and math.abs(back-rise)&lt;.8 and math.abs(lip-rise)&lt;.8
   local room=level and #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.lookAt(landing,landing+ahead)+Vector3.new(0,base.Y+rise+.4+(v.height-.4)/2-landing.Y,0),Vector3.new(v.track*2+1,v.height-.4,v.wheelbase+v.radius*2),v.overlap)==0
   if room then
    v.hoppedAt=os.clock()
    v.model:PivotTo(v.model:GetPivot()+Vector3.new(0,rise+.2,0)+ahead*((edge.Position-base):Dot(ahead)+clear))
   end
  end
 end
 local angle=steer*30
 for _,turn in v.steering do if turn.TargetAngle~=-angle then turn.TargetAngle=-angle end end
 local bend=math.abs(angle)&gt;1 and v.wheelbase/math.tan(math.rad(math.abs(angle)))
 for _,motor in v.motors do
  local share=1
  if bend then local path=bend-motor.side*math.sign(angle)*v.track;share=(motor.front and math.sqrt(path^2+v.wheelbase^2) or path)/bend end
  local spin=-v.drive*share/v.radius
  if motor.hinge.AngularVelocity~=spin then motor.hinge.AngularVelocity=spin end
 end
end

local function vehicleOf(model)
 local cast=RaycastParams.new();cast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;cast.FilterDescendantsInstances={model,Players.LocalPlayer.Character};cast.RespectCanCollide=true
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new();overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={model,Players.LocalPlayer.Character};overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
 local v={model=model,frame=model.PrimaryPart,cast=cast,overlap=overlap,speed=model:GetAttribute(&quot;GameplayVehicleSpeed&quot;),radius=model:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_WheelRadius&quot;),track=model:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_Track&quot;),wheelbase=model:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_Wheelbase&quot;),height=model:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_Height&quot;),motors={},steering={},drive=0}
 for _,joint in model:GetDescendants() do
  if joint:IsA(&quot;HingeConstraint&quot;) and joint.Name==&quot;TB_Drive&quot; then table.insert(v.motors,{hinge=joint,side=joint:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_Side&quot;),front=joint:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_Front&quot;)})
  elseif joint:IsA(&quot;HingeConstraint&quot;) and joint.Name==&quot;TB_Steer&quot; then table.insert(v.steering,joint) end
 end
 if not v.frame or not v.radius or #v.motors~=4 then error(&quot;Ridden vehicle &quot;..model:GetFullName()..&quot; lacks its tools.vehicle chassis: &quot;..#v.motors..&quot; drive hinges&quot;) end
 return v
end
local drivenVehicle
local function stopDriving()
 if drivenVehicle then drivenVehicle:Disconnect();drivenVehicle=nil end
end
local function watchHealth(body)
 local humanoid=body:WaitForChild(&quot;Humanoid&quot;,10)
 if not humanoid then return end
 local last=humanoid.Health
 humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
  if health&lt;last-.5 then hurtFlash();playLocalSound(&quot;hurt&quot;);recordAction(Players.LocalPlayer,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;hurt&quot;) end
  last=health
 end)
 -- Seated in a toolbox vehicle or mount: the bottom bar shows its keys.
 local function updateRiding()
  local seat=humanoid.SeatPart
  riding=seat~=nil and seat.Parent~=nil and seat.Parent:GetAttribute(&quot;GameplayVehicle&quot;)~=nil
  renderActionHints()
  stopDriving()
  if riding and seat:IsA(&quot;VehicleSeat&quot;) then
   if seat.Parent:GetAttribute(&quot;GameplayVehicle&quot;)==&quot;boat&quot; then
    local sentAt=-math.huge
    drivenVehicle=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
     if os.clock()-sentAt&lt;.05 then return end
     sentAt=os.clock();runtime.BoatInput:FireServer(seat.Parent,math.clamp(seat.ThrottleFloat,-1,1),math.clamp(seat.SteerFloat,-1,1))
    end)
    return
   end
   local v=vehicleOf(seat.Parent)
   drivenVehicle=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) driveVehicle(v,seat.ThrottleFloat,seat.SteerFloat,dt) end)
  end
 end
 -- Read the current seat, including when the interface starts after the rider already sat down.
 humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal(&quot;SeatPart&quot;):Connect(updateRiding)
 updateRiding()
end
-- Held tools: a click (or tap) reports the point under the mouse; the server checks the tool and acts.
local wiredTools={}
local function wireTool(tool)
 if not tool:IsA(&quot;Tool&quot;) or not tool:GetAttribute(&quot;GameplayToolKind&quot;) or wiredTools[tool] then return end
 keepFor(wiredTools,tool,true)
 tool.Activated:Connect(function()
  local mouse=Players.LocalPlayer:GetMouse();mouse.TargetFilter=Players.LocalPlayer.Character
  runtime.ToolUse:FireServer(tool,mouse.Hit.Position)
 end)
end
local function watchCharacter(body)
 riding=false;stopDriving()
 if actionHints then renderActionHints() end
 for _,item in body:GetChildren() do wireTool(item) end
 body.ChildAdded:Connect(wireTool)
 local function toolChanged(item) if item:IsA(&quot;Tool&quot;) and actionHints then renderActionHints() end end
 body.ChildAdded:Connect(toolChanged);body.ChildRemoved:Connect(toolChanged)
 task.spawn(watchHealth,body)
end

-- NPC talk: a box at the bottom with the name and one line at a time; E or a click goes on, Close ends it.
local function closeDialog()
 if not dialog then return end
 dialog.frame:Destroy();dialog.follow:Disconnect();dialog=nil
 ContextActionService:UnbindAction(&quot;GameplayDialogNext&quot;)
 ProximityPromptService.Enabled=true
 recordAction(Players.LocalPlayer,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;dialog-closed&quot;)
end
local function openDialog(name,lines)
 closeDialog()
 local frame=panel(gui,&quot;Dialog&quot;,UDim2.new(.9,0,0,160),UDim2.new(.5,0,1,-70),Vector2.new(.5,1));frame.BackgroundTransparency=.05
 local limit=Instance.new(&quot;UISizeConstraint&quot;);limit.MaxSize=Vector2.new(760,180);limit.Parent=frame
 local speaker=label(frame,&quot;Speaker&quot;,UDim2.new(1,-120,0,30),UDim2.fromOffset(20,12));speaker.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;speaker.Text=name;styled(speaker,&quot;accent&quot;)
 local said=label(frame,&quot;Line&quot;,UDim2.new(1,-40,1,-100),UDim2.fromOffset(20,46));said.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;said.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top;said.TextSize=24
 local nextButton=menuButton(frame,&quot;Next&quot;,&quot;&quot;,UDim2.fromOffset(150,40),UDim2.new(1,-14,1,-12),Vector2.new(1,1))
 menuButton(frame,&quot;Close&quot;,&quot;Close&quot;,UDim2.fromOffset(80,36),UDim2.new(1,-12,0,12),Vector2.new(1,0)).Activated:Connect(closeDialog)
 local page=0
 local function turn()
  page+=1
  if page&gt;#lines then closeDialog();return end
  said.Text=lines[page];nextButton.Text=page&lt;#lines and &quot;Next [E]&quot; or &quot;Close [E]&quot;
 end
 nextButton.Activated:Connect(turn)
 -- While the box is open, E turns the page instead of pressing a walk-up prompt again.
 ProximityPromptService.Enabled=false
 ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority(&quot;GameplayDialogNext&quot;,function(_,state) if state==Enum.UserInputState.Begin then turn() end;return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end,false,Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value,Enum.KeyCode.E)
 local start=Players.LocalPlayer.Character and Players.LocalPlayer.Character:GetPivot().Position
 -- Walking away ends the talk.
 local follow=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
  local body=Players.LocalPlayer.Character
  if start and body and (body:GetPivot().Position-start).Magnitude&gt;12 then closeDialog() end
 end)
 dialog={frame=frame,follow=follow}
 recordAction(Players.LocalPlayer,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;dialog &quot;..name)
 turn()
end

-- Level bar (tools.levels): top right, one button per level; the current one is highlighted, locked ones show a lock.
local levelBar
-- With a game&apos;s own layout the level bar is the first thing in the top-right stack (ui-layout.ts measures it there).
local function dockLevelBar()
 if not levelBar or not layoutSlots then return end
 levelBar.Parent=layoutSlots.topRight;levelBar.LayoutOrder=0;levelBar.Position=UDim2.new();levelBar.AnchorPoint=Vector2.zero
end
local function renderLevels()
 local names=runtime:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_LevelNames&quot;)
 if not names then return end
 local player=Players.LocalPlayer
 local current,unlocked=player:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_CurrentLevel&quot;) or 1,player:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_UnlockedLevel&quot;) or 1
 if not levelBar then
  levelBar=panel(gui,&quot;LevelBar&quot;,UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),UDim2.new(1,-12,0,12),Vector2.new(1,0));levelBar.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
  local row=Instance.new(&quot;UIListLayout&quot;);row.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal;row.VerticalAlignment=Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center;row.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;row.Padding=UDim.new(0,6);row.Parent=levelBar
  local pad=Instance.new(&quot;UIPadding&quot;);pad.PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,6);pad.PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,6);pad.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,10);pad.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,8);pad.Parent=levelBar
  local heading=label(levelBar,&quot;Heading&quot;,UDim2.fromOffset(0,40),UDim2.new());heading.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.X;heading.TextWrapped=false;heading.TextSize=20;heading.Text=theme.icon..&quot; Levels&quot;;styled(heading,&quot;accent&quot;)
  dockLevelBar()
 end
 for _,item in levelBar:GetChildren() do if item:IsA(&quot;TextButton&quot;) then item:Destroy() end end
 for index,name in names:split(&quot;\n&quot;) do
  local open=index&lt;=unlocked
  local chip=Instance.new(&quot;TextButton&quot;);chip.Name=&quot;level-&quot;..index;chip.LayoutOrder=index;chip.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(46,40);chip.TextSize=20;chip.Text=open and tostring(index) or &quot;🔒&quot;..index;chip.Parent=levelBar
  chip:SetAttribute(&quot;LevelName&quot;,name)
  styled(chip,index==current and &quot;button&quot; or &quot;panel&quot;)
  if not open then chip.TextTransparency=.45 end
  chip.Activated:Connect(function() playLocalSound(&quot;click&quot;);runtime.Level:FireServer(index) end)
 end
end
-- The one-time notice that saves last this session only (an unpublished game) or could not be read or written.

-- The leaderboard shows only when more than one player is in the game.
local function showRanking() rankingPanel.Visible=#Players:GetPlayers()&gt;1 and ranking.Text~=&quot;&quot; end
-- A settled round (won or over) shows no objective and no arrow until Play again starts the next one (11-08 pizza: the
-- old &quot;Buy the Dining Annex&quot; stayed on top of the victory panel).
local roundOver=false
local function showObjective()
 objectivePanel.Visible=objective.Text~=&quot;&quot; and not intro and not roundOver and not objectiveOff
 guide.Enabled=not intro and not roundOver
end

  if given~=nil then for _,item in gui:GetDescendants() do if item:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_Role&quot;) then paint(item) end end end
  return gui
 end
 local player=Players.LocalPlayer

 -- Key hints along the bottom; phones get Roblox&apos;s own touch buttons instead.

 runtime=ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(&quot;GameplayToolbox&quot;,30)
 if not runtime then error(&quot;Gameplay toolbox failed to start&quot;) end
 runtime.Feedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind,a,b,c,d,e)
  if kind==&quot;settlement&quot; then
   if layoutResult then ui.settlement(a and layoutResult.text or layoutResult.lose,b,a) else ui.settlement(a and &quot;Victory&quot; or &quot;Round over&quot;,b,a) end
  elseif kind==&quot;restart&quot; then
   clearSettlement();showUsedPrompts()
   roundOver=false;showObjective()
   -- Play again takes riders off their vehicles; stand up here (the server cannot lift a body this computer moves).
   local humanoid=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;)
   if humanoid and humanoid.Sit and not humanoid.SeatPart then humanoid.Sit=false;humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end
  elseif kind==&quot;boat-reset&quot; then
   -- The server has already detached and reset the boat. Finish detaching this client&apos;s old seat before moving
   -- its character, or its next physics update sends the old lake position back over the server&apos;s spawn reset.
   if a~=player.Character then return end
   local humanoid=a:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;);local body=a:FindFirstChild(&quot;HumanoidRootPart&quot;)
   if not humanoid or not body then return end
   local seat=humanoid.SeatPart
   if seat and seat.Parent and seat.Parent:GetAttribute(&quot;GameplayVehicle&quot;)==&quot;boat&quot; then
    local weld=seat:FindFirstChild(&quot;SeatWeld&quot;);if weld then weld:Destroy() end
   end
   humanoid.Sit=false;humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
   stopDriving();riding=false;renderActionHints()
   a:PivotTo(b);body.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;body.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
  elseif kind==&quot;prompt-used&quot; then hideUsedPrompt(a)
  elseif kind==&quot;prompt-ready&quot; then showPromptMissing(a,b)
  elseif kind==&quot;pickups-back&quot; then showAllPickups()
  elseif kind==&quot;pickup&quot; then pickedUp(a,b,c,d==player.UserId,e)
  elseif kind==&quot;hitmarker&quot; then hitMarker()
  elseif kind==&quot;dialog&quot; then openDialog(a,b)
  elseif kind==&quot;save-notice&quot; then showSaveNotice(a)
  else ui.toast(a) end
 end)
 renderLevels()
 runtime:GetAttributeChangedSignal(&quot;TB_LevelNames&quot;):Connect(renderLevels)
 player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(&quot;TB_CurrentLevel&quot;):Connect(renderLevels)
 player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(&quot;TB_UnlockedLevel&quot;):Connect(renderLevels)
 for _,child in ReplicatedStorage:GetChildren() do task.spawn(watchComponents,child) end
 ReplicatedStorage.ChildAdded:Connect(watchComponents)
 RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(animatePickups)
 if player.Character then watchCharacter(player.Character) end
 player.CharacterAdded:Connect(watchCharacter)
 for _,object in workspace:GetDescendants() do customPrompt(object) end
 workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(customPrompt)
 ProximityPromptService.PromptShown:Connect(showPromptHint)
 -- Studio playtests only: the test bench reaches the game after the 8-second card has gone, so it can show the card
 -- again to photograph the opening. Live games have no such hook.
 if RunService:IsStudio() then
  local replay=Instance.new(&quot;BindableFunction&quot;);replay.Name=&quot;TB_ReplayIntro&quot;;replay.Parent=gui
  replay.OnInvoke=function() if not lastIntro then return false end;ui.intro(lastIntro);return true end
 end
 return gui
end
local function mounted() if not gui then error(&quot;Call ui.mount first&quot;) end end
function ui.stats(text) mounted();status.Text=text end
function ui.objective(text,anchor) mounted()
 if type(anchor)==&quot;string&quot; then
  local id=anchor;anchor=nil
  for _,part in workspace:GetDescendants() do if part:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) and part:GetAttribute(&quot;GameplayAnchor&quot;)==id then anchor=part;break end end
  -- A place the scene had that the game has taken away since (the bought stand of 11-08 pizza): no arrow, no error.
  if not anchor and not table.find(string.split(runtime:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_AnchorIds&quot;) or &quot;&quot;,&quot;\n&quot;),id) then error(&quot;ui.objective missing anchor:&quot;..id) end
 end
 if typeof(anchor)==&quot;Instance&quot; and anchor:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;) then
  local model=anchor;anchor=model.PrimaryPart
  if not anchor then
   local largest=-1
   for _,part in model:GetDescendants() do
    if part:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then local size=part.Size;local volume=size.X*size.Y*size.Z;if volume&gt;largest then anchor=part;largest=volume end end
   end
  end
  if not anchor then error(&quot;ui.objective needs a Model with parts; got &quot;..tostring(model)) end
 end
 objective.Text=text~=&quot;&quot; and theme.icon..&quot; &quot;..text or &quot;&quot;;guide.Adornee=anchor
 showObjective()
end
function ui.leaderboard(rows) mounted();local lines={}
 for index,row in rows do
  if type(row)==&quot;string&quot; then table.insert(lines,row)
  else
   table.insert(lines,tostring(row.rank or index)..&quot;. &quot;..row.name..&quot;  &quot;..tostring(row.score))
  end
 end
 ranking.Text=table.concat(lines,&quot;\n&quot;)
 showRanking()
end
-- The numbers panel read straight from this player&apos;s attributes, kept up by itself whenever one changes: rows are
-- {label,attribute} with an optional third &quot;of&quot; number (&quot;保险丝 1/2&quot;) or &quot;time&quot; (seconds shown as 01:05); board, an
-- attribute every player has, ranks everyone in the leaderboard. The first round&apos;s ui.luau files rebuilt these strings
-- by hand in 16 of 18 games.
function ui.hud(rows,board)
 mounted()
 if type(rows)~=&quot;table&quot; or #rows&lt;1 or #rows&gt;8 then error(&quot;ui.hud needs 1..8 rows such as {\&quot;得分\&quot;,\&quot;FG_Score\&quot;}; got &quot;..(type(rows)==&quot;table&quot; and #rows..&quot; rows&quot; or type(rows))) end
 for index,row in rows do
  if type(row)~=&quot;table&quot; or type(row[1])~=&quot;string&quot; or #row[1]==0 or #row[1]&gt;30 or type(row[2])~=&quot;string&quot; or not row[2]:match(&quot;^[FT][GB]_%w+$&quot;) then error(&quot;ui.hud row &quot;..index..&quot; must be {label,attribute} such as {\&quot;得分\&quot;,\&quot;FG_Score\&quot;}; got &quot;..tostring(type(row)==&quot;table&quot; and row[2] or row)) end
  if row[3]~=nil and row[3]~=&quot;time&quot; and (type(row[3])~=&quot;number&quot; or row[3]&lt;=0) then error(&quot;ui.hud row &quot;..index..&quot; third item must be a number to show n/that or \&quot;time\&quot;; got &quot;..tostring(row[3])) end
 end
 if board~=nil and (type(board)~=&quot;string&quot; or not board:match(&quot;^[FT][GB]_%w+$&quot;)) then error(&quot;ui.hud board must be an attribute such as FG_Score; got &quot;..tostring(board)) end
 local player=Players.LocalPlayer
 local function render()
  local parts={}
  for _,row in rows do
   local value=player:GetAttribute(row[2])
   local text
   if row[3]==&quot;time&quot; then local seconds=math.max(0,math.floor(tonumber(value) or 0));text=string.format(&quot;%02d:%02d&quot;,seconds//60,seconds%60)
   elseif type(value)==&quot;boolean&quot; then text=value and &quot;✓&quot; or &quot;✗&quot;
   else text=tostring(value or 0)..(type(row[3])==&quot;number&quot; and &quot;/&quot;..row[3] or &quot;&quot;) end
   table.insert(parts,row[1]..&quot; &quot;..text)
  end
  ui.stats(table.concat(parts,&quot;　&quot;))
  if board then
   local list={}
   for _,other in Players:GetPlayers() do table.insert(list,{name=other.DisplayName,score=other:GetAttribute(board) or 0}) end
   table.sort(list,function(a,b) return a.score&gt;b.score end)
   ui.leaderboard(list)
  end
 end
 local function watch(other) if other==player or board then other.AttributeChanged:Connect(render) end end
 for _,other in Players:GetPlayers() do watch(other) end
 Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(other) watch(other);render() end)
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function() task.defer(render) end)
 render()
end
function ui.toast(text)
 -- One message at a time: messages sent together used to pile up in one unreadable spot.
 mounted();if toast then toast:Destroy() end
 toast=Instance.new(&quot;TextLabel&quot;);toast.Name=&quot;Toast&quot;;toast.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5);toast.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.62);toast.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,48);toast.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.X;toast.TextSize=26;toast.BackgroundTransparency=.12;toast.Text=&quot;  &quot;..text..&quot;  &quot;;toast.Parent=gui
 styled(toast,&quot;panel&quot;)
 Debris:AddItem(toast,3)
end
-- A settlement title that does not say it was won (no won argument) is a loss.
local function wonByTitle(title)
 local lowered=title:lower()
 for _,word in {&quot;胜&quot;,&quot;赢&quot;,&quot;通关&quot;,&quot;成功&quot;,&quot;完成&quot;,&quot;win&quot;,&quot;victory&quot;,&quot;clear&quot;} do if lowered:find(word,1,true) then return true end end
 return false
end
function ui.settlement(title,text,won)
 mounted();clearSettlement()
 roundOver=true;showObjective()
 if won==nil then won=wonByTitle(title) end
 local frame=panel(gui,&quot;Settlement&quot;,UDim2.new(.85,0,.36,0),UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5),Vector2.new(.5,.5));frame.BackgroundTransparency=0;frame.ZIndex=10
 if layoutResult then
  -- The game&apos;s own result screen: a card in the middle, or a banner at the edge it chose.
  local size=layoutResult.at==&quot;center&quot; and widgetSizes.result or widgetSizes.banner
  frame.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size[1],size[2]);frame.Position,frame.AnchorPoint=slotPlace(layoutResult.at)
 else
  local limit=Instance.new(&quot;UISizeConstraint&quot;);limit.MinSize=Vector2.new(300,220);limit.MaxSize=Vector2.new(720,400);limit.Parent=frame
 end
 local result=label(frame,&quot;Result&quot;,UDim2.new(1,-130,0,48),UDim2.fromOffset(20,12));result.Text=(won and theme.icon..&quot; &quot; or &quot;&quot;)..title;result.TextSize=32
 if won then styled(result,&quot;accent&quot;) end
 label(frame,&quot;Detail&quot;,UDim2.new(1,-40,1,-140),UDim2.fromOffset(20,66)).Text=text
 menuButton(frame,&quot;Close&quot;,&quot;Close&quot;,UDim2.fromOffset(96,40),UDim2.new(1,-12,0,12),Vector2.new(1,0)).Activated:Connect(collapseSettlement)
 menuButton(frame,&quot;Restart&quot;,layoutResult and layoutResult.restart and layoutResult.restart..&quot; [R]&quot; or &quot;Replay [R]&quot;,UDim2.fromOffset(200,52),UDim2.new(.5,0,1,-14),Vector2.new(.5,1)).Activated:Connect(requestRestart)
 settlement=frame
 ContextActionService:BindAction(&quot;GameplayRestart&quot;,function(_,state) if state==Enum.UserInputState.Begin then requestRestart() end;return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end,false,Enum.KeyCode.R)
 local stinger=won and &quot;win&quot; or &quot;lose&quot;
 duckMusic(sounds[stinger].seconds+2.5)
 task.delay(.3,function() playLocalSound(stinger) end)
 recordAction(nil,&quot;event&quot;,stinger)
 -- Left alone for 10 s, the panel folds into a small corner button so the game stays visible.
 task.delay(10,function() if settlement==frame then collapseSettlement() end end)
end
-- The opening card: what the game is about and how to play, in at most 3 lines. It goes after 8 s or a click; then
-- the first objective and its arrow show.
local function closeIntro()
 if not intro then return end
 intro:Destroy();intro=nil
 showObjective()
 recordAction(Players.LocalPlayer,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;intro-closed&quot;)
end
function ui.intro(options)
 mounted()
 if type(options)~=&quot;table&quot; or type(options.title)~=&quot;string&quot; or #options.title==0 or #options.title&gt;120 then error(&quot;ui.intro title must be short text such as the game&apos;s name; got &quot;..tostring(type(options)==&quot;table&quot; and options.title or options)) end
 if type(options.lines)~=&quot;table&quot; or #options.lines&lt;1 or #options.lines&gt;3 then error(&quot;ui.intro lines must be 1..3 short texts (the goal, the keys); got &quot;..(type(options.lines)==&quot;table&quot; and #options.lines..&quot; lines&quot; or tostring(options.lines))) end
 for index,text in options.lines do if type(text)~=&quot;string&quot; or #text==0 or #text&gt;240 then error(&quot;ui.intro line &quot;..tostring(index)..&quot; must be text up to 240 bytes&quot;) end end
 closeIntro()
 lastIntro={title=options.title,lines=table.clone(options.lines)}
 local card=Instance.new(&quot;TextButton&quot;);card.Name=&quot;Intro&quot;;card.Text=&quot;&quot;;card.AutoButtonColor=false;card.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5);card.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.45);card.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(540,0);card.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y;card.ZIndex=20;card.Parent=gui
 styled(card,&quot;panel&quot;)
 stack(card,10,22,Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center)
 local title=line(card,&quot;Heading&quot;,1,32);title.Text=theme.icon..&quot; &quot;..options.title;title.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center;styled(title,&quot;accent&quot;)
 for index,text in options.lines do line(card,&quot;Line&quot;..index,1+index,22).Text=text end
 local close=menuButton(card,&quot;Dismiss&quot;,&quot;Got it&quot;,UDim2.fromOffset(140,40),UDim2.new(),Vector2.zero);close.LayoutOrder=10
 intro=card
 showObjective()
 card.Activated:Connect(closeIntro);close.Activated:Connect(closeIntro)
 task.delay(8,function() if intro==card then closeIntro() end end)
 recordAction(Players.LocalPlayer,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;intro&quot;)
end
function ui.bindAction(name,options,callback)
 mounted()
 if #name&gt;61 or not name:match(&quot;^[a-z][a-z0-9_%-]*$&quot;) then error(&quot;ui.bindAction name must be the input name, such as cast or fire; got &quot;..name) end
 local input=actionInputs[options.key]
 if not input then error(&quot;ui.bindAction key must be E, F, Q, G, 1-5 or MouseLeftButton (R is play again); got &quot;..tostring(options.key)) end
 if type(options.label)~=&quot;string&quot; or #options.label==0 or #options.label&gt;40 then error(&quot;ui.bindAction label must be short text such as 钓鱼; got &quot;..tostring(options.label)) end
 if options.hold~=nil and type(options.hold)~=&quot;boolean&quot; then error(&quot;ui.bindAction hold must be true or false; got &quot;..tostring(options.hold)) end
 for other,action in boundActions do if other~=name and action.key==options.key then error(&quot;Key &quot;..options.key..&quot; already does &quot;..other..&quot;; one key per action&quot;) end end
 boundActions[name]={key=options.key,label=options.label}
 -- Computers press the key; phones get the touch button Roblox makes for this action. A held action reports, on
 -- release, how long it was held.
 local pressedAt=os.clock()
 ContextActionService:BindAction(&quot;Gameplay_&quot;..name,function(_,state)
  -- Beside a walk-up prompt on the same key, the key is the prompt&apos;s (&quot;[E] 卖鱼 鱼摊&quot; is what the player sees): the
  -- prompt does the job, with the player&apos;s reach, instead of the game&apos;s own action doing it a second way.
  for prompt in shownPrompts do if prompt.Enabled and prompt.KeyboardKeyCode==input then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end end
  -- The server hears which action this press is before the game&apos;s own send for it, so a press the game answers
  -- with no toolbox move still gets a reach and a light sound (SPEC 5.1).
  if state==Enum.UserInputState.Begin then pressedAt=os.clock();runtime.Action:FireServer(&quot;TB_key:&quot;..name);callback(true) elseif state==Enum.UserInputState.End and options.hold then callback(false,os.clock()-pressedAt) end
  return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
 end,true,input)
 ContextActionService:SetTitle(&quot;Gameplay_&quot;..name,options.label)
 renderActionHints()
end
function ui.button(id,text,callback)
 mounted();local count=0;for _,item in gui:GetChildren() do if item:IsA(&quot;TextButton&quot;) and item:GetAttribute(&quot;GameplayInput&quot;) then count+=1 end end
 local button=menuButton(gui,id,text,UDim2.fromOffset(126,62),UDim2.new(1,-18-(count%2)*138,1,-25-math.floor(count/2)*74),Vector2.new(1,1))
 button:SetAttribute(&quot;GameplayInput&quot;,id);button.TextWrapped=true;button.TextSize=23
 button.Activated:Connect(callback);return button
end
-- The game&apos;s own interface (ui.layout): parts the programmer picked, each pinned at one of nine places, stacked top to
-- bottom with the others there, shown when its trigger says. Numbers are read from this player&apos;s attributes and keep
-- themselves up; a part with an action sends it like send(action,nil,item number). ui-layout.ts checks the same table
-- on computer and phone screens before the game runs; here a wrong table stops with what was wrong.
local layoutMade=false
local function truthy(value) return value~=nil and value~=false and value~=0 and value~=&quot;&quot; end
local function watchAttribute(attribute,changed)
 local player=Players.LocalPlayer
 player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function() changed(player:GetAttribute(attribute)) end)
 changed(player:GetAttribute(attribute))
end
local function shownNumber(value,of,format)
 if format==&quot;time&quot; then local seconds=math.max(0,math.floor(tonumber(value) or 0));return string.format(&quot;%02d:%02d&quot;,seconds//60,seconds%60) end
 if type(value)==&quot;boolean&quot; then return value and &quot;✓&quot; or &quot;✗&quot; end
 local number=tonumber(value)
 local text=number and tostring(math.floor(number*10+.5)/10):gsub(&quot;%.0$&quot;,&quot;&quot;) or tostring(value or 0)
 return text..(of and &quot;/&quot;..of or &quot;&quot;)
end
local function sendPart(action,item) runtime.Action:FireServer(action,nil,item) end
local function tint(item,color)
 if color==nil then return end
 if color==&quot;accent&quot; then styled(item,&quot;accent&quot;) elseif color==&quot;danger&quot; then item.TextColor3=theme.danger else item.TextColor3=Color3.fromHex(color) end
end
-- Attribute names: letters and digits after FG_ or TB_ (ui-layout.ts uiAttributePattern is the same rule).
local function attributeName(value) return type(value)==&quot;string&quot; and value:match(&quot;^[FT][GB]_%w+$&quot;)~=nil end
local function partFields(spec,index,fields)
 -- The task line and the leaderboard are the toolbox&apos;s own panels: always shown where they sit, never opened.
 local fixed=spec.kind==&quot;objective&quot; or spec.kind==&quot;leaderboard&quot;
 for key in spec do
  if not (key==&quot;kind&quot; or key==&quot;at&quot; or not fixed and (key==&quot;id&quot; or key==&quot;when&quot;) or table.find(fields,key)) then error(&quot;ui.layout part &quot;..index..&quot; (&quot;..spec.kind..&quot;) has no field &quot;..tostring(key)) end
 end
end
local partFieldNames={title={&quot;text&quot;},counter={&quot;text&quot;,&quot;value&quot;,&quot;of&quot;,&quot;format&quot;,&quot;color&quot;},bar={&quot;text&quot;,&quot;value&quot;,&quot;max&quot;,&quot;color&quot;},timer={&quot;text&quot;,&quot;value&quot;,&quot;warnAt&quot;,&quot;color&quot;},objective={},leaderboard={&quot;text&quot;,&quot;value&quot;},inventory={&quot;items&quot;,&quot;action&quot;},towers={&quot;items&quot;,&quot;action&quot;,&quot;currency&quot;,&quot;money&quot;},shop={&quot;text&quot;,&quot;items&quot;,&quot;action&quot;,&quot;currency&quot;,&quot;money&quot;},button={&quot;text&quot;,&quot;action&quot;,&quot;opens&quot;},popup={&quot;text&quot;,&quot;seconds&quot;},result={&quot;text&quot;,&quot;lose&quot;,&quot;restart&quot;}}
-- A row of cells (inventory, tower cards): across the screen, or down it at the left and right.
local function cellRow(box,spec,cell)
 local upright=spec.at==&quot;left&quot; or spec.at==&quot;right&quot;
 local count=#spec.items
 local along=widgetSizes.pad*2+count*(upright and cell[2] or cell[1])+(count-1)*widgetSizes.itemGap
 box.Size=upright and UDim2.fromOffset(cell[1]+widgetSizes.pad*2,along) or UDim2.fromOffset(along,cell[2]+widgetSizes.pad*2)
 local list=Instance.new(&quot;UIListLayout&quot;);list.FillDirection=upright and Enum.FillDirection.Vertical or Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal;list.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;list.Padding=UDim.new(0,widgetSizes.itemGap);list.Parent=box
 local pad=Instance.new(&quot;UIPadding&quot;);for _,side in {&quot;PaddingTop&quot;,&quot;PaddingBottom&quot;,&quot;PaddingLeft&quot;,&quot;PaddingRight&quot;} do pad[side]=UDim.new(0,widgetSizes.pad) end;pad.Parent=box
end
local function cellText(parent,name,text,y)
 local words=label(parent,name,UDim2.new(1,-8,0,26),UDim2.fromOffset(4,y));words.TextSize=24;words.TextWrapped=false;words.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd;words.Text=text
 return words
end
-- Cards and shop rows a player cannot afford yet are dimmed (money is the attribute holding what they have).
local function dimWhenShort(spec,buttons)
 if not spec.money then return end
 watchAttribute(spec.money,function(have)
  for index,button in buttons do button.AutoButtonColor=(tonumber(have) or 0)&gt;=spec.items[index].price;button.BackgroundTransparency=button.AutoButtonColor and 0 or .45 end
 end)
end
local function priceText(spec,price) return (spec.currency or &quot;🪙&quot;)..&quot; &quot;..tostring(price) end
local builders={}

 box.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(widgetSizes.title[1],widgetSizes.title[2])
 local words=label(box,&quot;Text&quot;,UDim2.new(1,-20,1,0),UDim2.fromOffset(10,0));words.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;words.TextSize=26;words.Text=theme.icon..&quot; &quot;..spec.text;styled(words,&quot;accent&quot;)
end
local function numberPart(box,spec,size)
 box.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size[1],size[2])
 local name=label(box,&quot;Label&quot;,UDim2.new(.5,-10,1,0),UDim2.fromOffset(10,0));name.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;name.TextSize=24;name.Text=spec.text
 local number=label(box,&quot;Value&quot;,UDim2.new(.5,-10,1,0),UDim2.fromScale(.5,0));number.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right;number.TextSize=30
 tint(number,spec.color)
 return number
end

function builders.timer(box,spec)
 local number=numberPart(box,spec,widgetSizes.timer)
 watchAttribute(spec.value,function(value)
  number.Text=shownNumber(value,nil,&quot;time&quot;)
  -- The last seconds (warnAt) turn the number the danger colour.
  if spec.warnAt then
   local left=tonumber(value) or 0
   if left&gt;0 and left&lt;=spec.warnAt then number.TextColor3=theme.danger else styled(number,&quot;text&quot;);tint(number,spec.color) end
  end
 end)
end
function builders.bar(box,spec)
 box.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(widgetSizes.bar[1],widgetSizes.bar[2])
 local name=label(box,&quot;Label&quot;,UDim2.new(.6,-10,0,30),UDim2.fromOffset(10,4));name.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;name.TextSize=24;name.Text=spec.text
 local number=label(box,&quot;Value&quot;,UDim2.new(.4,-10,0,30),UDim2.new(.6,0,0,4));number.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right;number.TextSize=24
 local track=Instance.new(&quot;Frame&quot;);track.Name=&quot;Track&quot;;track.BorderSizePixel=0;track.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0);track.BackgroundTransparency=.55;track.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,14);track.Position=UDim2.new(0,10,1,-22);track.Parent=box
 local fill=Instance.new(&quot;Frame&quot;);fill.Name=&quot;Fill&quot;;fill.BorderSizePixel=0;fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1);fill.Parent=track
 fill.BackgroundColor3=spec.color==&quot;danger&quot; and theme.danger or (spec.color and spec.color~=&quot;accent&quot;) and Color3.fromHex(spec.color) or theme.accent
 for _,item in {track,fill} do local corner=Instance.new(&quot;UICorner&quot;);corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,7);corner.Parent=item end
 local player=Players.LocalPlayer
 local function render()
  local value=tonumber(player:GetAttribute(spec.value)) or 0
  local most=type(spec.max)==&quot;number&quot; and spec.max or tonumber(player:GetAttribute(spec.max)) or 0
  fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(most&gt;0 and math.clamp(value/most,0,1) or 0,1)
  number.Text=shownNumber(value)..&quot;/&quot;..shownNumber(most)
 end
 watchAttribute(spec.value,render)
 if type(spec.max)==&quot;string&quot; then watchAttribute(spec.max,render) end
end
function builders.objective(_,spec,index,slot)
 -- The task line ui.objective writes, with its arrow; it moves into the place the game chose.
 objectivePanel.Parent=slot;objectivePanel.LayoutOrder=index;objectivePanel.Position=UDim2.new();objectivePanel.AnchorPoint=Vector2.zero
 objectivePanel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(widgetSizes.objective[1],0)
end
function builders.leaderboard(_,spec,index,slot)
 rankingPanel.Parent=slot;rankingPanel.LayoutOrder=index;rankingPanel.Position=UDim2.new();rankingPanel.AnchorPoint=Vector2.zero
 rankingPanel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(widgetSizes.leaderboard[1],0)
 rankingPanel.Heading.Text=theme.icon..&quot; &quot;..spec.text
 local function rank()
  local list={}
  for _,other in Players:GetPlayers() do table.insert(list,{name=other.DisplayName,score=tonumber(other:GetAttribute(spec.value)) or 0}) end
  table.sort(list,function(a,b) return a.score&gt;b.score end)
  -- The top six, so the panel keeps the height the layout check measured.
  ui.leaderboard({table.unpack(list,1,math.min(6,#list))})
 end
 for _,other in Players:GetPlayers() do other:GetAttributeChangedSignal(spec.value):Connect(rank) end
 Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(other) other:GetAttributeChangedSignal(spec.value):Connect(rank);rank() end)
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function() task.defer(rank) end)
 rank()
end
function builders.inventory(box,spec)
 box.BackgroundTransparency=1

  slot.LayoutOrder=index
  local name=cellText(slot,&quot;Name&quot;,item.name,8)
  local count=cellText(slot,&quot;Count&quot;,&quot;&quot;,40);styled(count,spec.action and &quot;button&quot; or &quot;accent&quot;)
  if spec.action then slot:SetAttribute(&quot;GameplayInput&quot;,spec.action);slot.Activated:Connect(function() sendPart(spec.action,index) end) end
  watchAttribute(item.value,function(value)
   local have=tonumber(value) or (value==true and 1) or 0
   count.Text=&quot;×&quot;..tostring(have);name.TextTransparency=have&gt;0 and 0 or .5;count.TextTransparency=name.TextTransparency
  end)
 end
end
function builders.towers(box,spec)
 box.BackgroundTransparency=1
 cellRow(box,spec,widgetSizes.towerCard)
 local cell=widgetSizes.towerCard
 local cards={}
 local function pick(chosen)
  for index,card in cards do styled(card,index==chosen and &quot;button&quot; or &quot;panel&quot;);for _,words in card:GetChildren() do if words:IsA(&quot;TextLabel&quot;) then styled(words,index==chosen and &quot;button&quot; or &quot;text&quot;) end end end
 end

  local card=menuButton(box,&quot;Tower&quot;..index,&quot;&quot;,UDim2.fromOffset(cell[1],cell[2]),UDim2.new(),Vector2.zero);card.LayoutOrder=index;card:SetAttribute(&quot;GameplayInput&quot;,spec.action)

local partBoxes={}
function builders.button(box,spec,index)
 box.BackgroundTransparency=1;box.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(widgetSizes.button[1],widgetSizes.button[2])
 local button=menuButton(box,spec.action or (&quot;Open_&quot;..spec.opens),spec.text,UDim2.fromScale(1,1),UDim2.new(),Vector2.zero);button.TextWrapped=true;button.TextSize=24

function builders.popup(box,spec)
 box.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(widgetSizes.popup[1],widgetSizes.popup[2]);box.ZIndex=5
 local words=label(box,&quot;Text&quot;,UDim2.new(1,-32,1,-16),UDim2.fromOffset(16,8));words.TextSize=28;words.ZIndex=5
 local function fill(value) words.Text=(spec.text:gsub(&quot;{value}&quot;,function() return shownNumber(value) end)) end
 fill(nil)
 if spec.when:sub(1,7)==&quot;change:&quot; then
  -- Each change of the attribute (not its first value) shows the popup for a few seconds.
  local attribute,shownAt,first=spec.when:sub(8),0,true
  watchAttribute(attribute,function(value)
   if first then first=false;return end
   fill(value);box.Visible=true
   local stamp=os.clock();shownAt=stamp
   task.delay(spec.seconds or 3,function() if shownAt==stamp then box.Visible=false end end)
  end)
 else watchAttribute(spec.when,function(value) fill(value) end) end
end
function ui.layout(parts)
 mounted()
 if layoutMade then error(&quot;ui.layout is called once, at the start of ui.luau, with every part&quot;) end
 if type(parts)~=&quot;table&quot; or #parts&lt;1 or #parts&gt;12 then error(&quot;ui.layout needs 1..12 parts such as {kind=\&quot;counter\&quot;,at=\&quot;topLeft\&quot;,text=\&quot;金币\&quot;,value=\&quot;FG_Gold\&quot;}; got &quot;..(type(parts)==&quot;table&quot; and #parts..&quot; parts&quot; or type(parts))) end
 for index,spec in parts do
  if type(spec)~=&quot;table&quot; or not table.find(widgetKinds,spec.kind) then error(&quot;ui.layout part &quot;..index..&quot; kind must be one of &quot;..table.concat(widgetKinds,&quot;, &quot;)..&quot;; got &quot;..tostring(type(spec)==&quot;table&quot; and spec.kind or spec)) end
  if not table.find(slotNames,spec.at) then error(&quot;ui.layout part &quot;..index..&quot; at must be one of &quot;..table.concat(slotNames,&quot;, &quot;)..&quot;; got &quot;..tostring(spec.at)) end
  partFields(spec,index,partFieldNames[spec.kind])
  for _,key in {&quot;value&quot;,&quot;money&quot;} do if spec[key]~=nil and not attributeName(spec[key]) then error(&quot;ui.layout part &quot;..index..&quot; &quot;..key..&quot; must be a player attribute such as FG_Gold; got &quot;..tostring(spec[key])) end end
  if type(spec.max)==&quot;string&quot; and not attributeName(spec.max) then error(&quot;ui.layout part &quot;..index..&quot; max must be a number or a player attribute such as FG_Capacity; got &quot;..spec.max) end
  local when=spec.when
  if when~=nil and not (when==&quot;always&quot; or when==&quot;toggle&quot; or attributeName(when) or type(when)==&quot;string&quot; and when:sub(1,7)==&quot;change:&quot; and attributeName(when:sub(8))) then error(&quot;ui.layout part &quot;..index..&quot; when must be always, toggle, a player attribute or change:attribute; got &quot;..tostring(when)) end
  if spec.items~=nil and (type(spec.items)~=&quot;table&quot; or #spec.items&lt;1) then error(&quot;ui.layout part &quot;..index..&quot; items must list at least one item; got &quot;..tostring(spec.items)) end
  for row,item in spec.items or {} do
   if type(item)~=&quot;table&quot; or type(item.name)~=&quot;string&quot; then error(&quot;ui.layout part &quot;..index..&quot; item &quot;..row..&quot; needs a name; got &quot;..tostring(item)) end
   if spec.kind==&quot;inventory&quot; and not attributeName(item.value) then error(&quot;ui.layout part &quot;..index..&quot; item &quot;..row..&quot; value must be a player attribute such as FG_Keys; got &quot;..tostring(item.value)) end
   if spec.kind~=&quot;inventory&quot; and type(item.price)~=&quot;number&quot; then error(&quot;ui.layout part &quot;..index..&quot; item &quot;..row..&quot; price must be a number; got &quot;..tostring(item.price)) end
  end
 end
 layoutMade=true
 -- The fixed corner panel steps aside: the game&apos;s own parts show its numbers.
 scorePanel.Visible=false;objectiveOff=true
 local slots={}
 for _,at in slotNames do
  local frame=Instance.new(&quot;Frame&quot;);frame.Name=&quot;Place_&quot;..at;frame.BackgroundTransparency=1;frame.Size=UDim2.new();frame.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
  frame.Position,frame.AnchorPoint=slotPlace(at)
  local list=Instance.new(&quot;UIListLayout&quot;);list.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;list.Padding=UDim.new(0,widgetSizes.gap)
  list.HorizontalAlignment=frame.AnchorPoint.X==0 and Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left or frame.AnchorPoint.X==1 and Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right or Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
  list.Parent=frame;frame.Parent=gui;slots[at]=frame
 end
 layoutSlots=slots;dockLevelBar()
 for index,spec in parts do
  if spec.kind==&quot;result&quot; then
   -- Folded, Play again goes to a place no part uses (never a phone&apos;s bottom corners), else where the result sat.
   local used={}
   for _,other in parts do if other.kind~=&quot;result&quot; then used[other.at]=true end end
   local fold=spec.at==&quot;center&quot; and &quot;bottom&quot; or spec.at
   for _,at in {spec.at,&quot;right&quot;,&quot;left&quot;,&quot;bottom&quot;,&quot;top&quot;,&quot;topLeft&quot;} do if at~=&quot;center&quot; and not used[at] then fold=at;break end end
   layoutResult={at=spec.at,text=spec.text,lose=spec.lose,restart=spec.restart,fold=fold}
  elseif spec.kind==&quot;objective&quot; then objectiveOff=false;builders.objective(nil,spec,index,slots[spec.at])
  elseif spec.kind==&quot;leaderboard&quot; then builders.leaderboard(nil,spec,index,slots[spec.at])
  else
   local box=panel(slots[spec.at],spec.id or (spec.kind..index),UDim2.new(),UDim2.new());box.LayoutOrder=index
   box:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Part&quot;,spec.kind)
   if spec.id then partBoxes[spec.id]=box end
   builders[spec.kind](box,spec,index)
   local when=spec.when or &quot;always&quot;
   if when==&quot;toggle&quot; or spec.kind==&quot;popup&quot; and when:sub(1,7)==&quot;change:&quot; then box.Visible=false
   elseif when~=&quot;always&quot; then watchAttribute(when,function(value) box.Visible=truthy(value) end) end
  end
 end
 for _,spec in parts do if spec.opens and not partBoxes[spec.opens] then error(&quot;ui.layout button opens &quot;..spec.opens..&quot;, but no part has id=&quot;..spec.opens) end end
 showObjective()
 recordAction(Players.LocalPlayer,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;layout &quot;..#parts)
end

		player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(objective)
	end
	objective()

 local function remember(holder,kind,name)
  if not holder then holder=game:GetService(&quot;ReplicatedStorage&quot;):FindFirstChild(&quot;GameplayToolbox&quot;) end
  if not holder then return end
  local log=logs[holder] or {}
  logs[holder]=log
  table.insert(log,{kind=kind,name=name,at=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()})
  if #log&gt;100 then table.remove(log,1) end
  holder:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_ActionLog&quot;,game:GetService(&quot;HttpService&quot;):JSONEncode(log))
 end
 local function holderOf(object)
  local model=object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA(&quot;Model&quot;)
  while model and not model:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;) do model=model:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA(&quot;Model&quot;) end
  if model then return game:GetService(&quot;Players&quot;):GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) or model end
  return nil
 end
 local function watch(object)
  if object:IsA(&quot;Animator&quot;) then
   -- Only moves (Action priority and up): walking, running and standing (Core/Idle/Movement) would crowd them out.
   object.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
    local priority=track.Priority
    if priority~=Enum.AnimationPriority.Core and priority.Value&gt;=Enum.AnimationPriority.Action.Value then remember(holderOf(object),&quot;animation&quot;,(track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId or &quot;&quot;)..&quot; &quot;..track.Name) end
   end)
  elseif object:IsA(&quot;Sound&quot;) then
   -- Roblox&apos;s own footstep and jump sounds would crowd out the game&apos;s sounds.
   if characterSounds[object.Name] and object.Parent and object.Parent.Name==&quot;HumanoidRootPart&quot; then return end
   object.Played:Connect(function() remember(holderOf(object),&quot;sound&quot;,object.Name..&quot; &quot;..object.SoundId) end)
  elseif object:IsA(&quot;ParticleEmitter&quot;) or object:IsA(&quot;Beam&quot;) or object:IsA(&quot;Trail&quot;) or object:IsA(&quot;Explosion&quot;) or object:IsA(&quot;Highlight&quot;) then
   remember(holderOf(object),&quot;effect&quot;,object.ClassName..&quot;:&quot;..object.Name)
  end
 end
 if game:GetService(&quot;RunService&quot;):IsStudio() then
  recordAction=remember
  for _,root in {workspace,game:GetService(&quot;SoundService&quot;)} do
   for _,object in root:GetDescendants() do watch(object) end
   root.DescendantAdded:Connect(watch)
  end
 end
end

-- What is fixed on a gameplay door (its push bar, hinges, glass: scene-gameplay-mounts.ts) opens and shuts with it

local mountedOn={}

-- A library prop (a gate, a lever, a coin) comes as an invisible box holding its visible part. Opening, moving or
-- hiding the anchor means the prop itself, so a box around one part hands it its name, attributes, tags, place and
-- whether it is touched and hit (q10 lowered the box of its iron gate and the gate stayed shut). A prop of several
-- parts (a chest and its lid) keeps its box: the game moves its parts itself.
for id,part in anchors do
 if part.Transparency&gt;=.95 and not part.CanCollide and not part:FindFirstChild(&quot;GameplayAnchorModel&quot;) then
  local looks={}
  for _,item in part:GetDescendants() do if item:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then table.insert(looks,item) end end
  if #looks==1 then
   local look=looks[1]
   for name,value in part:GetAttributes() do look:SetAttribute(name,value) end
   for _,tag in CollectionService:GetTags(part) do CollectionService:AddTag(look,tag) end
   look.Name=part.Name;look.Anchored=part.Anchored;look.CanTouch=part.CanTouch;look.CanQuery=part.CanQuery;look.Parent=part.Parent
   for _,child in part:GetChildren() do if not child:IsA(&quot;JointInstance&quot;) and not child:IsA(&quot;WeldConstraint&quot;) then child.Parent=look end end
   part:Destroy();anchors[id]=look
  else
   -- 10-29 final q3: the champion stood inside its empty anchor box and 30 shots all struck the box; a kept box is
   -- no target for a ray (shots, aim, line of sight), only a place.
   part.CanQuery=false
  end
 end
end

local function bounded(value,name,maximum)
 if type(value)~=&quot;number&quot; or value~=value or value&lt;0 or value&gt;(maximum or 100000) then error(&quot;Invalid &quot;..name..&quot;:&quot;..tostring(value)) end
 return value
end
local function finiteVector(value)
 return typeof(value)==&quot;Vector3&quot; and value.X==value.X and value.Y==value.Y and value.Z==value.Z and math.abs(value.X)&lt;=100000 and math.abs(value.Y)&lt;=100000 and math.abs(value.Z)&lt;=100000
end

local function root(actor) local c=character(actor);return c and c:FindFirstChild(&quot;HumanoidRootPart&quot;) end
local function living(actor) local c=character(actor);local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;);return h and h.Health&gt;0 end

-- Instance-keyed tables are plain tables: Roblox drops an Instance key from a weak table while the Instance still
-- exists. An entry goes when its Instance is destroyed.
local function keepFor(map,instance,value)
 if map[instance]==nil then instance.Destroying:Connect(function() map[instance]=nil end) end
 map[instance]=value
end

end

local tracks={}
local function track(model,name)
 local humanoid=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;)
 if not humanoid then return nil end
 local animator=humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Animator&quot;)
 if not animator then animator=Instance.new(&quot;Animator&quot;);animator.Parent=humanoid end
 if not tracks[animator] then keepFor(tracks,animator,{}) end
 local cache=tracks[animator]
 if not cache[name] then
  if not animations[name] then error(&quot;Unknown toolbox animation:&quot;..tostring(name)) end
  cache[name]=animator:LoadAnimation(animations[name])
 end
 return cache[name]
end

-- Moves no official animation covers: one joint turns out and back (radians about its X axis; positive lifts an
-- arm forward and up, or leans the torso back).
local motions={recoil={joint=&quot;RightShoulder&quot;,angle=.45,out=.05,hold=0,back=.18},reel={joint=&quot;RightShoulder&quot;,angle=1.1,out=.2,hold=.2,back=.3},reach={joint=&quot;RightShoulder&quot;,angle=1.2,out=.15,hold=.15,back=.25},raise={joint=&quot;RightShoulder&quot;,angle=.7,out=.15,hold=.2,back=.25},throw={joint=&quot;RightShoulder&quot;,angle=2.6,out=.12,hold=.05,back=.2},flinch={joint=&quot;Waist&quot;,angle=.3,out=.06,hold=.04,back=.18},kick={joint=&quot;RightHip&quot;,angle=1.2,out=.1,hold=.06,back=.25}}
local jointMoves={}
local function motion(model,name)
 answerKeyPress(model)
 local pose=motions[name]
 if not pose then error(&quot;Unknown toolbox motion:&quot;..tostring(name)) end
 -- A Motor6D turns its C0; the AnimationConstraint joints of newer avatars turn their Attachment0, which is the same frame.
 local joint=model and model:FindFirstChild(pose.joint,true)
 local frame=joint and (joint:IsA(&quot;Motor6D&quot;) and joint or joint:IsA(&quot;AnimationConstraint&quot;) and joint.Attachment0)
 if not frame then return end
 local property=frame:IsA(&quot;Motor6D&quot;) and &quot;C0&quot; or &quot;CFrame&quot;
 -- A joint already moving finishes first, so a throw is not cut short by the shot it fires.
 if not jointMoves[frame] then keepFor(jointMoves,frame,{resting=frame[property],busyUntil=0}) end
 local move=jointMoves[frame]
 if move.busyUntil&gt;os.clock() then return end
 move.busyUntil=os.clock()+pose.out+pose.hold+pose.back
 local resting=move.resting
 TweenService:Create(frame,TweenInfo.new(pose.out,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{[property]=resting*CFrame.Angles(pose.angle,0,0)}):Play()
 task.delay(pose.out+pose.hold,function() if frame.Parent then TweenService:Create(frame,TweenInfo.new(pose.back,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad),{[property]=resting}):Play() end end)
 recordAction(holderOf(model),&quot;animation&quot;,&quot;procedural TB_act_&quot;..name)
end

local function tracer(actor,from,to,direction)
 -- A shot that lands right at the muzzle (the target pressed against the gun) still flashes a short streak along the
 -- aim (q3: two of three point-blank shots at a drone drew nothing).
 if (to-from).Magnitude&lt;1.5 then to=from+direction.Unit*1.5 end
 local length=(to-from).Magnitude
 local line=Instance.new(&quot;Part&quot;);line.Name=&quot;TB_Tracer&quot;;line.Anchored=true;line.CanCollide=false;line.CanTouch=false;line.CanQuery=false;line.CastShadow=false;line.Material=Enum.Material.Neon;line.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,228,140)
 line.Size=Vector3.new(.25,.25,length);line.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(from,to)*CFrame.new(0,0,-length/2);line.Parent=workspace
 recordAction(actor,&quot;effect&quot;,&quot;tracer&quot;)
 task.delay(.12,function() if line.Parent then TweenService:Create(line,TweenInfo.new(.4),{Transparency=1}):Play() end end)
 Debris:AddItem(line,.6)
end

local function stateFor(actor)
 if not privateStates[actor] then privateStates[actor]={coins=0,xp=0,level=1,inventory={},role=&quot;&quot;,captured=false,shots=0,shotAt=-math.huge,thrownAt=-math.huge,upgrades={}} end
 return privateStates[actor]
end
local function snapshot(value)
 if type(value)~=&quot;table&quot; then return value end
 local result={} for key,item in value do result[key]=snapshot(item) end
 return table.freeze(result)
end
local function publish(actor)
 local s=stateFor(actor)
 for key,value in {Coins=s.coins,XP=s.xp,Level=s.level,Role=s.role,Captured=s.captured,Shots=s.shots} do actor:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_&quot;..key,value) end
end
