 if trailIndex then for cursor=#trail,trailIndex+1,-1 do table.remove(trail,cursor) end else v.trail={} end
 v.stillAt=nil;v.lastRecovery=now;v.lastSample=now;v.movedFrom=upright.Position
 recordAction(rider,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;vehicle-recovered &quot;..v.model.Name)
 return true
end
local function recoverVehicle(v,index,now)
 local upright=uprightRecoveryPose(v,index)
 if not upright then return false end
 return placeRecoveredVehicle(v,upright,now,index,true)
end
-- Walled in where the way back is not clear (11-08 kart: astride a fence whose centre it had crossed, every visited
-- point lay beyond the fence): it is set straight down on the last safe point it drove over at least 6 studs away,
-- facing along the route, else back on its start spot. Both were reached before, so this never skips ahead.
local function liftToVisited(v,now)
 local trail=v.trail or {}
 for index=#trail,1,-1 do
  local entry=trail[index]
  if entry.safe and (entry.pose.Position-v.frame.Position).Magnitude&gt;=6 then
   local upright=uprightRecoveryPose(v,index)
   if upright then recordAction(v.rider,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;vehicle-lifted &quot;..v.model.Name);return placeRecoveredVehicle(v,upright,now,index,false) end
  end
 end
 recordAction(v.rider,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;vehicle-to-start &quot;..v.model.Name)
 return placeRecoveredVehicle(v,v.start,now)
end
-- An overturned or falling car is not a stationary obstruction. Prefer a visited safe pose, then the old fallback.
local function rescueVehicle(v,fallback,now)
 local chosen,distance=nil,math.huge
 for index,entry in v.trail or {} do
  local apart=(entry.pose.Position-v.frame.Position).Magnitude
  if entry.safe and apart&lt;distance then
   local upright=uprightRecoveryPose(v,index)
   if upright then chosen,distance=upright,apart end
  end
 end
 v.flippedAt=nil
 return placeRecoveredVehicle(v,chosen or fallback,now)
end
local function updateVehicleRecovery(v,now)
 if v.recoveringUntil then
  if now&lt;v.recoveringUntil then return true end
  v.recoveringUntil=nil;v.model:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Recovering&quot;,false)
  if v.recoveryRider and vehicleRecoveries[v.recoveryRider] then vehicleRecoveries[v.recoveryRider].active=false end
  v.recoveryRider=nil
  for _,part in v.owned do part:SetNetworkOwner(v.rider) end
 end
 if not v.seat.Occupant then v.stillAt=nil;return false end
 local pose=v.frame.CFrame
 v.trail=v.trail or {}
 local last=v.trail[#v.trail]
 -- A teleport, respawn or a long observation gap is not a driven connection between two roads.
 if last and (pose.Position-last.pose.Position).Magnitude&gt;math.max(12,v.speed*.6) then
  local delta=pose.Position-last.pose.Position
  local falling=delta.Y&lt;0 and v.frame.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y&lt;-1 and Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z).Magnitude&lt;12
  if not falling then table.clear(v.trail);last=nil end
 end
 if not v.lastSample or now-v.lastSample&gt;=.2 then
  v.lastSample=now
  if not last or (pose.Position-last.pose.Position).Magnitude&gt;=1 then
   table.insert(v.trail,{pose=pose,safe=supportedRecoveryPose(v,pose)})
   if #v.trail&gt;160 then table.remove(v.trail,1) end
  end
 end
 -- Stuck: the throttle held for 4 seconds and the car never got 3 studs from where that began. A car caught in a fence
 -- still rocks a stud or so each way as W and S change (11-08 kart: 0.96), which must not start the count again.
 local pushing=math.abs(v.seat.ThrottleFloat)&gt;.1
 if not pushing or not v.movedFrom or (pose.Position-v.movedFrom).Magnitude&gt;3 then
  v.stillAt=now;v.movedFrom=pose.Position
 elseif now-(v.stillAt or now)&gt;=4 and now-(v.lastRecovery or -math.huge)&gt;=5 then
  v.lastRecovery=now
  local destination=recoveryDestination(v)
  if destination then return recoverVehicle(v,destination,now) end
  return liftToVisited(v,now)
 end
 return false
end

local function createVehicle(model,options)
 local boat=options and options.kind==&quot;boat&quot;
 local tool=boat and &quot;tools.boat&quot; or &quot;tools.vehicle&quot;
 if typeof(model)~=&quot;Instance&quot; or not (model:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;) or model:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;)) then error(tool..&quot; model must be a Model or MeshPart (the car or the animal); got &quot;..tostring(model)) end
 if type(options)~=&quot;table&quot; or not vehicleActions[options.kind] then error(&apos;tools.vehicle kind must be &quot;car&quot; or &quot;mount&quot;; got &apos;..tostring(type(options)==&quot;table&quot; and options.kind or options)) end
 if type(options.name)~=&quot;string&quot; or #options.name==0 or #options.name&gt;40 then error(tool..&quot; name must be short text such as 卡丁车 or 小马; got &quot;..tostring(options.name)) end
 local speed=bounded(options.speed,tool..&quot; speed&quot;,120)
 if speed~=speed or speed&lt;5 then error(tool..&quot; speed must be 5..120 studs a second; got &quot;..speed) end
 if options.scale~=nil and (type(options.scale)~=&quot;number&quot; or options.scale~=options.scale or options.scale&lt;.3 or options.scale&gt;10) then error(tool..&quot; scale must be 0.3..10; got &quot;..tostring(options.scale)) end
 if options.onRide~=nil and type(options.onRide)~=&quot;function&quot; then error(tool..&quot; onRide must be a function&quot;) end
 if options.owner~=nil and not (typeof(options.owner)==&quot;Instance&quot; and options.owner:IsA(&quot;Player&quot;)) then error(tool..&quot; owner must be a Player; got &quot;..tostring(options.owner)) end
 local spot
 if options.anchor~=nil then
  spot=targetPart(options.anchor,tool..&quot; anchor&quot;)
 elseif not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then error(tool..&quot; needs an anchor to stand on for a model kept outside workspace: &quot;..model:GetFullName()) end
 local scale=options.scale or 1
 -- The rider sits where the model&apos;s own seat was; a car faces where that seat faces, an animal where its head is.
 local guide=model:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;) and (model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(&quot;VehicleSeat&quot;,true) or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(&quot;Seat&quot;,true))
 local guideOffset=guide and model:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(guide.CFrame)
 local shell=lookOnly(model,scale)
 local parts={}
 for _,part in shell:GetDescendants() do if part:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then part.Anchored=true;part.CanCollide=false;part.CanTouch=false;part.Massless=true;table.insert(parts,part) end end
 if #parts==0 then error(tool..&quot; model has no parts: &quot;..model:GetFullName()) end
 local box=shell:GetBoundingBox()
 local seatFrame=guideOffset and shell:GetPivot()*CFrame.new(guideOffset.Position*scale)*guideOffset.Rotation
 local head,saddle
 for _,part in parts do local lowered=part.Name:lower();if not head and lowered:find(&quot;head&quot;) then head=part end;if not saddle and lowered:find(&quot;saddle&quot;) then saddle=part end end
 local toHead=head and flatUnit(head.Position-box.Position,nil)
 local alongSeat=seatFrame and flatUnit(seatFrame.LookVector,nil)
 local forward=(options.kind==&quot;mount&quot; and (toHead or alongSeat) or (alongSeat or toHead)) or flatUnit(box.LookVector,Vector3.new(0,0,-1))
 local base=CFrame.lookAt(box.Position,box.Position+forward)
 -- Its size in its own frame (x right, y up, -z forward).
 local low,high=Vector3.one*math.huge,-Vector3.one*math.huge
 for _,part in parts do for _,corner in corners do local point=base:PointToObjectSpace(part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(part.Size/2*corner));low=low:Min(point);high=high:Max(point) end end
 local size=high-low
 local origin=base*CFrame.new((low.X+high.X)/2,low.Y,(low.Z+high.Z)/2)
 -- Wheels sit symmetrically about the centre line, their bottoms level with the model&apos;s bottom. A mount&apos;s wheels are
 -- hidden under its legs, so they are bigger and set wider and longer than the animal: it rolls over stones and bumps
 -- and does not tip over on rough ground.
 local mount=options.kind==&quot;mount&quot;
 local radius=boat and .5 or math.clamp(size.Y*(mount and .3 or .25),1,3)
 local width=math.clamp(radius*.8,.6,2)
 local track=math.max(size.X/2-width/2,size.Z*(mount and .4 or .2),1.2)
 local axle=math.max(size.Z/2-radius*1.1,radius*1.2,mount and size.Z*.35 or 0)
 local vehicle=Instance.new(&quot;Model&quot;);vehicle.Name=options.name;vehicle:SetAttribute(&quot;GameplayVehicle&quot;,options.kind);vehicle:SetAttribute(&quot;GameplayVehicleSpeed&quot;,speed);CollectionService:AddTag(vehicle,&quot;GameplayVehicle&quot;)
 -- The rider&apos;s computer drives the wheels with the same driveVehicle as the server; it reads the chassis from these.
 vehicle:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_WheelRadius&quot;,radius);vehicle:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Track&quot;,track);vehicle:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Wheelbase&quot;,axle*2);vehicle:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Height&quot;,size.Y)
 shell.Name=&quot;Look&quot;;shell.Parent=vehicle;vehicle.Parent=workspace
 -- The seat: the model&apos;s own seat, else its saddle, else the middle of its top.
 local seatAt=seatFrame and origin:PointToObjectSpace(seatFrame.Position) or saddle and origin:PointToObjectSpace(saddle.Position) or Vector3.zero
 local seatHeight
 if guide then seatHeight=seatAt.Y+guide.Size.Y*scale/2 else
  local cast=RaycastParams.new();cast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include;cast.FilterDescendantsInstances={shell}
  local hit=workspace:Raycast(origin:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(seatAt.X,size.Y+4,seatAt.Z)),-origin.UpVector*(size.Y+8),cast)
  seatHeight=hit and origin:PointToObjectSpace(hit.Position).Y or size.Y*.45
 end
 -- A thin slab at axle height: heavy (at least about 150 in all, so a player walking into it does not shove it), so the
 -- centre of gravity sits at the axles. It collides with nothing: only the wheels touch the ground, so a stone, a bump
 -- or the crest of a slope never hangs the vehicle up with its wheels in the air.
 local frame=physicsPart(&quot;TB_Frame&quot;,Vector3.new(math.max(1,track*2-width-.2),math.max(.3,radius*.4),math.max(1,axle*2)),origin*CFrame.new(0,radius,0),vehicle)
 frame.CustomPhysicalProperties=PhysicalProperties.new(math.clamp(150/(frame.Size.X*frame.Size.Y*frame.Size.Z),15,100),.3,0,1,1)
 frame.CanCollide=false;frame.CanTouch=false
 -- One weightless slippery box fills the wheels&apos; whole footprint from axle height to the wheel tops: a fence, a rail or
 -- a post that high stops at it and never gets between the wheels. 11-08 kart: two thin bars on the centre line let a
 -- fence&apos;s open end slide in under and over them, the car straddled the fence and no key drove it off. Below axle height
 -- it is open, so a kerb, a stone or the crest of a slope passes under it and never hangs the vehicle up; routes may
 -- pass it (a route starting under the vehicle must still work).
 if not boat then
  local guard=physicsPart(&quot;TB_Guard&quot;,Vector3.new(track*2+width,radius,axle*2+radius*2),origin*CFrame.new(0,radius*1.5,0),vehicle)
  guard.Massless=true;guard.CanTouch=false
  guard.CustomPhysicalProperties=PhysicalProperties.new(.7,.05,0,100,1)
  local passable=Instance.new(&quot;PathfindingModifier&quot;);passable.PassThrough=true;passable.Parent=guard
  local guardWeld=Instance.new(&quot;WeldConstraint&quot;);guardWeld.Part0=frame;guardWeld.Part1=guard;guardWeld.Parent=guard
 end
 if boat then frame.Size=Vector3.new(size.X,1,size.Z);frame.CanCollide=true end
 vehicle.PrimaryPart=frame
 local seat=Instance.new(&quot;VehicleSeat&quot;);seat.Name=&quot;TB_Seat&quot;;seat.Size=Vector3.new(2,.4,2);seat.Transparency=1;seat.CanCollide=false;seat.CanTouch=false;seat.Massless=true;seat.HeadsUpDisplay=false;seat.Anchored=true
 seat.CFrame=origin*CFrame.new(seatAt.X,seatHeight+.2,seatAt.Z);keepFor(toolboxSeats,seat,true);seat.Parent=vehicle
 local riding={seat}
 for _,part in parts do table.insert(riding,part) end
 local body,legGroups={},{}
 for _,part in riding do
  local offset=frame.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
  local joint=Instance.new(&quot;Motor6D&quot;);joint.Name=&quot;TB_Ride&quot;;joint.Part0=frame;joint.Part1=part;joint.C0=offset;joint.Parent=frame
  local entry={joint=joint,offset=offset}
  -- A mount&apos;s legs: narrow parts in its lower half, grouped by corner so each leg turns about its own hip.
  local p=offset.Position
  if options.kind==&quot;mount&quot; and part~=seat and p.Y+radius&lt;size.Y*.5 and math.max(part.Size.X,part.Size.Z)&lt;.5*math.max(size.X,size.Z) then
   local key=(p.X&gt;0 and &quot;r&quot; or &quot;l&quot;)..(p.Z&gt;0 and &quot;b&quot; or &quot;f&quot;)
   local group=legGroups[key] or {parts={},top=-math.huge,x=0,z=0,sign=(key==&quot;rb&quot; or key==&quot;lf&quot;) and 1 or -1}
   legGroups[key]=group
   table.insert(group.parts,entry);group.top=math.max(group.top,p.Y+part.Size.Y/2);group.x+=p.X;group.z+=p.Z
  else table.insert(body,entry) end
 end
 local legs={}
 for _,group in legGroups do group.hinge=Vector3.new(group.x/#group.parts,group.top,group.z/#group.parts);table.insert(legs,group) end
 local motors,steering,owned={},{},{frame}
 for _,corner in (boat and {} or wheelCorners) do
  local at=origin*CFrame.new(corner[1]*track,radius,corner[2]*axle)
  local wheel=physicsPart(&quot;TB_Wheel&quot;,Vector3.new(width,radius*2,radius*2),at,vehicle);wheel.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
  wheel.CustomPhysicalProperties=PhysicalProperties.new(.7,1.2,0,100,1)
  table.insert(owned,wheel)
  local hub=frame
  if corner[2]&lt;0 then
   hub=physicsPart(&quot;TB_Knuckle&quot;,Vector3.one*radius*.8,at,vehicle);hub.CanCollide=false;hub.CanTouch=false;hub.CanQuery=false
   hub.CustomPhysicalProperties=PhysicalProperties.new(2,.3,0,1,1)
   table.insert(owned,hub)
   local turn=hinge(frame,hub,at*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2),Enum.ActuatorType.Servo)
   turn.Name=&quot;TB_Steer&quot;;turn.AngularSpeed=5;turn.LimitsEnabled=true;turn.LowerAngle=-30;turn.UpperAngle=30
   table.insert(steering,turn)
  end
  local motor=hinge(hub,wheel,at,Enum.ActuatorType.Motor)
  motor.Name=&quot;TB_Drive&quot;;motor:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Side&quot;,corner[1]);motor:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Front&quot;,corner[2]&lt;0)
  table.insert(motors,{hinge=motor,side=corner[1],front=corner[2]&lt;0})
 end
 -- Torque to climb a steep slope with a rider aboard; the control loop below ramps the wheels&apos; speed smoothly.
 local mass=25
 for _,part in owned do mass+=part:GetMass() end
 local torque=mass*workspace.Gravity*radius*.5
 for _,motor in motors do motor.hinge.MotorMaxTorque=torque end
 for _,turn in steering do turn.ServoMaxTorque=torque end
 local waterCast=RaycastParams.new();waterCast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include;waterCast.FilterDescendantsInstances={workspace.Terrain};waterCast.IgnoreWater=false
 local waterY
 local at=spot and spot.Position or origin.Position
 local waterHit=workspace:Raycast(at+Vector3.new(0,128,0),Vector3.new(0,-256,0),waterCast)
 -- A submerged anchor is still in water unless a solid ceiling separates its floor from the surface.
 local function landFloor(floor)
  local water=floor and floor.Material==Enum.Material.Water and floor or (waterHit and waterHit.Material==Enum.Material.Water and waterHit)
  if not water then return floor end
  local ignored={vehicle,model};if spot then table.insert(ignored,spot) end
  local bedCast=RaycastParams.new();bedCast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;bedCast.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignored;bedCast.RespectCanCollide=true;bedCast.IgnoreWater=true
  local dryFloor=floor and floor.Material~=Enum.Material.Water
  local bed=dryFloor and floor or workspace:Raycast(water.Position+Vector3.new(0,.1,0),Vector3.new(0,-256,0),bedCast)
  local depth=bed and water.Position.Y-bed.Position.Y or math.huge
  if depth&gt;3 then
   local roof=dryFloor and workspace:Raycast(floor.Position+Vector3.new(0,.1,0),Vector3.new(0,depth-.1,0),bedCast)
   if not roof then vehicle:Destroy();error(tool..&quot; &quot;..options.name..&quot; is on water at &quot;..tostring(water.Position)..&quot; (depth &quot;..tostring(depth)..&quot;); use tools.boat for water vehicles&quot;) end
  end
  return bed or floor
 end
 if boat then
  local hit=waterHit
  if not hit or hit.Material~=Enum.Material.Water then vehicle:Destroy();error(&quot;tools.boat &quot;..options.name..&quot; needs terrain water at &quot;..tostring(at)) end
  waterY=hit.Position.Y
  local facing=spot and flatUnit(spot.CFrame.LookVector,forward) or forward
  local surface=Vector3.new(at.X,waterY+.5,at.Z)
  vehicle:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(surface,surface+facing))
 elseif spot then
  local cast=RaycastParams.new();cast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;cast.FilterDescendantsInstances={vehicle,spot,model};cast.RespectCanCollide=true;cast.IgnoreWater=false
  local floor=workspace:Raycast(spot.Position+Vector3.new(0,size.Y+2,0),Vector3.new(0,-(size.Y+40),0),cast)
  floor=landFloor(floor)
  local ground=floor and floor.Position or spot.Position
  vehicle:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(ground,ground+flatUnit(spot.CFrame.LookVector,forward))*CFrame.new(0,radius+.05,0))
 else
  local cast=RaycastParams.new();cast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;cast.FilterDescendantsInstances={vehicle,model};cast.RespectCanCollide=true;cast.IgnoreWater=false
  local floor=workspace:Raycast(origin.Position+Vector3.new(0,2,0),Vector3.new(0,-40,0),cast)
  floor=landFloor(floor)
  vehicle:PivotTo(frame.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,.05,0))
 end
 for _,part in vehicle:GetDescendants() do if part:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then part.Anchored=false;part.CollisionGroup=&quot;TB_Vehicle&quot; end end
 if boat then frame.Anchored=true else for _,part in owned do part:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end end
 local cast=RaycastParams.new();cast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;cast.FilterDescendantsInstances={vehicle,model};cast.RespectCanCollide=true
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new();overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={vehicle,model};overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
 local v={model=vehicle,original=model,spot=spot,onRide=options.onRide,frame=frame,cast=cast,overlap=overlap,seat=seat,kind=options.kind,speed=speed,radius=radius,track=track,wheelbase=axle*2,height=size.Y,motors=motors,steering=steering,body=body,legs=legs,phase=0,drive=0,start=vehicle:GetPivot(),owned=owned}
 if boat then
  v.pose=frame.CFrame;v.waterY=waterY;v.waterCast=waterCast;v.hull=Vector3.new(size.X,1,size.Z);v.clearance=Vector3.new(size.X,math.max(size.Y,seatHeight+5),size.Z)
  v.cast.IgnoreWater=true;v.cast.CollisionGroup=&quot;TB_Vehicle&quot;;v.overlap.CollisionGroup=&quot;TB_Vehicle&quot;;v.throttle=0;v.steer=0
  v.probe=physicsPart(&quot;TB_BoatProbe&quot;,v.clearance,frame.CFrame,vehicle);v.probe.CanCollide=false;v.probe.CanQuery=false;v.probe.CanTouch=false
  boatFilters(v)
  if not boatFits(v,frame.CFrame,true) then
   -- Task 366 (11-12 seaside fishing): a berth the scene left against a pier or a bank. The boat takes the nearest
   -- clear water within 8 studs, the same heading; only with none there is the berth the scene&apos;s to mend.
   local berth=vehicle:GetPivot();local moved=false
   for _,reach in {2,4,6,8} do
    for index=0,15 do
     local angle=index*math.pi/8
     vehicle:PivotTo(berth+Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*reach,0,math.sin(angle)*reach))
     if boatFits(v,frame.CFrame,true) then moved=true;break end
    end
    if moved then break end
   end
   if not moved then vehicle:Destroy();error(&quot;tools.boat &quot;..options.name..&quot; hull overlaps the bank or an obstacle at &quot;..tostring(berth.Position)) end
   v.pose=frame.CFrame;v.start=vehicle:GetPivot()
  end
  if not boatBoardingLand(v) then vehicle:Destroy();error(&quot;tools.boat &quot;..options.name..&quot; has no reachable dry boarding ground within 10 studs of seat at &quot;..tostring(seat.Position)) end
 end
 if model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then hideOriginal(model) end
 local prompt=tools.prompt(seat,{action=vehicleActions[options.kind],object=options.name},function(player)
  if options.owner and player~=options.owner then tools.feedback(player,&quot;This &quot;..options.name..&quot; belongs to &quot;..options.owner.DisplayName);return end
  local humanoid=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;)
  if humanoid and not seat.Occupant and not humanoid.SeatPart then seat:Sit(humanoid) end
 end)
 -- An owned vehicle (one per player in a race): its prompt shows to the owner alone (toolbox-ui keepOwnersPrompt).
 if options.owner then prompt:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Owner&quot;,options.owner.UserId) end
 -- The rider&apos;s computer runs its physics and drives its wheels while they ride (the server does when no player
 -- does), so the wheels answer the keys with no round trip to the server; space gets off. Getting off, it coasts
 -- to a stop from the speed it had.
 seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal(&quot;Occupant&quot;):Connect(function()
  prompt.Enabled=seat.Occupant==nil
  if boat and (v.restoring or restoreBoat(v)) then return end
  local rider=seat.Occupant and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(seat.Occupant.Parent)
  if not boat then for _,part in owned do if part:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then part:SetNetworkOwner(rider) end end end
  if boat then boatFilters(v) else cast.FilterDescendantsInstances={vehicle,model,rider and rider.Character or nil};overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances=cast.FilterDescendantsInstances end
  if boat then v.throttle=0;v.steer=0;v.inputAt=nil end
  v.drive=(boat or rider) and 0 or frame.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Dot(frame.CFrame.LookVector)
  if rider then v.rider=rider;setRiderGroup(seat.Occupant.Parent,&quot;TB_Vehicle&quot;);recordAction(rider,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;ride &quot;..options.name);if options.onRide then options.onRide(rider,true) end
  elseif v.rider then
   local left=v.rider;v.rider=nil;recordAction(left,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;dismount &quot;..options.name);if options.onRide then options.onRide(left,false) end
   if left.Character then setRiderGroup(left.Character,&quot;Default&quot;) end
   -- Getting off, the rider steps down beside it (left, else right, where nothing stands in the way), not onto it.
   local body=left.Character and left.Character:FindFirstChild(&quot;HumanoidRootPart&quot;)
   local humanoid=left.Character and left.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;)
   if body and humanoid and boat then leaveBoat(v,body,humanoid,left.Character)
   elseif body and humanoid then
    local cast=RaycastParams.new();cast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;cast.FilterDescendantsInstances={vehicle,left.Character};cast.RespectCanCollide=true
    for _,hand in {-1,1} do
     local out=frame.CFrame.RightVector*hand*(track+width/2+2)
     if not workspace:Raycast(frame.Position,out,cast) then
      local ground=workspace:Raycast(frame.Position+out+Vector3.new(0,size.Y,0),Vector3.new(0,-(size.Y+20),0),cast)
      if ground then body.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(ground.Position,ground.Position+frame.CFrame.LookVector)+Vector3.new(0,humanoid.HipHeight+body.Size.Y/2,0) end
      break
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end)
 keepFor(vehicles,vehicle,v)
 return vehicle
end
function tools.vehicle(model,options)
 if type(options)~=&quot;table&quot; or (options.kind~=&quot;car&quot; and options.kind~=&quot;mount&quot;) then error(&apos;tools.vehicle kind must be &quot;car&quot; or &quot;mount&quot;; water vehicles use tools.boat; got &apos;..tostring(type(options)==&quot;table&quot; and options.kind or options)) end
 return createVehicle(model,options)
end
function tools.boat(model,options)
 if type(options)~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&quot;tools.boat options must be a table; got &quot;..tostring(options)) end
 if options.kind~=nil and options.kind~=&quot;boat&quot; then error(&quot;tools.boat does not accept kind &quot;..tostring(options.kind)) end
 local settings=table.clone(options);settings.kind=&quot;boat&quot;
 return createVehicle(model,settings)
end
local boatInput=Instance.new(&quot;RemoteEvent&quot;);boatInput.Name=&quot;BoatInput&quot;;boatInput.Parent=folder
boatInput.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,model,throttle,steer)
 if typeof(model)~=&quot;Instance&quot; then error(&quot;BoatInput model must be an Instance; got &quot;..typeof(model)) end
 for key,value in {throttle=throttle,steer=steer} do if type(value)~=&quot;number&quot; or value~=value or math.abs(value)&gt;1 then error(&quot;BoatInput &quot;..key..&quot; must be -1..1; got &quot;..tostring(value)) end end
 if type(throttle)~=&quot;number&quot; or type(steer)~=&quot;number&quot; then error(&quot;BoatInput needs throttle and steer numbers&quot;) end
 local v=vehicles[model]
 if not v or v.kind~=&quot;boat&quot; or v.rider~=player or not v.seat.Occupant or v.seat.Occupant.Parent~=player.Character then return end
 local now=os.clock();if v.inputAt and now-v.inputAt&lt;.03 then return end
 v.throttle=throttle;v.steer=steer;v.inputAt=now
end)

-- W drives forward; S brakes while moving forward, then reverses at half speed; letting go slows it to a stop. The
-- wheels&apos; speed moves toward that smoothly (studs/s² below) and the motors follow it with full torque; in a bend each
-- wheel turns at the speed of its own path (radius from the rear axle&apos;s centre), so the four motors do not fight.
local function driveVehicle(v,throttle,steer,dt)
 if v.model:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_Recovering&quot;) then
  v.drive=0
  for _,motor in v.motors do motor.hinge.AngularVelocity=0 end
  return
 end
 local serial=v.model:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_RecoverySerial&quot;)
 if serial~=v.recoverySerial then v.recoverySerial=serial;v.drive=0 end
 local forward=v.frame.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Dot(v.frame.CFrame.LookVector)
 local goal,rate=0,30
 if throttle&gt;0 then goal,rate=throttle*v.speed,45
 elseif throttle&lt;0 and forward&gt;2 then goal,rate=0,80
 elseif throttle&lt;0 then goal,rate=throttle*v.speed*.5,30 end
 -- Changing direction (backing away from a wall it was pushing): the wheels start from how fast it really goes, not
 -- from the speed they were still asked for, so the reverse takes at once.
 if goal*v.drive&lt;0 then v.drive=math.clamp(v.drive,forward-3,forward+3) end
 v.drive+=math.clamp(goal-v.drive,-rate*dt,rate*dt)
 -- A step no higher than a player steps up (a kerb, the edge of a raised road or yard) just ahead as it drives at it:
 -- it hops up onto the step whole, as a horse would; wheels this size cannot roll up so high, and one wheel climbing
 -- first tips it over. A wall, a higher ledge, a slope, a fence or a post (no level ground on top for it) does not, nor
-- a step with no room for the whole vehicle on it (a house&apos;s floor behind its wall, a rope or a roof above).
 if math.abs(throttle)&gt;.1 and goal~=0 and os.clock()-(v.hoppedAt or 0)&gt;1 then
  local look=v.frame.CFrame.LookVector
  local ahead=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z).Unit*math.sign(goal)
  local base=v.frame.Position-v.frame.CFrame.UpVector*v.radius
  local clear=v.wheelbase/2+v.radius+.5
  local edge=workspace:Raycast(base+Vector3.new(0,.5,0),ahead*(clear+.3),v.cast)
  if edge and math.abs(edge.Normal.Y)&lt;.3 then
   -- The step&apos;s own top just past its edge, and where it would stand (under its middle and both axles), all level:
   -- not a fence or a wall with higher ground behind it, not a fence&apos;s top.
   local function riseAt(point)
    local top=workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(point.X,base.Y+3,point.Z),Vector3.new(0,-3.5,0),v.cast)
    return top and top.Normal.Y&gt;.7 and top.Position.Y-base.Y
   end
   local landing=edge.Position+ahead*clear
   local rise,front,back,lip=riseAt(landing),riseAt(landing+ahead*v.wheelbase/2),riseAt(landing-ahead*v.wheelbase/2),riseAt(edge.Position+ahead*.3)
   local level=rise and front and back and lip and rise&gt;.4 and rise&lt;=2.6 and math.abs(front-rise)&lt;.8 and math.abs(back-rise)&lt;.8 and math.abs(lip-rise)&lt;.8
   local room=level and #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.lookAt(landing,landing+ahead)+Vector3.new(0,base.Y+rise+.4+(v.height-.4)/2-landing.Y,0),Vector3.new(v.track*2+1,v.height-.4,v.wheelbase+v.radius*2),v.overlap)==0
   if room then
    v.hoppedAt=os.clock()
    v.model:PivotTo(v.model:GetPivot()+Vector3.new(0,rise+.2,0)+ahead*((edge.Position-base):Dot(ahead)+clear))
   end
  end
 end
 local angle=steer*30
 for _,turn in v.steering do if turn.TargetAngle~=-angle then turn.TargetAngle=-angle end end
 local bend=math.abs(angle)&gt;1 and v.wheelbase/math.tan(math.rad(math.abs(angle)))
 for _,motor in v.motors do
  local share=1
  if bend then local path=bend-motor.side*math.sign(angle)*v.track;share=(motor.front and math.sqrt(path^2+v.wheelbase^2) or path)/bend end
  local spin=-v.drive*share/v.radius
  if motor.hinge.AngularVelocity~=spin then motor.hinge.AngularVelocity=spin end
 end
end

vehiclesBack=function()
 local boatRiders={}
 for _,v in vehicles do
  local passengers=v.kind==&quot;boat&quot; and boatPassengers(v)
  if v.kind==&quot;boat&quot; then
   v.restoring=true
   local left=unseatBoat(v)
   local body=left and left.Character and left.Character:FindFirstChild(&quot;HumanoidRootPart&quot;)
   local humanoid=left and left.Character and left.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;)
   if body and humanoid then
    passengers[body]=CFrame.new(0,.5+humanoid.HipHeight+body.Size.Y/2+.2,0)
    boatRiders[left]=left.Character
   end
  else
   local occupant=v.seat.Occupant
   if occupant then local weld=v.seat:FindFirstChild(&quot;SeatWeld&quot;);if weld then weld:Destroy() end;occupant.Sit=false end
  end
  placeVehicle(v,v.start)
  if v.kind==&quot;car&quot; then
   v.trail=nil;v.stillAt=nil;v.recoveringUntil=nil;v.model:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Recovering&quot;,false)
   if v.recoveryRider then vehicleRecoveries[v.recoveryRider]=nil;v.recoveryRider=nil end
  end
  -- Keep standing passengers aboard too. A configured player spawn takes precedence later in restartPlayers.
  if passengers then for body,offset in passengers do
   body.CFrame=v.start*offset
   body.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;body.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
  end end
  v.restoring=nil
 end
 return boatRiders
end
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
 for _,v in vehicles do
  if v.kind==&quot;boat&quot; then
   if restoreBoat(v) then continue end
   local fresh=v.rider and v.inputAt and os.clock()-v.inputAt&lt;.5
   driveBoat(v,fresh and v.throttle or 0,fresh and v.steer or 0,dt)
   continue
  end
  -- Falling and overturning have their own clock: neither waits for four seconds without movement.
  local low=v.frame.Position.Y&lt;v.start.Position.Y-60
  local flipped=v.frame.CFrame.UpVector.Y&lt;.3
  local ground=(low or flipped) and workspace:Raycast(v.frame.Position,Vector3.new(0,-v.radius-4,0),v.cast)
  if ground and ground.Material==Enum.Material.Water then ground=nil end
  if low and not ground then
   if v.kind==&quot;car&quot; then rescueVehicle(v,v.start,os.clock());continue end
   placeVehicle(v,v.start)
  end
  if flipped and ground and v.frame.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude&lt;2 and v.frame.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude&lt;1 then
   v.flippedAt=v.flippedAt or os.clock()
   if os.clock()-v.flippedAt&gt;2 then
    v.flippedAt=nil
    local at=v.frame.Position+Vector3.new(0,v.radius+1,0)
    local upright=CFrame.lookAt(at,at+flatUnit(v.frame.CFrame.LookVector,flatUnit(v.frame.CFrame.UpVector,Vector3.new(0,0,-1))))
    if v.kind==&quot;car&quot; then rescueVehicle(v,upright,os.clock());continue end
    placeVehicle(v,upright)
    recordAction(v.rider,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;vehicle-righted &quot;..v.model.Name)
   end
  else v.flippedAt=nil end
  if v.kind==&quot;car&quot; and updateVehicleRecovery(v,os.clock()) then continue end
  if not v.rider then
   local driving=v.seat.Occupant~=nil
   driveVehicle(v,driving and v.seat.ThrottleFloat or 0,driving and v.seat.SteerFloat or 0,dt)
  end
  if v.kind==&quot;mount&quot; then
   local speed=(v.frame.AssemblyLinearVelocity*Vector3.new(1,0,1)).Magnitude
   local moving=speed&gt;1
   if moving then v.phase+=dt*math.clamp(speed*.5,4,12) end
   local swing=moving and math.sin(v.phase)*.6 or 0
   for _,group in v.legs do
    local turn=CFrame.new(group.hinge)*CFrame.Angles(swing*group.sign,0,0)*CFrame.new(-group.hinge)
    for _,entry in group.parts do entry.joint.C0=turn*entry.offset end
   end
   local lift=moving and math.abs(math.sin(v.phase))*(#v.legs&gt;0 and .05 or .12)*v.height or 0
   for _,entry in v.body do entry.joint.C0=CFrame.new(0,lift,0)*entry.offset end
  end
 end
end)

end -- vehicle internals

-- Balls: a real sphere, light and bouncy, its physics run by the server. A kick sends it where the kicker faces.
local balls={}
-- Goals (11-03, X3 q9): the goal each team scores into, ends changed only by tools.swapGoals. Every player in a team
-- carries TB_KickGoal, the anchor id of that goal, which the test bench aims at: X3 q9 changed ends after the first
-- goal on its own, the bench kicked at the goal its step named and put two in its own net. Not in a team: &quot;&quot;.
local function writeKickGoals(entry)
 for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do
  local team=entry.team(player)
  if team~=nil and not entry.goals[team] then error(&quot;tools.ball team(actor) must return one of &quot;..table.concat(entry.teams,&quot;, &quot;)..&quot; or nil; got &quot;..tostring(team)..&quot; for &quot;..player.Name) end
  local id=team and entry.scoresInto(team) or &quot;&quot;
  if player:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_KickGoal&quot;)~=id then player:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_KickGoal&quot;,id) end
 end
end
function tools.ball(options,onKick)
 local spot=targetPart(options.anchor,&quot;tools.ball anchor&quot;)
 local model=options.model
 if model==nil then
  -- Cloud part fallbacks live under the original anchor; use their look on the one playable ball.
  for _,item in spot:GetDescendants() do
   if item:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;) and item:GetAttribute(&quot;KeyObjectFallback&quot;)==true and item:GetAttribute(&quot;KeyObjectKind&quot;)==&quot;ball&quot; then
    if model then error(&quot;tools.ball anchor contains more than one fallback ball: &quot;..spot:GetFullName()) end
    model=item
   end
  end
 end
 local diameter=options.diameter==nil and 2.5 or bounded(options.diameter,&quot;ball diameter&quot;,20)
 if diameter&lt;.5 then error(&quot;tools.ball diameter must be 0.5..20 studs; got &quot;..diameter) end
 if options.model~=nil and not (typeof(options.model)==&quot;Instance&quot; and (options.model:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;) or options.model:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;))) then error(&quot;tools.ball model must be a Model or MeshPart; got &quot;..tostring(options.model)) end
 if onKick~=nil and type(onKick)~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;tools.ball onKick must be a function&quot;) end
 local goals,team=options.goals,options.team
 if (goals==nil)~=(team==nil) then error(&apos;tools.ball takes goals and team together, such as goals={red=&quot;east-goal&quot;,blue=&quot;west-goal&quot;},team=function(actor) return teams[actor] end; got goals &apos;..typeof(goals)..&quot;, team &quot;..typeof(team)) end
 local teams={}
 if goals~=nil then
  if type(goals)~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&apos;tools.ball goals must map each team to the anchor id of the goal it scores into, such as {red=&quot;east-goal&quot;,blue=&quot;west-goal&quot;}; got &apos;..typeof(goals)) end
  for name,id in goals do
   if type(name)~=&quot;string&quot; or type(id)~=&quot;string&quot; then error(&apos;tools.ball goals must map a team name to a goal anchor id such as red=&quot;east-goal&quot;; got &apos;..tostring(name)..&quot;=&quot;..tostring(id)) end
   tools.anchor(id)
   table.insert(teams,name)
  end
  table.sort(teams)
  if #teams~=2 then error(&quot;tools.ball goals must name exactly two teams; got &quot;..#teams) end
  if goals[teams[1]]==goals[teams[2]] then error(&quot;tools.ball goals: both teams score into &quot;..goals[teams[1]]) end
  if type(team)~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;tools.ball team must be a function(actor) returning the actor&apos;s team or nil; got &quot;..type(team)) end
 end
 local ball=Instance.new(&quot;Part&quot;);ball.Name=&quot;TB_Ball&quot;;ball.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball;ball.Size=Vector3.one*diameter;ball.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic;ball.Color=Color3.fromRGB(245,245,245)
 ball.CustomPhysicalProperties=PhysicalProperties.new(.15,.5,.55,1,1)
 ball:SetAttribute(&quot;GameplayBall&quot;,true);ball:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_PhysicsPart&quot;,true);CollectionService:AddTag(ball,&quot;GameplayBall&quot;)
 local cast=RaycastParams.new();cast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;cast.FilterDescendantsInstances={spot,model}
 local floor=workspace:Raycast(spot.Position+Vector3.new(0,4,0),Vector3.new(0,-60,0),cast)
 local start=(floor and floor.Position or spot.Position)+Vector3.new(0,diameter/2+.05,0)
 ball.CFrame=CFrame.new(start)
 if model then
  -- The model is its look, scaled to the ball and carried by it; the sphere does the colliding.
  local look=lookOnly(model)
  local frame,size=look:GetBoundingBox()
  look:ScaleTo(look:GetScale()*diameter/math.max(size.X,size.Y,size.Z))
  frame=look:GetBoundingBox()
  look:PivotTo(ball.CFrame*frame:ToObjectSpace(look:GetPivot()))
  for _,part in look:GetDescendants() do
   if part:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then part.Anchored=false;part.CanCollide=false;part.CanTouch=false;part.CanQuery=false;part.Massless=true;local weld=Instance.new(&quot;WeldConstraint&quot;);weld.Part0=ball;weld.Part1=part;weld.Parent=part end
  end
  look.Name=&quot;Look&quot;;look.Parent=ball;ball.Transparency=1
  if model:GetAttribute(&quot;KeyObjectFallback&quot;)==true and model:GetAttribute(&quot;KeyObjectKind&quot;)==&quot;ball&quot; then storeSceneCopies(model)
  elseif model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then hideOriginal(model) end
 end
 ball.Parent=workspace;ball:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
 local entry={start=start,onKick=onKick,goals=goals,team=team,teams=teams,swapped=false}
 keepFor(balls,ball,entry)
 if goals then
  function entry.scoresInto(name) return goals[entry.swapped and (name==teams[1] and teams[2] or teams[1]) or name] end
  -- Seats change hands while the match goes on: the players&apos; goals are written again four times a second.
  writeKickGoals(entry)
  task.spawn(function() while ball.Parent do task.wait(.25);writeKickGoals(entry) end end)
 end
 return ball
end
function tools.resetBall(ball)
 if not balls[ball] then error(&quot;tools.resetBall needs a ball made by tools.ball; got &quot;..ball:GetFullName()) end
 ball.CFrame=CFrame.new(balls[ball].start);ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;ball.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
end
-- The teams change ends: every player&apos;s TB_KickGoal at once, before the ball is put back for the kick-off.
function tools.swapGoals(ball)
 local entry=balls[ball]
 if not entry or not entry.goals then error(&quot;tools.swapGoals needs a ball made by tools.ball with goals and team; got &quot;..tostring(ball)) end
 entry.swapped=not entry.swapped
 writeKickGoals(entry)
 recordAction(nil,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;swap goals&quot;)
end
function tools.goalFor(ball,team)
 local entry=balls[ball]
 if not entry or not entry.goals then error(&quot;tools.goalFor needs a ball made by tools.ball with goals and team; got &quot;..tostring(ball)) end
 if not entry.goals[team] then error(&quot;tools.goalFor team must be one of &quot;..table.concat(entry.teams,&quot;, &quot;)..&quot;; got &quot;..tostring(team)) end
 return tools.anchor(entry.scoresInto(team))
end
-- aim: the kicker&apos;s camera look (it nudges the direction a little); seconds: how long the key was held (longer kicks harder).
function tools.kick(actor,ball,aim,seconds)
 local entry=balls[ball]
 if not entry then error(&quot;tools.kick needs a ball made by tools.ball; got &quot;..ball:GetFullName()) end
 if aim~=nil and not finiteVector(aim) then error(&quot;tools.kick aim must be a Vector3 such as the camera&apos;s LookVector; got &quot;..tostring(aim)) end
 local held=seconds==nil and 0 or bounded(seconds,&quot;kick hold seconds&quot;,30)
 local r=root(actor)
 if not r or not living(actor) then return false end
 if ((ball.Position-r.Position)*Vector3.new(1,0,1)).Magnitude-ball.Size.X/2&gt;5 then return false end
 local s=stateFor(actor)
 if os.clock()-(s.kickedAt or -math.huge)&lt;.35 then return false end
 s.kickedAt=os.clock()
 -- A practice opponent (tools.seats) turns to its aim first: the server moves its body, and nothing else turns it.
 if aim and practiceBodies[actor] then r.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(r.Position,r.Position+flatUnit(aim,r.CFrame.LookVector)) end
 local facing=flatUnit(r.CFrame.LookVector,Vector3.new(0,0,-1))
 local view=aim and flatUnit(aim,facing) or facing
 local direction=facing:Dot(view)&gt;0 and (facing+view*.35).Unit or facing
 local speed=35+math.clamp(held/.8,0,1)*55
 ball:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
 ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity=direction*speed+Vector3.new(0,speed*.22,0)
 motion(character(actor),&quot;kick&quot;);playSound(&quot;kick&quot;,ball);recordAction(actor,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;kick&quot;)
 if entry.onKick then entry.onKick(actor,ball) end
 return true
end
-- A ball rolling on the ground slows down (Roblox&apos;s would roll on forever); one that falls out of the world comes back.
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
 for ball,entry in balls do
  if ball.Position.Y&lt;entry.start.Y-60 then tools.resetBall(ball);continue end
  local velocity=ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity
  if math.abs(velocity.Y)&lt;2 then local keep=math.max(0,1-.6*dt);ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(velocity.X*keep,velocity.Y,velocity.Z*keep);ball.AssemblyAngularVelocity*=keep end
 end
end)

-- Hits: an enemy is damaged (flash, sparks, sound, knock-back come with it); another body flashes; a wall sparks.
local function landHit(actor,instance,position,damage)
 local model=humanoidModelOf(instance)
 if model and enemySettings[model] then tools.damageEnemy(model,damage,actor)
 elseif model then hitFeedback(model,actor)
 else emitAt(position,&quot;spark&quot;) end
 if model and actor:IsA(&quot;Player&quot;) then feedbackEvent:FireClient(actor,&quot;hitmarker&quot;) end
end
local function equippedTip(actor)
 local c=character(actor);local tool=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Tool&quot;)
 return tool and tool:FindFirstChild(&quot;TB_Tip&quot;,true)
end
-- Roblox&apos;s own Health script in each player&apos;s body heals 1% a second: round 17 q3&apos;s 5 a shot, 25 a magazine in 12
-- seconds, lost 18 of it again, over 4 minutes to knock a player out. From the first shot, throw or swing no body heals
-- by itself; a game that wants healing writes it. It comes into a new body a moment after the body, hence the wait.
local function dropHealing(body)
 local healing=body:WaitForChild(&quot;Health&quot;,5)
 if healing and healing:IsA(&quot;Script&quot;) then healing:Destroy() end
end
local bodiesHeal=true
local function stopBodiesHealing()
 if not bodiesHeal then return end
 bodiesHeal=false
 local function watch(player)
  player.CharacterAdded:Connect(dropHealing)
  if player.Character then task.spawn(dropHealing,player.Character) end
 end
 for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do watch(player) end
 table.insert(playerJoins,watch)
end
-- What the actor&apos;s own shots and swings pass: their body, and the car or mount they sit on, whole (its wheels and bars
-- are solid, a game&apos;s own horse may be solid all through, and its shell sits in front of a rider&apos;s muzzle).
local function ownBodies(actor)
 local c=character(actor)
 local humanoid=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;)
 local seat=humanoid and humanoid.SeatPart
 return {c,seat and (seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass(&quot;Model&quot;) or seat)}
end
-- The first solid thing on the line, if any; what a player can walk through (grass, zones, water, an open door) is not.
-- A gun reaches about 3.5 studs ahead of the body, so someone by a wall holds the muzzle inside it or beyond it, and a
-- ray from there never meets that wall (11-03 Y6: 5 shots sparked on a single wall, then from 2.9 studs off it 3 hit
-- the player behind). A shot or a throw checks the body to the muzzle first; a blade the body to the target.
local function solidBetween(from,to,ignore)
 local gap=to-from
 if gap.Magnitude&lt;.01 then return nil end
 local cast=RaycastParams.new();cast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;cast.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignore;cast.RespectCanCollide=true;cast.IgnoreWater=true
 return workspace:Raycast(from,gap,cast)
end
function tools.shoot(actor,origin,direction,options)
 local r=root(actor);if not r or not living(actor) or not finiteVector(origin) or not finiteVector(direction) or direction.Magnitude&lt;.001 or (origin-r.Position).Magnitude&gt;10 then return nil,&quot;invalid aim&quot; end
 local s=stateFor(actor);local cooldown=bounded(options.cooldown,&quot;shot cooldown&quot;,10);local range=bounded(options.range,&quot;shot range&quot;,1000);local damage=bounded(options.damage,&quot;shot damage&quot;,10000);local ammo=bounded(options.ammo,&quot;shot ammo&quot;,10000)
 if os.clock()-s.shotAt&lt;cooldown then return nil,&quot;cooldown&quot; end;if s.shots&gt;=ammo then return nil,&quot;empty&quot; end
 s.shots+=1;s.shotAt=os.clock();publish(actor);stopBodiesHealing()
 local tip=equippedTip(actor);local muzzle=tip and tip.WorldPosition or origin
 -- Blocked, the shot lands on the wall: the flash and the streak stay on the shooter&apos;s side of it.
 local own=ownBodies(actor)
 local blocked=solidBetween(r.Position,origin,own)
 if blocked then muzzle=blocked.Position end
 motion(character(actor),&quot;recoil&quot;);playSound(&quot;shoot&quot;,tip and tip.Parent or r);emitAt(muzzle,&quot;muzzle&quot;);recordAction(actor,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;fire&quot;)
 local cast=RaycastParams.new();cast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;cast.FilterDescendantsInstances=own
 local hit=blocked or workspace:Raycast(origin,direction.Unit*range,cast)
 tracer(actor,muzzle,hit and hit.Position or origin+direction.Unit*range,blocked and -direction or direction)
 if hit then landHit(actor,hit.Instance,hit.Position,damage) end
 return hit and hit.Instance,nil
end
function tools.projectile(actor,origin,direction,options,onHit)
 local r=root(actor);if not r or not living(actor) or not finiteVector(origin) or not finiteVector(direction) or direction.Magnitude&lt;.001 or (origin-r.Position).Magnitude&gt;10 then return false end
 local speed=bounded(options.speed,&quot;projectile speed&quot;,300);local range=bounded(options.range,&quot;projectile range&quot;,1000);local damage=bounded(options.damage,&quot;projectile damage&quot;,10000);local cooldown=bounded(options.cooldown,&quot;projectile cooldown&quot;,10)
 if speed&lt;1 then error(&quot;Invalid projectile speed:&quot;..speed) end
 local s=stateFor(actor);if os.clock()-s.thrownAt&lt;cooldown then return false end;s.thrownAt=os.clock();stopBodiesHealing()
 local tip=equippedTip(actor);local position=tip and tip.WorldPosition or origin
 local own=ownBodies(actor)
 local blocked=solidBetween(r.Position,position,own)
 if blocked then
  motion(character(actor),&quot;recoil&quot;);playSound(&quot;swing&quot;,r);recordAction(actor,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;fire&quot;)
  landHit(actor,blocked.Instance,blocked.Position,damage)
  if onHit then onHit(blocked.Instance,blocked.Position) end
  return true
 end
 local ball=Instance.new(&quot;Part&quot;);ball.Name=&quot;TB_Projectile&quot;;ball.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball;ball.Size=Vector3.new(.9,.9,.9);ball.Material=Enum.Material.Neon;ball.Color=Color3.fromRGB(120,220,255);ball.Anchored=true;ball.CanCollide=false;ball.CanTouch=false;ball.CanQuery=false;ball.CastShadow=false
 local top=Instance.new(&quot;Attachment&quot;);top.Position=Vector3.new(0,.3,0);top.Parent=ball
 local bottom=Instance.new(&quot;Attachment&quot;);bottom.Position=Vector3.new(0,-.3,0);bottom.Parent=ball
 local trail=Instance.new(&quot;Trail&quot;);trail.Name=&quot;TB_ProjectileTrail&quot;;trail.Attachment0=top;trail.Attachment1=bottom;trail.Lifetime=.3;trail.LightEmission=1;trail.Color=ColorSequence.new(ball.Color);trail.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(.1,1);trail.Parent=ball
 ball.CFrame=CFrame.new(position);ball.Parent=workspace
 motion(character(actor),&quot;recoil&quot;);playSound(&quot;swing&quot;,ball);recordAction(actor,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;fire&quot;);recordAction(actor,&quot;effect&quot;,&quot;projectile&quot;)
 table.insert(own,ball)
 local cast=RaycastParams.new();cast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;cast.FilterDescendantsInstances=own
 local unit=direction.Unit;local travelled=0
 local flight;flight=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
  local step=math.min(speed*dt,range-travelled)
  local hit=workspace:Raycast(position,unit*step,cast)
  if hit or travelled+step&gt;=range then
   flight:Disconnect();ball:Destroy()
   if hit then landHit(actor,hit.Instance,hit.Position,damage) end
   if onHit then onHit(hit and hit.Instance,hit and hit.Position or position+unit*step) end
   return
  end
  position+=unit*step;travelled+=step;ball.CFrame=CFrame.new(position)
 end)
 return true
end

-- Held tools: a Roblox Tool per id. The client reports the clicked point (ToolUse); the server checks it and acts.
local toolCooldowns={melee=.45,ranged=.12,fishing=.5,throw=.6,hold=.3}
local givenTools,respawnWatched,lastGivenTool={},{},{}
local toolOwners={}
local function toolPart(tool,name,size,color,material,frame)
 local part=Instance.new(&quot;Part&quot;);part.Name=name;part.Size=size;part.Color=color;part.Material=material;part.CFrame=frame;part.CanCollide=false;part.Massless=true;part.Parent=tool
 return part
end
local function attach(part,name,position) local point=Instance.new(&quot;Attachment&quot;);point.Name=name;point.Position=position;point.Parent=part;return point end
local function weldTo(handle,part) if part~=handle then local weld=Instance.new(&quot;WeldConstraint&quot;);weld.Part0=handle;weld.Part1=part;weld.Parent=handle end end
-- Plain stand-ins until a game passes a model: the Handle sits in the hand, the blade/barrel/rod rises from it.
local function plainTool(tool,kind)
 local wood,metal=Color3.fromRGB(120,82,50),Color3.fromRGB(205,212,222)
 local handle,tip
 if kind==&quot;melee&quot; then
  handle=toolPart(tool,&quot;Handle&quot;,Vector3.new(.35,1.2,.35),wood,Enum.Material.Wood,CFrame.new())
  local blade=toolPart(tool,&quot;Blade&quot;,Vector3.new(.2,3.4,.7),metal,Enum.Material.Metal,CFrame.new(0,2.4,0))
  toolPart(tool,&quot;Guard&quot;,Vector3.new(.35,.25,1.4),Color3.fromRGB(214,170,70),Enum.Material.Metal,CFrame.new(0,.7,0))
  tip=attach(blade,&quot;TB_Tip&quot;,Vector3.new(0,1.7,0))
 elseif kind==&quot;ranged&quot; then
  handle=toolPart(tool,&quot;Handle&quot;,Vector3.new(.35,1,.5),Color3.fromRGB(50,52,60),Enum.Material.Metal,CFrame.new())
  local barrel=toolPart(tool,&quot;Barrel&quot;,Vector3.new(.38,.42,2.2),Color3.fromRGB(70,74,84),Enum.Material.Metal,CFrame.new(0,.55,-.75))
  tip=attach(barrel,&quot;TB_Tip&quot;,Vector3.new(0,0,-1.1))
 elseif kind==&quot;fishing&quot; then
  handle=toolPart(tool,&quot;Handle&quot;,Vector3.new(.28,1.4,.28),wood,Enum.Material.Wood,CFrame.new())
  local rod=toolPart(tool,&quot;Rod&quot;,Vector3.new(.14,6,.14),Color3.fromRGB(196,160,104),Enum.Material.Wood,CFrame.new(0,3.6,0))
  tip=attach(rod,&quot;TB_Tip&quot;,Vector3.new(0,3,0))
 elseif kind==&quot;throw&quot; then
  handle=toolPart(tool,&quot;Handle&quot;,Vector3.new(1.1,1.1,1.1),Color3.fromRGB(150,150,150),Enum.Material.Slate,CFrame.new());handle.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
  tip=attach(handle,&quot;TB_Tip&quot;,Vector3.new(0,0,0))
 else
  handle=toolPart(tool,&quot;Handle&quot;,Vector3.new(.8,1,.8),Color3.fromRGB(214,170,70),Enum.Material.Metal,CFrame.new())
  tip=attach(handle,&quot;TB_Tip&quot;,Vector3.new(0,.5,0))
 end
 return handle,tip
end
-- A game&apos;s model: its longest side runs up from the hand (forward for a gun); the hand holds the lower end.
local function modelTool(tool,kind,model)
 local shell=lookOnly(model)
 local frame,size=shell:GetBoundingBox()
 local upright=size.Y&gt;=size.X and size.Y&gt;=size.Z and CFrame.new() or size.X&gt;=size.Z and CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2) or CFrame.Angles(-math.pi/2,0,0)
 local turn=kind==&quot;ranged&quot; and CFrame.Angles(-math.pi/2,0,0)*upright or upright
 local length=math.max(size.X,size.Y,size.Z)
 local grip=(kind==&quot;melee&quot; or kind==&quot;fishing&quot;) and Vector3.new(0,-length*.4,0) or kind==&quot;ranged&quot; and Vector3.new(0,-.3,length*.25) or Vector3.zero
 local handle=toolPart(tool,&quot;Handle&quot;,Vector3.new(.3,.3,.3),Color3.new(),Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,CFrame.new(grip));handle.Transparency=1;handle.CanTouch=false;handle.CanQuery=false
 for _,part in shell:GetDescendants() do
  if part:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then local placed=turn*frame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame);part.Anchored=false;part.CanCollide=false;part.CanTouch=false;part.Massless=true;part.CFrame=placed;part.Parent=tool end
 end
 local far=kind==&quot;ranged&quot; and Vector3.new(0,0,-length/2) or Vector3.new(0,length/2,0)
 return handle,attach(handle,&quot;TB_Tip&quot;,far-grip)
end
local function buildTool(options)
 local tool=Instance.new(&quot;Tool&quot;);tool.Name=options.name or options.id;tool.CanBeDropped=false;tool.RequiresHandle=true
 tool:SetAttribute(&quot;GameplayTool&quot;,options.id);tool:SetAttribute(&quot;GameplayToolKind&quot;,options.kind)
 local handle,tip
 if options.model then handle,tip=modelTool(tool,options.kind,options.model) else handle,tip=plainTool(tool,options.kind) end
 for _,part in tool:GetChildren() do if part:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then weldTo(handle,part) end end
 if options.kind==&quot;fishing&quot; then tool.Grip=CFrame.Angles(math.rad(40),0,0) end
 if options.kind==&quot;melee&quot; then
  local base=attach(handle,&quot;TB_TrailBase&quot;,Vector3.new(0,.6,0))
  local trail=Instance.new(&quot;Trail&quot;);trail.Name=&quot;TB_Trail&quot;;trail.Attachment0=base;trail.Attachment1=tip;trail.Lifetime=.18;trail.MinLength=0;trail.LightEmission=.8;trail.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1));trail.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(.3,1);trail.Enabled=false;trail.Parent=handle
 end
 return tool
end
local function placeTool(player,options)
 for _,holder in {player:FindFirstChild(&quot;Backpack&quot;),player.Character} do
  if holder then for _,item in holder:GetChildren() do if item:IsA(&quot;Tool&quot;) and item:GetAttribute(&quot;GameplayTool&quot;)==options.id then item:Destroy() end end end
 end
 local backpack=player:WaitForChild(&quot;Backpack&quot;,10)
 if not backpack then error(&quot;Player &quot;..player.Name..&quot; has no Backpack for tool &quot;..options.id) end
 local tool=buildTool(options)
 keepFor(toolOwners,tool,{player=player,options=options,usedAt=-math.huge})
 tool.Parent=backpack
 -- 10-29 final q1: a sword a game handed out the moment the character spawned (in CharacterAdded) and that was
 -- taken out at once never swung, for either player, until a respawn gave it again 0.2 s later. It is taken out a
 -- moment later, once the body has settled. The latest explicitly given tool replaces the one in hand.
 task.delay(.25,function()
  local humanoid=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;)
  if tool.Parent==backpack and humanoid and humanoid.Health&gt;0 and lastGivenTool[player]==options then humanoid:EquipTool(tool) end
 end)
 return tool
end
-- What stands within 3.5 studs is hit whichever way the player faces: a small monster at the feet sat just outside the
-- front cone and 28 swings missed it (10-28 final q1). Further off it must be in front, within range. A wall between
-- stops the blade; the other bodies do not (a swing hits a crowd), nor what is lower than the swinger&apos;s waist.
local function meleeTargets(player,range,degrees)
 stopBodiesHealing()
 local body=root(player);local facing=(body.CFrame.LookVector*Vector3.new(1,0,1)).Unit
 local candidates,found={},{}
 for model in enemySettings do table.insert(candidates,model) end
 for _,other in Players:GetPlayers() do if other~=player and other.Character then table.insert(candidates,other.Character) end end
 for model in practiceBodies do table.insert(candidates,model) end
 local bodies=table.clone(candidates)
 for _,own in ownBodies(player) do table.insert(bodies,own) end
 for _,model in candidates do
  local r=model:FindFirstChild(&quot;HumanoidRootPart&quot;);local h=model:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;)
  if r and h and h.Health&gt;0 then
   local offset=(r.Position-body.Position)*Vector3.new(1,0,1)
   local reach=horizontalReach(body.Position,model)
   if reach&lt;=range and (offset.Magnitude&lt;3.5 or facing:Dot(offset.Unit)&gt;=math.cos(math.rad(degrees/2))) then
    -- Level with the swinger or up to a target above, as far as the target&apos;s edge (a big boss&apos;s middle may be behind a pillar).
    local toward=Vector3.new(r.Position.X,math.max(r.Position.Y,body.Position.Y),r.Position.Z)-body.Position
    if reach&lt;=0 or toward.Magnitude&lt;.01 or not solidBetween(body.Position,body.Position+toward.Unit*math.min(reach,toward.Magnitude),bodies) then table.insert(found,model) end
   end
  end
 end
 return found
end
function tools.giveTool(actor,options)
 if not actor:IsA(&quot;Player&quot;) then error(&quot;tools.giveTool needs a player; got &quot;..actor:GetFullName()) end
 if type(options.id)~=&quot;string&quot; or #options.id&gt;40 or not options.id:match(&quot;^[a-z][a-z0-9_%-]*$&quot;) then error(&quot;tools.giveTool id must be the input name such as sword; got &quot;..tostring(options.id)) end
 if not toolCooldowns[options.kind] then error(&quot;tools.giveTool kind must be melee, ranged, fishing, throw or hold; got &quot;..tostring(options.kind)) end
 if options.name~=nil and (type(options.name)~=&quot;string&quot; or #options.name==0 or #options.name&gt;30) then error(&quot;tools.giveTool name must be a short hotbar label; got &quot;..tostring(options.name)) end
 if options.model~=nil and not (typeof(options.model)==&quot;Instance&quot; and (options.model:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;) or options.model:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;))) then error(&quot;tools.giveTool model must be a Model or MeshPart; got &quot;..tostring(options.model)) end
 if options.onUse~=nil and type(options.onUse)~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;tools.giveTool onUse must be a function&quot;) end
 if options.kind~=&quot;hold&quot; and not options.onUse then error(&quot;tools.giveTool &quot;..options.id..&quot; (&quot;..options.kind..&quot;) needs onUse(player,use)&quot;) end
 local frozen=table.freeze(table.clone(options))
 givenTools[actor]=givenTools[actor] or {}
 givenTools[actor][frozen.id]=frozen
 lastGivenTool[actor]=frozen
 -- A respawned player gets their tools back.
 if not respawnWatched[actor] then
  respawnWatched[actor]=true
  actor.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(.2);for _,given in givenTools[actor] or {} do placeTool(actor,given) end end)
 end
 return placeTool(actor,frozen)
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) givenTools[player]=nil;respawnWatched[player]=nil;lastGivenTool[player]=nil end)
toolUseEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,tool,aim)
 local owned=typeof(tool)==&quot;Instance&quot; and toolOwners[tool]
 -- Why a use is turned away goes in the action log (10-29 final q1: thirteen clicks of a sword left no trace, and a
 -- click that never came could not be told from one the server refused).
 local refused=not owned and &quot;unknown tool&quot; or owned.player~=player and &quot;not the owner&apos;s&quot; or tool.Parent~=player.Character and &quot;not in hand&quot; or not finiteVector(aim) and &quot;aim not a point&quot;
 if refused then recordAction(player,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;tool refused: &quot;..refused);return end
 local options=owned.options
 local now=os.clock();if now-owned.usedAt&lt;toolCooldowns[options.kind] then return end;owned.usedAt=now
 local body=root(player);if not body or not living(player) then return end
 local tip=tool:FindFirstChild(&quot;TB_Tip&quot;,true);local origin=tip and tip.WorldPosition or body.Position
 local direction=aim-origin;if direction.Magnitude&lt;.01 then direction=body.CFrame.LookVector end
 -- use is the game&apos;s own table (it may sort or empty use.targets); the toolbox keeps its own list of targets.
 local use={aim=aim,origin=origin,direction=direction.Unit,targets={}}
 local held=player.Character
 if options.kind==&quot;melee&quot; then
  playAction(held,&quot;slash&quot;);playSound(&quot;swing&quot;,tool.Handle);recordAction(player,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;attack&quot;)
  local trail=tool:FindFirstChild(&quot;TB_Trail&quot;,true);if trail then trail.Enabled=true;task.delay(.35,function() trail.Enabled=false end) end
  task.wait(.12)
  local targets=meleeTargets(player,6,90)
  use.targets=table.clone(targets)
  options.onUse(player,use)
  -- Whatever the game did with the targets, a blade that connects shows it.
  for _,model in targets do if os.clock()-(lastHit[model] or -math.huge)&gt;.3 then hitFeedback(model,player) end end
 elseif options.kind==&quot;throw&quot; then motion(held,&quot;throw&quot;);playSound(&quot;swing&quot;,tool.Handle);recordAction(player,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;attack&quot;);options.onUse(player,use)
 elseif options.kind==&quot;hold&quot; then motion(held,&quot;raise&quot;);if options.onUse then options.onUse(player,use) end
 else options.onUse(player,use) end
end)

-- Digging (treasure, ore, trees): a spot dug with its own held tool, hits shared by everyone; dug open it fades, what
-- it hid shows, with a walk-up [E] when asked. First round q4 stuck on all seven bench steps: its own dig wanted E once
-- dug, its instructions said click. One top-level local only: the toolbox nears Luau&apos;s 200 locals in a function.
local resetDigSpots
do
 local spots,digTools={},{}
 local ServerStorage=game:GetService(&quot;ServerStorage&quot;)
 particleStyles.dust={texture=&quot;rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds&quot;,color=Color3.fromRGB(150,112,72),size=1.2,life=.6,speed=7,spread=50,count=14}
 -- A hit counts within 8 studs of the spot&apos;s edge across the ground (the bench swings from 4, a player stands a few
 -- off, [E] shows within 10) and of its top or bottom to the feet, 3 below the root: nobody digs from a balcony.
 local function digDistance(part,from)
  local offset=from-part.Position
  return math.max(Vector3.new(offset.X,0,offset.Z).Magnitude-math.max(part.Size.X,part.Size.Z)/2,math.abs(offset.Y)-part.Size.Y/2-3)
 end
 local function showDug(spot,dug)
  for _,look in spot.looks do
   TweenService:Create(look.item,TweenInfo.new(.4),{Transparency=dug and 1 or look.transparency}):Play()
   if look.item:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then look.item.CanCollide=not dug and look.collide;look.item.CanQuery=not dug and look.query end
  end
 end
 local function openSpot(spot,player)
  local part=spot.part
  spot.dug=true;part:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Dug&quot;,true);showDug(spot,true)
  if spot.reveal then spot.reveal.Parent=spot.revealParent end
  emitAt(part.Position+Vector3.new(0,part.Size.Y/2,0),&quot;celebrate&quot;);playSound(&quot;unlock&quot;,part);recordAction(player,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;dug &quot;..part.Name)
  local ask=spot.ask
  if not ask then toast(player,&quot;Dug it open!&quot;);spot.onDug(player);return end
  -- Pressed once for everyone, as the digging was: onDug runs once a round for each spot.
  local prompt
  prompt=tools.prompt(spot.reveal or part,{action=ask.action,object=ask.object},function(presser)
   if spot.prompt~=prompt then return end
   spot.prompt=nil;prompt:Destroy()
   spot.onDug(presser)
  end)
  spot.prompt=prompt
  toast(player,&quot;Dug it open! Press E to &quot;..ask.action..&quot; &quot;..ask.object)
 end
 -- A tool id has one onUse for all its spots: the nearest one not yet dug within reach takes the hit.
 local function digNearest(player,id)
  local body=root(player);if not body then return end
  local nearest,nearestDistance=nil,8
  for _,spot in spots do
   local distance=spot.toolId==id and not spot.dug and digDistance(spot.part,body.Position)
   if distance and distance&lt;=nearestDistance then nearest,nearestDistance=spot,distance end
  end
  if not nearest then return end
  local part=nearest.part
  nearest.hits+=1;part:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_DigHits&quot;,nearest.hits)
  emitAt(part.Position+Vector3.new(0,part.Size.Y/2,0),&quot;dust&quot;);playSound(&quot;hit&quot;,part);recordAction(player,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;dig &quot;..part.Name..&quot; &quot;..nearest.hits)
  if nearest.hits&gt;=nearest.need then openSpot(nearest,player) else toast(player,&quot;Dig &quot;..nearest.hits..&quot;/&quot;..nearest.need) end
 end
 function tools.dig(target,options,onDug)
  local part=targetPart(target,&quot;tools.dig&quot;)
  if spots[part] then error(&quot;tools.dig called twice for &quot;..part:GetFullName()) end
  if type(options)~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&apos;tools.dig needs options such as {tool={id=&quot;shovel&quot;,name=&quot;Shovel&quot;}}; got &apos;..type(options)) end
  local need=options.hits==nil and 3 or options.hits
  if type(need)~=&quot;number&quot; or need%1~=0 or need&lt;1 or need&gt;20 then error(&quot;tools.dig hits must be a whole number 1..20; got &quot;..tostring(options.hits)) end
  local tool=options.tool
  if type(tool)~=&quot;table&quot; or type(tool.id)~=&quot;string&quot; or #tool.id&gt;40 or not tool.id:match(&quot;^[a-z][a-z0-9_%-]*$&quot;) then error(&apos;tools.dig tool must be {id=&quot;shovel&quot;,name=&quot;Shovel&quot;} with an input name id; got &apos;..(type(tool)==&quot;table&quot; and &quot;id &quot;..tostring(tool.id) or tostring(tool))) end
  if tool.name~=nil and (type(tool.name)~=&quot;string&quot; or #tool.name==0 or #tool.name&gt;30) then error(&quot;tools.dig tool name must be a short hotbar label; got &quot;..tostring(tool.name)) end
  if tool.model~=nil and not (typeof(tool.model)==&quot;Instance&quot; and (tool.model:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;) or tool.model:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;))) then error(&quot;tools.dig tool model must be a Model or MeshPart; got &quot;..tostring(tool.model)) end
  local given=digTools[tool.id]
  if given and (given.name~=tool.name or given.model~=tool.model) then error(&quot;tools.dig tool &quot;..tool.id..&quot; is &quot;..tostring(given.name)..&quot; already: spots with one id share one tool, same name and model; got &quot;..tostring(tool.name)) end
  local reveal=options.reveal and targetObject(options.reveal,&quot;tools.dig reveal&quot;)
  if reveal~=nil and not (typeof(reveal)==&quot;Instance&quot; and (reveal:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) or reveal:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;)) and reveal:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then error(&apos;tools.dig reveal must be a part or model standing in workspace, such as tools.anchor(&quot;chest&quot;); got &apos;..tostring(reveal)) end
  local ask=options.prompt
  if ask~=nil and (type(ask)~=&quot;table&quot; or type(ask.action)~=&quot;string&quot; or #ask.action==0 or #ask.action&gt;40 or type(ask.object)~=&quot;string&quot; or #ask.object==0 or #ask.object&gt;40) then error(&quot;tools.dig prompt must be {action,object}, short texts such as 打开 and 宝箱; got &quot;..(type(ask)==&quot;table&quot; and tostring(ask.action)..&quot;, &quot;..tostring(ask.object) or tostring(ask))) end
  if type(onDug)~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;tools.dig onDug must be a function(player); got &quot;..type(onDug)) end
  local revealParent=reveal and reveal.Parent
  if reveal then reveal.Parent=ServerStorage end
  -- What fades once dug: the spot, its parts, decals and textures (what it hid is away already).
  local looks={}
  local subject=targetObject(target,&quot;tools.dig&quot;)
  local items=subject:GetDescendants();table.insert(items,subject)
  for _,item in items do
   local solid=item:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;)
   if solid or item:IsA(&quot;Decal&quot;) then table.insert(looks,{item=item,transparency=item.Transparency,collide=solid and item.CanCollide,query=solid and item.CanQuery}) end
  end
  keepFor(spots,part,{part=part,toolId=tool.id,need=need,hits=0,dug=false,reveal=reveal,revealParent=revealParent,ask=ask,onDug=onDug,looks=looks})
  part:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_DigHits&quot;,0);part:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Dug&quot;,false)
  if given then
   -- A new crop can mature after the player switched back to a swatter. Re-giving the same id keeps one hotbar tool.
   for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do task.spawn(tools.giveTool,player,given) end
   return
  end
  -- One tool for all spots of this id, to players here and joining; tools.giveTool gives it back on respawn.
  given={id=tool.id,kind=&quot;melee&quot;,name=tool.name,model=tool.model,onUse=function(player) digNearest(player,tool.id) end}
  digTools[tool.id]=given
  for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do task.spawn(tools.giveTool,player,given) end
  table.insert(playerJoins,function(player) tools.giveTool(player,given) end)
 end
 -- Play again: every spot as it was before digging, what it hid back in ServerStorage, its [E] gone.
 resetDigSpots=function()
  for part,spot in spots do
   if spot.dug then showDug(spot,false) end
   spot.hits=0;spot.dug=false;part:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_DigHits&quot;,0);part:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Dug&quot;,false)
   if spot.reveal then spot.reveal.Parent=ServerStorage end
   if spot.prompt then spot.prompt:Destroy();spot.prompt=nil end
  end
 end
end

-- Friendly NPCs: a body on an anchor, name above its head, &quot;[E] 对话 name&quot; opening the dialog box on that player.
function tools.npc(options)
 if type(options.name)~=&quot;string&quot; or #options.name==0 or #options.name&gt;40 then error(&quot;tools.npc name must be short text such as 村民; got &quot;..tostring(options.name)) end
 if type(options.lines)~=&quot;table&quot; or #options.lines&lt;1 or #options.lines&gt;20 then error(&quot;tools.npc lines must be 1..20 texts for &quot;..options.name) end
 for index,line in options.lines do if type(line)~=&quot;string&quot; or #line==0 or #line&gt;300 then error(&quot;tools.npc line &quot;..tostring(index)..&quot; of &quot;..options.name..&quot; must be text up to 300 bytes&quot;) end end
 if options.onTalk~=nil and type(options.onTalk)~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;tools.npc onTalk must be a function&quot;) end
 local spot=targetPart(options.anchor,&quot;tools.npc anchor&quot;)
 local lines=table.freeze(table.clone(options.lines))
 local model,humanoid,body=buildBody(options.look,options.name)
 model:SetAttribute(&quot;GameplayNPC&quot;,true);model:SetAttribute(&quot;GameplayPurpose&quot;,&quot;Friendly NPC: talk&quot;);CollectionService:AddTag(model,&quot;GameplayNPC&quot;)
 -- It stands still on its spot: anchored, with no physics states (an anchored walker reads as falling down).
 body.Anchored=true;humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine=false
 model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(spot.Position)*spot.CFrame.Rotation)
 local frame,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
 model:PivotTo(model:GetPivot()+Vector3.new(0,spot.Position.Y+spot.Size.Y/2-(frame.Position.Y-size.Y/2),0))
 model.Parent=workspace
 if options.look.kind==&quot;humanoid&quot; then animateWalker(model,options.look.animation) end
 nameplate(model,options.name,false)
 tools.prompt(model,{action=&quot;Talk to&quot;,object=options.name},function(player)
  local r=root(player);if r then body.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(body.Position,Vector3.new(r.Position.X,body.Position.Y,r.Position.Z)) end
  recordAction(player,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;talk &quot;..options.name)
  feedbackEvent:FireClient(player,&quot;dialog&quot;,options.name,lines)
  if options.onTalk then options.onTalk(player) end
 end)
 return model
end

-- Pickups spin, bob and glow on every client; walking into one takes it 10 times a second, well within half a second.
local pickups={}
function tools.pickup(options,onPickup)
 local part=targetPart(options.anchor,&quot;tools.pickup anchor&quot;)
 if pickups[part] then error(&quot;tools.pickup called twice for &quot;..part:GetFullName()) end
 local value=bounded(options.value,&quot;pickup value&quot;,100000)
 if options.kind~=&quot;coin&quot; and options.kind~=&quot;item&quot; then error(&apos;tools.pickup kind must be &quot;coin&quot; or &quot;item&quot;; got &apos;..tostring(options.kind)) end
 if options.shared~=nil and type(options.shared)~=&quot;boolean&quot; then error(&quot;tools.pickup shared must be true or false; got &quot;..tostring(options.shared)) end
 if onPickup~=nil and type(onPickup)~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;tools.pickup onPickup must be a function&quot;) end
 local subject=targetObject(options.anchor,&quot;tools.pickup anchor&quot;)
 if subject:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;) and not part:FindFirstChild(&quot;GameplayAnchorModel&quot;) then
  local link=Instance.new(&quot;ObjectValue&quot;);link.Name=&quot;GameplayAnchorModel&quot;;link.Value=subject;link.Parent=part
 end
 local looks={}
 for _,item in {subject,table.unpack(subject:GetDescendants())} do
  if item:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then
   item.Anchored=true;item.CanCollide=false;item.CanTouch=false
   table.insert(looks,{part=item,transparency=item.Transparency})
  end
 end
 local glow=Instance.new(&quot;PointLight&quot;);glow.Name=&quot;TB_PickupGlow&quot;;glow.Brightness=1.5;glow.Range=9;glow.Color=options.kind==&quot;coin&quot; and Color3.fromRGB(255,214,90) or Color3.fromRGB(150,220,255);glow.Parent=part
 part:SetAttribute(&quot;GameplayPickup&quot;,options.kind);CollectionService:AddTag(part,&quot;GameplayPickup&quot;)
 pickups[part]={value=value,kind=options.kind,shared=options.shared==true,onPickup=onPickup,takenBy={},standingOn={},refusedAt={},looks=looks}
end
local function pickupReach(part) return math.max(part.Size.X,part.Size.Y,part.Size.Z)/2+2.5 end
-- Measured to the nearest point of the body, from the feet 3 studs below the root to 2 above it, not to the root: a
-- player standing on a step beside a coin, or over one half sunk in the grass, has it at their feet (10-28 q11).
local function pickupDistance(r,part)
 local p=part.Position
 return (Vector3.new(r.Position.X,math.clamp(p.Y,r.Position.Y-3,r.Position.Y+2),r.Position.Z)-p).Magnitude
end
local function bringPickupsBack()
 for part,pickup in pickups do
  table.clear(pickup.takenBy);table.clear(pickup.standingOn);table.clear(pickup.refusedAt)
  for _,look in pickup.looks do look.part.Transparency=look.transparency end
  -- Whoever stands on a pickup as it comes back steps off first: a new round does not start with a free coin.
  for _,actor in tools.actors() do local r=root(actor);if r and pickupDistance(r,part)&lt;=pickupReach(part) then pickup.standingOn[actor]=true end end
 end
 feedbackEvent:FireAllClients(&quot;pickups-back&quot;)
end
function tools.resetPickups() bringPickupsBack() end
local pickupClock=0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
 pickupClock+=dt;if pickupClock&lt;.1 then return end;pickupClock=0
 for part,pickup in pickups do
  -- Out of the scene is out of reach: a gem tools.dig keeps in ServerStorage until dug stands where it was buried.
  if not part:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or pickup.takenBy.everyone then continue end
  local reach=pickupReach(part)
  for _,actor in tools.actors() do
   local r=root(actor)
   local near=r and pickupDistance(r,part)&lt;=reach
   if pickup.standingOn[actor] and not near then pickup.standingOn[actor]=nil end
   if near and living(actor) and not pickup.takenBy[actor] and not pickup.standingOn[actor] and os.clock()-(pickup.refusedAt[actor] or -math.huge)&gt;=1 then
    -- The game may refuse it for now by returning false (10-28 q10: the key before its crate was broken, which a
    -- player walking by used to take for nothing): it stays where it is and is asked again a second later.
    if pickup.onPickup and pickup.onPickup(actor,pickup.value)==false then pickup.refusedAt[actor]=os.clock();continue end
    if pickup.shared then pickup.takenBy.everyone=true;for _,look in pickup.looks do look.part.Transparency=1 end else pickup.takenBy[actor]=true end
    recordAction(actor,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;pickup &quot;..(part:GetAttribute(&quot;GameplayAnchor&quot;) or part.Name))
    feedbackEvent:FireAllClients(&quot;pickup&quot;,part,pickup.value,pickup.kind,actor:IsA(&quot;Player&quot;) and actor.UserId or 0,pickup.shared)
    if pickup.shared then break end
   end
  end
 end
end)

-- Saves (SPEC 8.2): each player&apos;s values live in this server&apos;s memory and, in a published game, under one DataStore
-- key per player. An unpublished file (Studio Play) cannot use DataStores, and a published game may fail to read one:
-- then the values last for this session only and the player is told so once, never silently.
local DataStoreService=game:GetService(&quot;DataStoreService&quot;)
local saveStore=game.PlaceId~=0 and DataStoreService:GetDataStore(&quot;GameplaySaves&quot;) or nil
local saves,saveNotices={},{}
local function saveNotice(player,text)
 if saveNotices[player] then return end
 saveNotices[player]=true
 warn(&quot;[GameplayToolbox] &quot;..player.Name..&quot;: &quot;..text)
 feedbackEvent:FireClient(player,&quot;save-notice&quot;,text)
end
local function saveSlot(actor)
 if saves[actor] then return saves[actor] end
 local slot={values={},loaded=false,durable=false,dirty=false}
 keepFor(saves,actor,slot)
 if not actor:IsA(&quot;Player&quot;) or not saveStore then slot.loaded=true;return slot end
 task.spawn(function()
  local ok,stored=pcall(function() return saveStore:GetAsync(&quot;player_&quot;..actor.UserId) end)
  if ok then
   if type(stored)==&quot;table&quot; then slot.values=stored end
   slot.durable=true
  else slot.failure=tostring(stored) end
  slot.loaded=true
 end)
 return slot
end
for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do saveSlot(player) end
table.insert(playerJoins,saveSlot)
local function readySlot(actor)
 local slot=saveSlot(actor)
 while not slot.loaded do task.wait(.05) end
 -- A slot whose read failed is never written: that would overwrite the player&apos;s real progress.
 if actor:IsA(&quot;Player&quot;) and not slot.durable then
  saveNotice(actor,slot.failure and &quot;Could not load your save (&quot;..slot.failure..&quot;): progress in this round will not be kept&quot; or &quot;Saves last only this round: publish to Roblox to keep them&quot;)
 end
 return slot
end
local function checkSaveKey(key,name)
 if type(key)~=&quot;string&quot; or #key==0 or #key&gt;50 or not key:match(&quot;^[%w_]+$&quot;) then error(name..&quot; key must be 1..50 letters, digits or _; got &quot;..tostring(key)) end
end
local function copySaved(value,path,depth)
 local kind=type(value)
 if kind==&quot;number&quot; then if value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then error(&quot;tools.save value &quot;..path..&quot; must be a finite number&quot;) end;return value end
 if kind==&quot;string&quot; then if #value&gt;10000 then error(&quot;tools.save value &quot;..path..&quot; is longer than 10000 bytes&quot;) end;return value end
 if kind==&quot;boolean&quot; or kind==&quot;nil&quot; then return value end
 if kind~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&quot;tools.save value &quot;..path..&quot; must be a number, text, true/false or a table of them; got &quot;..typeof(value)) end
 if depth&gt;4 then error(&quot;tools.save value &quot;..path..&quot; nests more than 4 tables&quot;) end
 local copy={}
 for key,item in value do
  if type(key)~=&quot;string&quot; and type(key)~=&quot;number&quot; then error(&quot;tools.save value &quot;..path..&quot; has a &quot;..typeof(key)..&quot; key&quot;) end
  copy[key]=copySaved(item,path..&quot;.&quot;..tostring(key),depth+1)
 end
 return copy
end
function tools.save(actor,key,value)
 checkSaveKey(key,&quot;tools.save&quot;)
 local copy=copySaved(value,key,1)
 local slot=readySlot(actor)
 slot.values[key]=copy;slot.dirty=slot.durable
 recordAction(actor,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;save &quot;..key)
end
function tools.load(actor,key)
 checkSaveKey(key,&quot;tools.load&quot;)
 return copySaved(readySlot(actor).values[key],key,1)
end
local function writeSave(player)
 local slot=saves[player]
 if not slot or not slot.dirty then return end
 slot.dirty=false
 local ok,failure=pcall(function() saveStore:SetAsync(&quot;player_&quot;..player.UserId,slot.values) end)
 if not ok then
  slot.dirty=true
