  warn(&quot;[GameplayToolbox] saving &quot;..player.Name..&quot; failed, retrying: &quot;..tostring(failure))
  if not slot.writeTold then slot.writeTold=true;feedbackEvent:FireClient(player,&quot;save-notice&quot;,&quot;Could not save yet (&quot;..tostring(failure)..&quot;): will try again soon&quot;) end
 end
end
if saveStore then
 task.spawn(function() while true do task.wait(8);for actor in saves do if actor:IsA(&quot;Player&quot;) then writeSave(actor) end end end end)
 game:BindToClose(function() for actor in saves do if actor:IsA(&quot;Player&quot;) then writeSave(actor) end end end)
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) if saveStore then writeSave(player) end;saves[player]=nil;saveNotices[player]=nil end)

-- Levels (SPEC 8.3): areas of the one map, each starting at an anchor. Finishing one unlocks the next; the level bar
-- (top right) takes a player to any unlocked level; progress is saved, so a player comes back to where they were.
local levelList,levelNames,levelEnter
local levelStates={}
local levelEvent=Instance.new(&quot;RemoteEvent&quot;);levelEvent.Name=&quot;Level&quot;;levelEvent.Parent=folder
local function levelState(actor)
 if not levelList then error(&quot;Call tools.levels first&quot;) end
 if not levelStates[actor] then keepFor(levelStates,actor,{current=1,unlocked=1}) end
 return levelStates[actor]
end
local function publishLevel(actor)
 local s=levelState(actor)
 actor:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_CurrentLevel&quot;,s.current);actor:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_UnlockedLevel&quot;,s.unlocked)
end
local function saveLevels(actor)
 local s=levelState(actor)
 tools.save(actor,&quot;TB_levels&quot;,{current=s.current,unlocked=s.unlocked})
 actor:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_SavedLevel&quot;,tools.load(actor,&quot;TB_levels&quot;).unlocked)
end
local function placeAtLevel(actor,n)
 local body=character(actor)
 if not body then return end
 local humanoid=body:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;);if humanoid then humanoid.Sit=false end
 local start=targetPart(levelList[n].anchor,&quot;tools.levels anchor&quot;)
 local at=start.Position+Vector3.new(0,start.Size.Y/2+3,0)
 body:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(at,at+flatUnit(start.CFrame.LookVector,Vector3.new(0,0,-1))))
end
function tools.levels(list,onEnter)
 if levelList then error(&quot;tools.levels called twice&quot;) end
 if #list&lt;2 or #list&gt;20 then error(&quot;tools.levels needs 2..20 levels such as {anchor=\&quot;level1_start\&quot;,name=\&quot;第1关\&quot;}; got &quot;..#list) end
 local names={}
 for index,level in list do
  if type(level)~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&quot;tools.levels level &quot;..index..&quot; must be {anchor=...,name=...}; got &quot;..typeof(level)) end
  targetPart(level.anchor,&quot;tools.levels anchor&quot;)
  if level.name~=nil and (type(level.name)~=&quot;string&quot; or #level.name==0 or #level.name&gt;60 or level.name:find(&quot;\n&quot;)) then error(&quot;tools.levels level &quot;..index..&quot; name must be one line up to 60 bytes; got &quot;..tostring(level.name)) end
  names[index]=level.name or &quot;Level &quot;..index
 end
 levelList,levelNames,levelEnter=table.clone(list),names,onEnter
 folder:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_LevelNames&quot;,table.concat(names,&quot;\n&quot;))
 -- Everyone starts on level 1; saved progress, once read, brings a player back to the level they were on.
 local function join(player)
  publishLevel(player)
  -- A respawn (Roblox&apos;s spawn, or a parkour checkpoint) that lands in another level&apos;s area goes back to the start of
  -- the player&apos;s level; a checkpoint inside their own level is kept.
  player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(body)
   if not body:WaitForChild(&quot;HumanoidRootPart&quot;,10) then return end
   RunService.Heartbeat:Wait();RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
   local s=levelState(player);local at=body:GetPivot().Position
   local nearest,best=1,math.huge
   for index,level in levelList do local gap=((targetPart(level.anchor,&quot;tools.levels anchor&quot;).Position-at)*Vector3.new(1,0,1)).Magnitude;if gap&lt;best then nearest,best=index,gap end end
   if nearest~=s.current then placeAtLevel(player,s.current) end
  end)
  task.spawn(function()
   local saved=tools.load(player,&quot;TB_levels&quot;)
   local s=levelState(player)
   if type(saved)==&quot;table&quot; and type(saved.unlocked)==&quot;number&quot; and type(saved.current)==&quot;number&quot; then
    s.unlocked=math.clamp(math.floor(saved.unlocked),1,#levelList);s.current=math.clamp(math.floor(saved.current),1,s.unlocked)
    player:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_SavedLevel&quot;,s.unlocked)
   end
   publishLevel(player)
   if s.current&gt;1 then placeAtLevel(player,s.current) end
   if levelEnter then levelEnter(player,s.current) end
  end)
 end
 for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do join(player) end
 table.insert(playerJoins,join)
end
function tools.currentLevel(actor) return levelState(actor).current end
function tools.goToLevel(actor,n)
 local s=levelState(actor)
 if n%1~=0 or n&lt;1 or n&gt;#levelList then error(&quot;tools.goToLevel level must be 1..&quot;..#levelList..&quot;; got &quot;..tostring(n)) end
 if n&gt;s.unlocked then error(&quot;Level &quot;..n..&quot; is still locked for &quot;..actor.Name..&quot; (unlocked up to &quot;..s.unlocked..&quot;); tools.completeLevel unlocks the next one&quot;) end
 s.current=n;publishLevel(actor);placeAtLevel(actor,n)
 recordAction(actor,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;level &quot;..n)
 toast(actor,&quot;Entering &quot;..levelNames[n])
 task.spawn(saveLevels,actor)
 if levelEnter then levelEnter(actor,n) end
end
function tools.completeLevel(actor)
 local s=levelState(actor)
 local finished=s.current
 local nextLevel=finished&lt;#levelList and finished+1 or nil
 if nextLevel and nextLevel&gt;s.unlocked then s.unlocked=nextLevel end
 publishLevel(actor)
 local body=root(actor)
 if body then playSound(&quot;level_up&quot;,body);emitAt(body.Position,&quot;celebrate&quot;) end
 recordAction(actor,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;level-complete &quot;..finished)
 toast(actor,levelNames[finished]..&quot; complete!&quot;..(nextLevel and &quot; &quot;..levelNames[nextLevel]..&quot; unlocked&quot; or &quot;&quot;))
 task.spawn(saveLevels,actor)
 return nextLevel
end
levelEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,n)
 if not levelList or type(n)~=&quot;number&quot; or n%1~=0 or n&lt;1 or n&gt;#levelList then error(&quot;Invalid level choice from &quot;..player.Name..&quot;: &quot;..tostring(n)) end
 if n&gt;levelState(player).unlocked then toast(player,levelNames[n]..&quot; is locked: finish &quot;..levelNames[n-1]..&quot; first&quot;);return end
 tools.goToLevel(player,n)
end)


function tools.onInput(callback)
 if type(callback)~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;Input callback required&quot;) end
 -- One listener runs every callback in order (a press is filled only after all of them); disconnecting the
 -- returned connection stops this one.
 local event=Instance.new(&quot;BindableEvent&quot;)
 local connection=event.Event:Connect(function() end)
 table.insert(inputCallbacks,{callback=callback,connection=connection,event=event})
 return connection
end
local function fillKeyPress(actor)
 motion(character(actor),&quot;reach&quot;)
 local body=root(actor)
 if body then playSound(&quot;reach&quot;,body) end
end
actionEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(actor,name,target,value)
 if type(name)~=&quot;string&quot; or #name&gt;100 then error(&quot;Invalid client gameplay input name: &quot;..tostring(name)) end
 -- ui.bindAction names its action as the key goes down, before the game&apos;s own send for that press.
 if name:sub(1,7)==&quot;TB_key:&quot; then keyPresses[actor]=name:sub(8);return end
 if (target~=nil and not finiteVector(target)) or (value~=nil and (type(value)~=&quot;number&quot; or value~=value or math.abs(value)&gt;10000)) then error(&quot;Invalid client gameplay input for &quot;..name) end
 local now=os.clock();if now-(cooldowns[actor] or -math.huge)&lt;.03 then return end;cooldowns[actor]=now
 -- The press is used up by its first input: one fill at most.
 local pressed=keyPresses[actor]==name
 if pressed then keyPresses[actor]=nil end
 pressAnswers[actor]=false
 for _,entry in table.clone(inputCallbacks) do if entry.connection.Connected then entry.callback(actor,name,target,value) end end
 local answered=pressAnswers[actor]
 pressAnswers[actor]=nil
 if pressed and not answered then fillKeyPress(actor) end
end)

-- once=true prompts each player has used (opened that chest, took that key): hidden for that player alone until Play
-- again; everyone else can still use them.
local usedPrompts={}
-- Prompts with a ready condition (a fuse box that needs two fuses): ready(player) answers true, or false and what the
-- player still misses. The prompt stays on for everyone; its label shows each player near it what they miss, and a
-- press before then only says so (11-01 q17 turned its prompts off at the start and never on again).
local readyPrompts={}
local function promptMissing(ready,player,object)
 local ok,missing=ready(player)
 if ok==true then return nil end
 if ok~=false then error(&quot;tools.prompt ready for &quot;..object..&quot; must return true, or false and what is missing; got &quot;..tostring(ok)) end
 if type(missing)~=&quot;string&quot; or #missing==0 or #missing&gt;80 then error(&quot;tools.prompt ready for &quot;..object..&quot; returned false without saying what is missing (such as 还差 1 根保险丝); got &quot;..tostring(missing)) end
 return missing
end
local function refreshReadyPrompts()
 while true do
  task.wait(.5)
  for prompt,entry in readyPrompts do
   -- A prompt out of the scene (a sold-out shop, an area not open yet) is in ServerStorage, which no player has: a
   -- label sent then reaches the client as nil. Its labels are sent again once it is back.
   if prompt:FindFirstAncestorOfClass(&quot;ServerStorage&quot;) then table.clear(entry.shown);continue end
   for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do
    local r=root(player)
    local missing=r and (r.Position-entry.part.Position).Magnitude&lt;=16 and promptMissing(entry.ready,player,entry.object) or nil
    if entry.shown[player]~=missing then entry.shown[player]=missing;feedbackEvent:FireClient(player,&quot;prompt-ready&quot;,prompt,missing) end
   end
  end
 end
end
function tools.prompt(target,options,callback)
 local part=target:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;) and (target.PrimaryPart or target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;,true)) or target
 if not part or not part:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then error(&quot;tools.prompt needs a BasePart or a Model with parts: &quot;..target:GetFullName()) end
 if type(options.action)~=&quot;string&quot; or #options.action==0 or #options.action&gt;40 then error(&quot;tools.prompt action must be short text such as 打开; got &quot;..tostring(options.action)) end
 if type(options.object)~=&quot;string&quot; or #options.object==0 or #options.object&gt;40 then error(&quot;tools.prompt object must be short text such as 宝箱; got &quot;..tostring(options.object)) end
 local hold=bounded(options.hold or 0,&quot;prompt hold seconds&quot;,5)
 if options.once~=nil and type(options.once)~=&quot;boolean&quot; then error(&quot;tools.prompt once must be true or false; got &quot;..tostring(options.once)) end
 if options.ready~=nil and type(options.ready)~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;tools.prompt ready must be a function(player) returning true, or false and what is missing; got &quot;..type(options.ready)) end
 local prompt=Instance.new(&quot;ProximityPrompt&quot;);prompt.Name=&quot;GameplayPrompt&quot;;prompt.ActionText=options.action;prompt.ObjectText=options.object;prompt.KeyboardKeyCode=Enum.KeyCode.E;prompt.MaxActivationDistance=10;prompt.RequiresLineOfSight=false;prompt.HoldDuration=hold;prompt.Parent=part
 if options.ready then
  if next(readyPrompts)==nil then task.spawn(refreshReadyPrompts) end
  keepFor(readyPrompts,prompt,{ready=options.ready,object=options.object,part=part,shown={}})
 end
 prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
  -- The reach is played here first: a callback that destroys its own prompt (tools.dig&apos;s chest, 11-03 small level)
  -- left the press without the reach the prompt service plays below. motion skips the second one.
  if player.Character then motion(player.Character,&quot;reach&quot;) end
  local r=root(player)
  if not (r and living(player) and (r.Position-part.Position).Magnitude&lt;=12) then return end
  if options.ready then
   local missing=promptMissing(options.ready,player,options.object)
   if missing then toast(player,missing);recordAction(player,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;prompt not ready: &quot;..options.object);return end
  end
  if options.once then
   if not usedPrompts[player] then keepFor(usedPrompts,player,{}) end
   if usedPrompts[player][prompt] then return end
   usedPrompts[player][prompt]=true
   feedbackEvent:FireClient(player,&quot;prompt-used&quot;,prompt)
  end
  callback(player)
 end)
 return prompt
end
-- Any walk-up prompt: the player reaches out as they press it.
ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(_,player) if player.Character then motion(player.Character,&quot;reach&quot;) end end)
-- Doors: every part of a door opens and shuts together, see-through, walk-through, touch-through and ray-through when
-- open and back as it was when shut, with the door sound (11-01 q10 left an open door touchable and the runtime
-- stopped the game; q17 turned its prompts off and never on). The door carries TB_DoorOpen, a timed one also
-- TB_DoorChangesAt (server time of its next change), and the tag GameplayDoor, for the test bench.
local doors={}
-- The tools register actual parts, not names containing words such as &quot;platform&quot; or &quot;ground&quot;.
local courseParts=setmetatable({},{__mode=&quot;k&quot;})
local function registerCourseParts(target)
 if target:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then courseParts[target]=true end
 for _,part in target:GetDescendants() do if part:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then courseParts[part]=true end end
end
local function setDoor(door,open)
 if door.open==open then return end
 door.open=open
 for _,entry in door.parts do
  local part=entry.part
  part.CanCollide=not open and entry.collide;part.CanTouch=not open and entry.touch;part.CanQuery=not open and entry.query
  TweenService:Create(part,TweenInfo.new(.35),{Transparency=open and math.max(entry.transparency,.85) or entry.transparency}):Play()
 end
 door.target:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_DoorOpen&quot;,open)
 if open then playSound(&quot;door_open&quot;,door.parts[1].part) end
 recordAction(nil,&quot;event&quot;,(open and &quot;door open &quot; or &quot;door shut &quot;)..door.target.Name)
end
function tools.door(target,options,onOpen)
 local door=targetObject(target,&quot;tools.door&quot;)
 if typeof(door)~=&quot;Instance&quot; or not (door:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) or door:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;)) then error(&quot;tools.door needs an anchor name, a BasePart or a Model; got &quot;..tostring(target)) end
 if doors[door] then error(&quot;tools.door called twice for &quot;..door:GetFullName()) end
 if type(options)~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&apos;tools.door needs options such as {mode=&quot;prompt&quot;}; got &apos;..type(options)) end
 local mode=options.mode
 if mode~=&quot;prompt&quot; and mode~=&quot;timed&quot; and mode~=&quot;script&quot; then error(&apos;tools.door mode must be &quot;prompt&quot;, &quot;timed&quot; or &quot;script&quot;; got &apos;..tostring(mode)) end
 if mode~=&quot;prompt&quot; and onOpen~=nil then error(&quot;tools.door &quot;..mode..&quot; opens without a player: onOpen is only for prompt doors&quot;) end
 if onOpen~=nil and type(onOpen)~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;tools.door onOpen must be a function(player); got &quot;..type(onOpen)) end
 local parts={}
 local function keepPart(part) if part:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then table.insert(parts,{part=part,collide=part.CanCollide,touch=part.CanTouch,query=part.CanQuery,transparency=part.Transparency}) end end
 keepPart(door);for _,part in door:GetDescendants() do keepPart(part) end
 for _,part in mountedOn[door:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_AnchorId&quot;) or door:GetAttribute(&quot;GameplayAnchor&quot;) or &quot;&quot;] or {} do keepPart(part) end
 if #parts==0 then error(&quot;tools.door &quot;..door:GetFullName()..&quot; has no parts&quot;) end
 local entry={target=door,parts=parts,open=false,mode=mode}
 keepFor(doors,door,entry)
 door:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_DoorOpen&quot;,false);CollectionService:AddTag(door,&quot;GameplayDoor&quot;)
 if mode==&quot;prompt&quot; then
  local at=options.lever==nil and door or type(options.lever)==&quot;string&quot; and tools.anchor(options.lever) or options.lever
  if typeof(at)~=&quot;Instance&quot; or not (at:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) or at:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;)) then error(&quot;tools.door lever must be an anchor name, a BasePart or a Model; got &quot;..tostring(options.lever)) end
  tools.prompt(at,{action=options.action or &quot;Open&quot;,object=options.object or &quot;Door&quot;,hold=options.hold,ready=options.ready},function(player)
   setDoor(entry,true)
   if onOpen then onOpen(player) end
  end)
 elseif mode==&quot;timed&quot; then
  local openSeconds=bounded(options.openSeconds,&quot;door openSeconds&quot;,120);local closeSeconds=bounded(options.closeSeconds,&quot;door closeSeconds&quot;,120)
  if openSeconds&lt;1 or closeSeconds&lt;1 then error(&quot;tools.door timed openSeconds and closeSeconds must be 1..120; got &quot;..openSeconds..&quot;, &quot;..closeSeconds) end
  task.spawn(function()
   while door.Parent do
    door:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_DoorChangesAt&quot;,workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+closeSeconds);task.wait(closeSeconds)
    setDoor(entry,true)
    door:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_DoorChangesAt&quot;,workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+openSeconds);task.wait(openSeconds)
    setDoor(entry,false)
   end
  end)
 end
 return table.freeze({open=function() setDoor(entry,true) end,close=function() setDoor(entry,false) end,isOpen=function() return entry.open end})
end
-- Movers and hazards. A mover&apos;s parts stay anchored and are set every frame with their velocity, by which Roblox
-- carries a body standing on them (as the parkour runtime&apos;s movers); the server moves no player (q20&apos;s turntable did,
-- every frame). A hazard hurts once an interval (q3, q4, q8 and q11 hurt every frame); rising lava grows with its
-- bottom kept (q18). State on the main part, as a timed door&apos;s, for the test bench. A block: Luau allows 200 locals.
local resetMoversAndHazards
do
 local movers,hazards={},{}
 local function inRange(value,low,high) return type(value)==&quot;number&quot; and value&gt;=low and value&lt;=high end
 local function partsOf(target,name)
  local found=targetObject(target,name)
  if typeof(found)~=&quot;Instance&quot; or not (found:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) or found:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;)) then error(name..&quot; needs an anchor name, a BasePart or a Model; got &quot;..tostring(target)) end
  local parts=found:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) and {found} or {}
  for _,part in found:GetDescendants() do if part:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then table.insert(parts,part) end end
  if #parts==0 then error(name..&quot; &quot;..found:GetFullName()..&quot; has no parts&quot;) end
  return found,parts,found:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;) and found.PrimaryPart or parts[1]
 end
 -- A trip: rest, go, rest, come back, eased so a rider is not thrown: how far along (0..1), how fast, state, its end.
 local function tripPhase(m,t)
  local half,pause,names=m.period/2,m.pause,m.states
  local a=(t-pause)/half
  if t&lt;pause then return 0,0,names[1],pause end
  if a&lt;1 then return (1-math.cos(math.pi*a))/2,math.pi/half/2*math.sin(math.pi*a),names[2],pause+half end
  a=(t-2*pause-half)/half
  if a&lt;0 then return 1,0,names[3],2*pause+half end
  return (1+math.cos(math.pi*a))/2,-math.pi/half/2*math.sin(math.pi*a),names[4],2*pause+2*half
 end
 local function alongRoute(route,distance)
  for i=1,#route-1 do
   local leg=route[i+1]-route[i]
   if distance&lt;=leg.Magnitude or i==#route-1 then
    local direction=leg.Magnitude&gt;0 and leg/leg.Magnitude or Vector3.zero
    return route[i]+direction*math.min(distance,leg.Magnitude),direction
   end
   distance-=leg.Magnitude
  end
 end
 local function placeMover(m,now)
  local elapsed,turn=now-m.started,m.turn
  local frame,velocity,state,changesAt
  if turn then
   -- About the upright line through its pivot: a cylinder tools.part stood up has its own Y axis lying flat.
   frame=CFrame.new(m.axis)*CFrame.Angles(0,(turn*elapsed)%(2*math.pi),0)*CFrame.new(-m.axis);state=&quot;turning&quot;
  else
   local cycle=m.period+2*m.pause
   local trips=math.floor(elapsed/cycle)
   local along,rate,ends
   along,rate,state,ends=tripPhase(m,elapsed-trips*cycle)
   local at,direction=alongRoute(m.route,along*m.length)
   frame=CFrame.new(at-m.route[1]);velocity=direction*rate*m.length;changesAt=m.started+trips*cycle+ends
  end
  m.target:PivotTo(frame*m.pivot)
  for _,part in m.parts do
   if turn then local r=part.Position-m.axis;part.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(turn*r.Z,0,-turn*r.X);part.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.new(0,turn,0)
   else part.AssemblyLinearVelocity=velocity end
  end
  if state~=m.state or changesAt~=m.changesAt then
   m.state,m.changesAt=state,changesAt
   m.main:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_MoverState&quot;,state);m.main:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_MoverChangesAt&quot;,changesAt)
  end
 end
 function tools.mover(target,options)
  local found,parts,main=partsOf(target,&quot;tools.mover&quot;)
  if movers[found] then error(&quot;tools.mover called twice for &quot;..found:GetFullName()) end
  if type(options)~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&quot;tools.mover needs options such as {rotate=90}; got &quot;..type(options)) end
  local kinds={}
  for _,kind in {&quot;path&quot;,&quot;rotate&quot;,&quot;sink&quot;} do if options[kind]~=nil then table.insert(kinds,kind) end end
  if #kinds~=1 then error(&quot;tools.mover needs exactly one of path, rotate or sink; got &quot;..(#kinds==0 and &quot;none&quot; or table.concat(kinds,&quot; and &quot;))) end
  local pivot=found:GetPivot()
  local m={target=found,parts=parts,main=main,pivot=pivot,axis=pivot.Position,started=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()}
  local rotate,period,pause,sink,path=options.rotate,options.period,options.pause or 0,options.sink,options.path
  if rotate~=nil then
   if type(rotate)~=&quot;number&quot; or not inRange(math.abs(rotate),.001,720) then error(&quot;tools.mover rotate must be degrees a second, -720..720, not 0; got &quot;..tostring(rotate)) end
   if period~=nil or options.pause~=nil then error(&quot;tools.mover rotate takes no period or pause&quot;) end
   m.turn=math.rad(rotate)
  else
   if not inRange(period,1,600) then error(&quot;tools.mover period must be 1..600 seconds (one trip there and back); got &quot;..tostring(period)) end
   if not inRange(pause,0,60) then error(&quot;tools.mover pause must be 0..60 seconds; got &quot;..tostring(pause)) end
   local route={pivot.Position}
   if sink==nil then
    if type(path)~=&quot;table&quot; or #path&lt;1 or #path&gt;20 then error(&quot;tools.mover path must be 1..20 points; got &quot;..tostring(path)) end
    for i,point in path do
     local spot=point
     if type(spot)==&quot;string&quot; or typeof(spot)==&quot;Instance&quot; then spot=targetPart(spot,&quot;tools.mover path point &quot;..i).Position end
     if not finiteVector(spot) then error(&quot;tools.mover path point &quot;..i..&quot; must be a Vector3, an anchor name, a BasePart or a Model with parts; got &quot;..tostring(point)) end
     table.insert(route,spot)
    end
    m.states={&quot;start&quot;,&quot;out&quot;,&quot;end&quot;,&quot;back&quot;}
   else
    if type(sink)~=&quot;table&quot; or not inRange(sink.depth,.1,200) then error(&quot;tools.mover sink must be {depth=0.1..200}; got &quot;..tostring(type(sink)==&quot;table&quot; and &quot;depth &quot;..tostring(sink.depth) or sink)) end
    table.insert(route,route[1]-Vector3.new(0,sink.depth,0))
    m.states={&quot;up&quot;,&quot;sinking&quot;,&quot;down&quot;,&quot;rising&quot;}
   end
   m.length=0
   for i=2,#route do m.length+=(route[i]-route[i-1]).Magnitude end
   if sink==nil and m.length&lt;.1 then error(&quot;tools.mover &quot;..found:GetFullName()..&quot; goes nowhere: its path ends where it stands&quot;) end
   m.route,m.period,m.pause=route,period,pause
   if sink==nil then
    -- Its two ends, for whoever rides it (the test bench waits at one and gets off at the other): its main part&apos;s
    -- centre resting at the start and at the last point, the pivot carried there with its parts as they stand.
    local offset=main.Position-pivot.Position
    main:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_MoverFrom&quot;,route[1]+offset);main:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_MoverTo&quot;,route[#route]+offset)
   end
  end
  for _,part in parts do part.Anchored=true;courseParts[part]=true end
  if next(movers)==nil then task.spawn(function() while true do RunService.Heartbeat:Wait();local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow();for _,each in movers do placeMover(each,now) end end end) end
  keepFor(movers,found,m)
  CollectionService:AddTag(main,&quot;GameplayMover&quot;)
  placeMover(m,m.started)
  return table.freeze({state=function() return m.state end,changesAt=function() return m.changesAt end})
 end
 local function riseHazard(h,now)
  local rise,step=h.rise,math.floor(now-h.started)
  if step==h.step or h.step and h.step&gt;=rise.seconds then return end
  h.step=step
  local grown=rise.height*math.min(1,(step+1)/rise.seconds)
  -- Through its second, and once more when done in case a late check skipped the last step.
  h.tween=TweenService:Create(h.parts[1],TweenInfo.new(math.clamp(rise.seconds-step,.1,1),Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),{Size=h.size+Vector3.new(0,grown,0),CFrame=h.frame*CFrame.new(0,grown/2,0)})
  h.tween:Play()
  h.main:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_HazardTop&quot;,h.top+grown);h.main:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_HazardRising&quot;,step&lt;rise.seconds)
 end
 local function hurtByHazards()
  local overlap=OverlapParams.new();overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
  while true do
   task.wait(.1)
   local now,bodies=workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),{}
   for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do if player.Character then table.insert(bodies,player.Character) end end
   for body in practiceBodies do table.insert(bodies,body) end
   overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances=bodies
   for _,h in hazards do
    if h.rise then riseHazard(h,now) end
    -- Half a stud around it: a body standing on a solid one or against its side touches it.
    local touching={}
    for _,part in h.parts do for _,hit in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(part.CFrame,part.Size+Vector3.one,overlap) do local actor=tools.actorOf(hit);if actor then touching[actor]=true end end end
    for actor in touching do
     -- Checked every 0.1 s: hurt at the check nearest the interval. A player&apos;s screen flashes red by itself.
     if living(actor) and now-(h.hurtAt[actor] or -math.huge)&gt;=h.interval-.05 then
      keepFor(h.hurtAt,actor,now)
      local body=character(actor)
      body:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;):TakeDamage(h.damage)
      if actor:IsA(&quot;Player&quot;) then motion(body,&quot;flinch&quot;) else hitFeedback(body,nil) end
      recordAction(actor,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;hurt &quot;..h.name)
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 function tools.hazard(target,options)
  local found,parts,main=partsOf(target,&quot;tools.hazard&quot;)
  if hazards[found] then error(&quot;tools.hazard called twice for &quot;..found:GetFullName()) end
  if type(options)~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&quot;tools.hazard needs options such as {damage=10,interval=.5}; got &quot;..type(options)) end
  local damage,interval,rise=options.damage,options.interval,options.rise
  if not inRange(damage,.001,1000) then error(&quot;tools.hazard damage must be above 0, up to 1000; got &quot;..tostring(damage)) end
  if not inRange(interval,.2,60) then error(&quot;tools.hazard interval must be 0.2..60 seconds (damage over time needs a gap); got &quot;..tostring(interval)) end
  local h={parts=parts,main=main,name=found.Name,damage=damage,interval=interval,hurtAt={},top=-math.huge,started=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()}
  for _,part in parts do h.top=math.max(h.top,part.Position.Y+part.Size.Y/2) end
  if rise~=nil then
   if type(rise)~=&quot;table&quot; or not inRange(rise.height,.001,1000) or not inRange(rise.seconds,1,3600) then error(&quot;tools.hazard rise must be {height=0..1000,seconds=1..3600}; got &quot;..tostring(type(rise)==&quot;table&quot; and &quot;height &quot;..tostring(rise.height)..&quot;, seconds &quot;..tostring(rise.seconds) or rise)) end
   if not found:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then error(&quot;tools.hazard rise is for one part (the lava), not the Model &quot;..found:GetFullName()) end
   found.Anchored=true
   h.rise,h.size,h.frame=rise,found.Size,found.CFrame
  end
  if next(hazards)==nil then task.spawn(hurtByHazards) end
  keepFor(hazards,found,h)
  CollectionService:AddTag(main,&quot;GameplayHazard&quot;)
  main:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_HazardTop&quot;,h.top);main:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_HazardRising&quot;,rise~=nil)
 end
 -- Play again: movers back where they started, rising hazards back to their first height and rising again.
 resetMoversAndHazards=function()
  local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
  for _,m in movers do m.started=now;placeMover(m,now) end
  for _,h in hazards do
   if h.rise then
    if h.tween then h.tween:Cancel() end
    h.parts[1].Size=h.size;h.parts[1].CFrame=h.frame;h.started,h.step,h.tween=now,nil,nil
    h.main:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_HazardTop&quot;,h.top);h.main:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_HazardRising&quot;,true)
   end
  end
 end
end
-- Zones: a player whose body is within radius studs of a spot across, and from 4 below to height above it, has
-- arrived there. Checkpoints are zones taken in order, with TB_Checkpoint, TB_CheckpointTotal and TB_Finished on the
-- player (11-01 q5&apos;s course waited for scene marks it never had and was given up twice).
local zones,course={},nil
local function zoneSpot(target,name)
 local spot=type(target)==&quot;string&quot; and tools.anchor(target) or target
 if typeof(spot)==&quot;Instance&quot; and spot:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;) then spot=spot.PrimaryPart or spot:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;,true) end
 if typeof(spot)~=&quot;Instance&quot; or not spot:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then error(name..&quot; needs an anchor name, a BasePart or a Model; got &quot;..tostring(target)) end
 return spot
end
local function zoneReach(options,name)
 local radius=options.radius==nil and 6 or bounded(options.radius,name..&quot; radius&quot;,200)
 local height=options.height==nil and 10 or bounded(options.height,name..&quot; height&quot;,200)
 if radius&lt;1 then error(name..&quot; radius must be 1..200 studs; got &quot;..radius) end
 return radius,height
end
local function within(spot,radius,height,body)
 local offset=body.Position-spot.Position
 if Vector3.new(offset.X,0,offset.Z).Magnitude&gt;radius or offset.Y&gt;height then return false end
 local ignored={spot}
 if typeof(body)==&quot;Instance&quot; then
  local model=body:FindFirstAncestorOfClass(&quot;Model&quot;)
  if model then
   table.insert(ignored,model)
   local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;)
   local seat=humanoid and humanoid.SeatPart
   if seat then table.insert(ignored,seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass(&quot;Model&quot;) or seat) end
  end
 end
 local cast=RaycastParams.new();cast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;cast.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignored;cast.RespectCanCollide=true;cast.IgnoreWater=true
 local floor=workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(body.Position.X,spot.Position.Y-.05,body.Position.Z),Vector3.new(0,-2048,0),cast)
 local bottom=floor and math.min(spot.Position.Y-4,floor.Position.Y-.5) or spot.Position.Y-4
 return body.Position.Y&gt;=bottom
end
local function watchRecoveredDepartures()
 for actor,recovery in vehicleRecoveries do
  local body=root(actor)
  if not recovery.active and body then
   for spot,reach in recovery.watched or {} do
    if not within(spot,reach.radius,reach.height,body) then
     recovery.left[spot]=true;recovery.watched[spot]=nil
    end
   end
  end
 end
end
task.spawn(function() while true do task.wait(.1);watchRecoveredDepartures() end end)
local function recoveredArrival(actor,spot,radius,height,body)
 local recovery=vehicleRecoveries[actor]
 if not recovery then return false end
 recovery.watched=recovery.watched or {}
 recovery.watched[spot]={radius=radius,height=height}
 if recovery.active then return true end
 if recovery.left[spot] or not recovery.landing or not within(spot,radius,height,{Position=recovery.landing}) then
  recovery.watched[spot]=nil;return false
 end
 if not within(spot,radius,height,body) then recovery.left[spot]=true;recovery.watched[spot]=nil;return false end
 return true
end
local function backToCheckpoint(player)
 local reached=course.reached[player] or 0
 local body=character(player)
 if reached&gt;0 and body then
  local spot=course.spots[reached]
  local torso=root(player)
  if torso then torso.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;torso.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero end
  body:PivotTo(CFrame.new(spot.Position+Vector3.new(0,spot.Size.Y/2+3,0)))
  course.motion[player]=nil
  recordAction(player,&quot;event&quot;,&quot;checkpoint-return &quot;..reached..&quot; &quot;..spot:GetFullName())
 end
end
-- A thin decoration lying on a registered deck is still supported by that deck, not a new patch of outside ground.
local function registeredCourseFloor(floor,cast)
 if courseParts[floor.Instance] then return true end
 local skipped=table.clone(cast.FilterDescendantsInstances)
 local hit=floor
 for _=1,4 do
  table.insert(skipped,hit.Instance);cast.FilterDescendantsInstances=skipped
  hit=workspace:Raycast(floor.Position+Vector3.new(0,.1,0),Vector3.new(0,-2.1,0),cast)
  if not hit then return false end
  if courseParts[hit.Instance] then return true end
 end
 return false
end
-- Only an observed airborne drop greater than the character jump height plus 0.5 starts the off-course return timer.
-- Ground contact is independent of downhill speed; registered course surfaces remain valid at any height.
local function landedOffCourse(player,body,reached)
 local model=character(player)
 local humanoid=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;)
 if not humanoid then return false end
 local motion=course.motion[player]
 if not motion or motion.body~=model then motion={body=model};course.motion[player]=motion end
 local depth=humanoid.HipHeight+body.Size.Y/2
 local cast=RaycastParams.new();cast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;cast.RespectCanCollide=true;cast.IgnoreWater=true
 cast.FilterDescendantsInstances={model}
 local floor=workspace:Raycast(body.Position,Vector3.new(0,-depth-1.5,0),cast)
 local grounded=humanoid.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air
 if not grounded then
  motion.takeoffHeight=motion.takeoffHeight or motion.lastGroundHeight
  motion.steadyAt=nil;return false
 end
 local feetHeight=floor and floor.Position.Y or body.Position.Y-depth
 local registered=floor and registeredCourseFloor(floor,cast) or within(course.spots[reached],course.radius,course.height,body)
  or course.finish and within(course.finish,course.radius,course.height,body)
 if registered then motion.returnNeeded=false;motion.steadyAt=nil
 elseif motion.takeoffHeight then
  local jumpHeight=humanoid.UseJumpPower and humanoid.JumpPower^2/(2*workspace.Gravity) or humanoid.JumpHeight
  if motion.takeoffHeight-feetHeight&gt;jumpHeight+.5 then motion.returnNeeded=true end
 end
 motion.takeoffHeight=nil;motion.lastGroundHeight=feetHeight
 if not motion.returnNeeded then return false end
 local floorSpeed=floor and floor.Instance:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) and floor.Instance.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y or 0
 if math.abs(body.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y-floorSpeed)&gt;=2 then motion.steadyAt=nil;return false end
 motion.steadyAt=motion.steadyAt or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-motion.steadyAt&gt;=.8
end
local function walkCourse(player,body)
 local reached=course.reached[player] or 0
 if course.respawn and reached&gt;0 and not course.finished[player] then
  if body.Position.Y&lt;course.lowest-30 or landedOffCourse(player,body,reached) then backToCheckpoint(player);return end
 end
 local nextSpot=course.spots[reached+1]
 local nextBlocked=nextSpot and recoveredArrival(player,nextSpot,course.radius,course.height,body)
 local finishBlocked=course.finish and recoveredArrival(player,course.finish,course.radius,course.height,body)
 if nextSpot and within(nextSpot,course.radius,course.height,body) and not nextBlocked then
  reached+=1;course.reached[player]=reached;course.motion[player]=nil;player:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Checkpoint&quot;,reached)
  tools.feedback(player,&quot;Checkpoint &quot;..reached..&quot;/&quot;..#course.spots,&quot;score&quot;)
  if course.onReach then course.onReach(player,reached) end
 elseif course.finish and not course.finished[player] and within(course.finish,course.radius,course.height,body) and not finishBlocked then
  if reached&lt;#course.spots then
   if os.clock()-(course.warnedAt[player] or -math.huge)&gt;3 then course.warnedAt[player]=os.clock();toast(player,&quot;Checkpoints left: &quot;..(#course.spots-reached)) end
   return
  end
  course.finished[player]=true;player:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Finished&quot;,true)
  tools.feedback(player,&quot;Finish!&quot;,&quot;win&quot;)
  if course.onFinish then course.onFinish(player) end
 end
end
local function watchZones()
 while true do
  task.wait(.1)
  for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do
   local body=root(player)
   if not body or not living(player) then continue end
   for _,zone in zones do
    local inside=within(zone.spot,zone.radius,zone.height,body)
    local was=zone.inside[player];zone.inside[player]=inside
    local recovering=recoveredArrival(player,zone.spot,zone.radius,zone.height,body)
    if inside and not was and not recovering and not (zone.once and zone.done[player]) then zone.done[player]=true;zone.onEnter(player) end
   end
   if course then walkCourse(player,body) end
  end
 end
end
local function startWatchingZones() if #zones==0 and not course then task.spawn(watchZones) end end
function tools.zone(target,options,onEnter)
 if type(options)~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&quot;tools.zone needs options such as {radius=6}; got &quot;..type(options)) end
 if type(onEnter)~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;tools.zone onEnter must be a function(player); got &quot;..type(onEnter)) end
 if options.once~=nil and type(options.once)~=&quot;boolean&quot; then error(&quot;tools.zone once must be true or false; got &quot;..tostring(options.once)) end
 local radius,height=zoneReach(options,&quot;tools.zone&quot;)
 local spot=zoneSpot(target,&quot;tools.zone&quot;)
 startWatchingZones()
 table.insert(zones,{spot=spot,radius=radius,height=height,once=options.once~=false,onEnter=onEnter,inside={},done={}})
end
-- A player standing at a spot, as tools.zone reads it: on the ground by the point, whatever its height over that ground.
-- Round 17 q6&apos;s own check wanted the body no lower than the point and refused a player standing right there.
function tools.atSpot(actor,target,radius)
 local spot=zoneSpot(target,&quot;tools.atSpot&quot;)
 local reach,height=zoneReach({radius=radius},&quot;tools.atSpot&quot;)
 local body=root(actor)
 return body~=nil and living(actor) and not recoveredArrival(actor,spot,reach,height,body) and within(spot,reach,height,body)
end
function tools.checkpoints(list,options)
 if course then error(&quot;tools.checkpoints called twice&quot;) end
 if type(list)~=&quot;table&quot; or #list&lt;1 or #list&gt;30 then error(&quot;tools.checkpoints needs 1..30 checkpoints in order; got &quot;..(type(list)==&quot;table&quot; and #list..&quot; of them&quot; or type(list))) end
 if type(options)~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&quot;tools.checkpoints needs options such as {finish=\&quot;finish\&quot;}; got &quot;..type(options)) end
 if options.respawn~=nil and type(options.respawn)~=&quot;boolean&quot; then error(&quot;tools.checkpoints respawn must be true or false; got &quot;..tostring(options.respawn)) end
 for _,name in {&quot;onReach&quot;,&quot;onFinish&quot;} do if options[name]~=nil and type(options[name])~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;tools.checkpoints &quot;..name..&quot; must be a function; got &quot;..type(options[name])) end end
 local radius,height=zoneReach(options,&quot;tools.checkpoints&quot;)
 local spots={}
 for index,target in list do spots[index]=zoneSpot(target,&quot;tools.checkpoints checkpoint &quot;..index) end
 local finish=options.finish~=nil and zoneSpot(options.finish,&quot;tools.checkpoints finish&quot;) or nil
 local lowest=finish and finish.Position.Y or math.huge
 for _,spot in spots do lowest=math.min(lowest,spot.Position.Y) end
 startWatchingZones()
 course={spots=spots,finish=finish,radius=radius,height=height,lowest=lowest,respawn=options.respawn~=false,onReach=options.onReach,onFinish=options.onFinish,reached={},finished={},warnedAt={},motion={}}
 for _,part in workspace:GetDescendants() do
  if part:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then
   local kit=part:GetAttribute(&quot;structureKit&quot;)
   if kit==&quot;platform&quot; or kit==&quot;stairs&quot; or kit==&quot;ramp&quot; then courseParts[part]=true end
  end
 end
 for _,spot in spots do registerCourseParts(spot) end
 if finish then registerCourseParts(finish) end
 local function join(player)
  player:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Checkpoint&quot;,0);player:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_CheckpointTotal&quot;,#spots);player:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Finished&quot;,false)
  -- A player who dies comes back at their last checkpoint, once Roblox has set the new body down.
  player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(body)
   if not body:WaitForChild(&quot;HumanoidRootPart&quot;,10) then return end
   RunService.Heartbeat:Wait();RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
   if course.respawn then backToCheckpoint(player) end
  end)
 end
 for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do join(player) end
 table.insert(playerJoins,join)
end
local function resetZonesAndDoors()
 table.clear(vehicleRecoveries)
 for _,zone in zones do table.clear(zone.done) end
 if course then
  table.clear(course.reached);table.clear(course.finished);table.clear(course.motion)
  for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do player:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Checkpoint&quot;,0);player:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_Finished&quot;,false) end
 end
 for _,door in doors do if door.mode~=&quot;timed&quot; then setDoor(door,false) end end
end
-- Parts the game makes (a marker, a cup, a target, a plaque) in one call: anchored, never touched (arrival is
-- tools.zone), solid unless said otherwise, an upright cylinder when asked for one, with an optional glow, outline
-- and sign. The first round&apos;s games wrote 949 lines of these, and q16&apos;s cups lay on their sides.
local partShapes={block=Enum.PartType.Block,ball=Enum.PartType.Ball,cylinder=Enum.PartType.Cylinder}
local function partColor(value,name)
 if typeof(value)==&quot;Color3&quot; then return value end
 if type(value)==&quot;string&quot; and value:match(&quot;^#%x%x%x%x%x%x$&quot;) then return Color3.fromHex(value) end
 error(name..&apos; color must be a Color3 or &quot;#rrggbb&quot;; got &apos;..tostring(value))
end
function tools.sign(target,text,options)
 if typeof(target)~=&quot;Instance&quot; or not (target:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) or target:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;)) then error(&quot;tools.sign needs a BasePart or a Model; got &quot;..tostring(target)) end
 if type(text)~=&quot;string&quot; or #text&gt;200 then error(&quot;tools.sign text must be text up to 200 bytes; got &quot;..tostring(text)) end
 options=options or {}
 if type(options)~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&quot;tools.sign options must be a table such as {color=\&quot;#ffd166\&quot;}; got &quot;..type(options)) end
 local distance=options.distance==nil and 60 or bounded(options.distance,&quot;sign distance&quot;,500)
 local body=target
 if target:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;) then body=target.PrimaryPart or target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;,true) end
 if not body then error(&quot;tools.sign &quot;..target:GetFullName()..&quot; has no parts&quot;) end
 local frame,size
 if target:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;) then frame,size=target:GetBoundingBox() else frame,size=target.CFrame,target.Size end
 local gui=Instance.new(&quot;BillboardGui&quot;);gui.Name=&quot;TB_Sign&quot;;gui.Adornee=body;gui.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(220,40);gui.MaxDistance=distance;gui.LightInfluence=0
 gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace=Vector3.new(0,frame.Position.Y+size.Y/2-body.Position.Y+1.4,0)
 local label=Instance.new(&quot;TextLabel&quot;);label.Name=&quot;Text&quot;;label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);label.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(24,24,32);label.BackgroundTransparency=.25
 label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;label.TextScaled=true;label.TextColor3=options.color==nil and Color3.new(1,1,1) or partColor(options.color,&quot;tools.sign&quot;);label.TextStrokeTransparency=.4;label.Text=text;label.Parent=gui
 local fit=Instance.new(&quot;UITextSizeConstraint&quot;);fit.MaxTextSize=24;fit.Parent=label
 local corner=Instance.new(&quot;UICorner&quot;);corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,8);corner.Parent=label
 gui.Parent=body
 return label
end
function tools.part(options)
 if type(options)~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&apos;tools.part needs options such as {name=&quot;crate&quot;,size=Vector3.new(2,2,2),at=Vector3.new(0,1,0)}; got &apos;..type(options)) end
 if type(options.name)~=&quot;string&quot; or #options.name==0 or #options.name&gt;60 then error(&quot;tools.part name must be short text such as 木箱; got &quot;..tostring(options.name)) end
 local name=&quot;tools.part &quot;..options.name
 if typeof(options.size)~=&quot;Vector3&quot; or not finiteVector(options.size) or options.size.X&lt;=0 or options.size.Y&lt;=0 or options.size.Z&lt;=0 then error(name..&quot; size must be a Vector3 with every side above 0; got &quot;..tostring(options.size)) end
 local at=typeof(options.at)==&quot;Vector3&quot; and CFrame.new(options.at) or options.at
 if typeof(at)~=&quot;CFrame&quot; or not finiteVector(at.Position) then error(name..&quot; at must be a Vector3 or a CFrame; got &quot;..tostring(options.at)) end
 local shape=options.shape or &quot;block&quot;
 if shape~=&quot;wedge&quot; and not partShapes[shape] then error(name..&apos; shape must be &quot;block&quot;, &quot;ball&quot;, &quot;cylinder&quot; or &quot;wedge&quot;; got &apos;..tostring(shape)) end
 local material=options.material or &quot;SmoothPlastic&quot;
 if type(material)~=&quot;string&quot; or not pcall(function() return Enum.Material[material] end) then error(name..&quot; material must be a Roblox material name such as Wood, Metal, Neon or Glass; got &quot;..tostring(material)) end
 local transparency=options.transparency==nil and 0 or bounded(options.transparency,name..&quot; transparency&quot;,1)
 if options.solid~=nil and type(options.solid)~=&quot;boolean&quot; then error(name..&quot; solid must be true or false; got &quot;..tostring(options.solid)) end
 local solid=options.solid~=false
 -- The runtime stops a game whose see-through part still blocks the way (11-01 q10).
 if solid and transparency&gt;.5 then error(name..&quot; is see-through (transparency &quot;..transparency..&quot;) and solid: give it solid=false&quot;) end
 if options.parent~=nil and typeof(options.parent)~=&quot;Instance&quot; then error(name..&quot; parent must be an Instance; got &quot;..tostring(options.parent)) end
 if options.outline~=nil and type(options.outline)~=&quot;boolean&quot; then error(name..&quot; outline must be true or false; got &quot;..tostring(options.outline)) end
 local part=Instance.new(shape==&quot;wedge&quot; and &quot;WedgePart&quot; or &quot;Part&quot;)
 part.Name=options.name;part.Anchored=true;part.CanTouch=false;part.CanCollide=solid;part.CanQuery=transparency&lt;.95
 part.Material=Enum.Material[material];part.Color=options.color==nil and Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200) or partColor(options.color,name);part.Transparency=transparency
 if shape==&quot;cylinder&quot; then
  -- Upright: size is width, height, depth, as for a block; Roblox&apos;s own cylinder lies along X.
  part.Shape=partShapes.cylinder;part.Size=Vector3.new(options.size.Y,options.size.X,options.size.Z);part.CFrame=at*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2)
 else
  if shape~=&quot;wedge&quot; then part.Shape=partShapes[shape] end
  part.Size=options.size;part.CFrame=at
 end
 part.Parent=options.parent or workspace
 if solid then courseParts[part]=true end
 if options.glow~=nil then
  local range=bounded(options.glow,name..&quot; glow&quot;,60)
  local light=Instance.new(&quot;PointLight&quot;);light.Color=part.Color;light.Range=range;light.Brightness=1;light.Parent=part
 end
 if options.outline then local outline=Instance.new(&quot;Highlight&quot;);outline.FillTransparency=.85;outline.OutlineColor=part.Color;outline.Adornee=part;outline.Parent=part end
 if options.sign~=nil then tools.sign(part,options.sign) end
 return part
end
-- Key objects (KeyObject attribute) the scene placed: a template the game hands out or copies, every copy of which
-- leaves the scene, or the copies used where they stand (karts, ponies).
function tools.takeModel(id)
 if type(id)~=&quot;string&quot; or #id==0 then error(&quot;tools.takeModel needs a key object id; got &quot;..tostring(id)) end
 local template
 for _,where in {workspace,game:GetService(&quot;ServerStorage&quot;)} do
  for _,item in where:GetDescendants() do if item:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;) and item:GetAttribute(&quot;KeyObject&quot;)==id then template=item;break end end
  if template then break end
 end
 if not template then error(&quot;tools.takeModel: the scene has no key object &quot;..id) end
 storeSceneCopies(template)
 return template
end
function tools.sceneModels(id)
 if type(id)~=&quot;string&quot; or #id==0 then error(&quot;tools.sceneModels needs a key object id; got &quot;..tostring(id)) end
 local found={}
 for _,item in workspace:GetDescendants() do if item:IsA(&quot;Model&quot;) and item:GetAttribute(&quot;KeyObject&quot;)==id then table.insert(found,item) end end
 table.sort(found,function(a,b) return a.Name&lt;b.Name end)
 return found
end
-- Players: who is in, each player&apos;s own table, the FG_ values everyone starts with, the Roblox player list column,
-- and each new body once Roblox has set it down; Play again gives every player a fresh table and the start values,
-- and stands them on the spawn anchor. The first round&apos;s games wrote this by hand in 16 of 18 programs.
local roster
local function freshPlayer(player)
 for name,value in roster.start do player:SetAttribute(name,value) end
 roster.states[player]=roster.state and roster.state(player) or {}
end
local function restartPlayers()
 if not roster then return end
 for player in roster.states do
  freshPlayer(player)
  local body=character(player)
  if roster.spawn and body then local humanoid=body:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;);if humanoid then humanoid.Sit=false end;body:PivotTo(CFrame.new(roster.spawn.Position+Vector3.new(0,roster.spawn.Size.Y/2+3,0))) end
 end
end
function tools.players(options)
 if roster then error(&quot;tools.players called twice&quot;) end
 if type(options)~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&quot;tools.players needs options such as {start={FG_Score=0}}; got &quot;..type(options)) end
 local start=options.start or {}
 if type(start)~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&quot;tools.players start must be a table of FG_ attributes such as {FG_Score=0}; got &quot;..type(start)) end
 for name,value in start do
  if type(name)~=&quot;string&quot; or not name:match(&quot;^FG_%w+$&quot;) then error(&quot;tools.players start names must be FG_ attributes such as FG_Score; got &quot;..tostring(name)) end
  if type(value)~=&quot;number&quot; and type(value)~=&quot;string&quot; and type(value)~=&quot;boolean&quot; then error(&quot;tools.players start &quot;..name..&quot; must be a number, text or true/false; got &quot;..type(value)) end
 end
 for _,name in {&quot;state&quot;,&quot;onJoin&quot;,&quot;onLeave&quot;,&quot;onSpawn&quot;} do if options[name]~=nil and type(options[name])~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;tools.players &quot;..name..&quot; must be a function; got &quot;..type(options[name])) end end
 if options.leaderboard~=nil and type(start[options.leaderboard])~=&quot;number&quot; then error(&quot;tools.players leaderboard must be one of the start numbers such as FG_Score; got &quot;..tostring(options.leaderboard)) end
 local spawn=options.spawn~=nil and targetPart(options.spawn,&quot;tools.players spawn&quot;) or nil
 roster={start=start,state=options.state,spawn=spawn,states={},gone=setmetatable({},{__mode=&quot;k&quot;})}
 local function spawned(player,body)
  if not body:WaitForChild(&quot;HumanoidRootPart&quot;,10) then return end
  RunService.Heartbeat:Wait();RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
  if roster.states[player] and options.onSpawn then options.onSpawn(player,body,roster.states[player]) end
 end
 local function join(player)
  if roster.states[player] or roster.gone[player] then return end
  freshPlayer(player)
  if options.leaderboard then
   local board=player:FindFirstChild(&quot;leaderstats&quot;) or Instance.new(&quot;Folder&quot;);board.Name=&quot;leaderstats&quot;;board.Parent=player
   local column=Instance.new(&quot;IntValue&quot;);column.Name=&quot;Score&quot;;column.Value=player:GetAttribute(options.leaderboard);column.Parent=board
   player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(options.leaderboard):Connect(function() column.Value=player:GetAttribute(options.leaderboard) or 0 end)
  end
  player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(body) spawned(player,body) end)
  if options.onJoin then options.onJoin(player,roster.states[player]) end
  if player.Character then task.spawn(spawned,player,player.Character) end
 end
 roster.join=join
 for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do join(player) end
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
  roster.gone[player]=true
  local state=roster.states[player]
  if state and options.onLeave then options.onLeave(player,state) end
  roster.states[player]=nil
 end)
 return roster.states
end
-- One player&apos;s state, joined on the spot when they have just come in: Roblox runs a new player&apos;s PlayerAdded handlers
-- newest first, so one connected after tools.players runs before its join (round 17 q2: tools.seats&apos; onSeat read
-- states[player] as nil for both players and no kart was made). nil once the player has left.
function tools.playerState(player)
 if not roster then error(&quot;tools.playerState needs tools.players called first&quot;) end
 if typeof(player)~=&quot;Instance&quot; or not player:IsA(&quot;Player&quot;) then error(&quot;tools.playerState takes a Player (a practice opponent is a Model: keep its table yourself); got &quot;..tostring(player)) end
 if player.Parent==Players then roster.join(player) end
 return roster.states[player]
end
-- Seats: a match has count places. Real players take them in the order they join, and a practice opponent (a toolbox
-- body the game steers through think) holds every place left, so one player can start a match made for four (11-01
-- final q9: a 2-against-2 football waited for four real players and never kicked off). A player who joins takes the
-- lowest seat a practice opponent holds; one who leaves hands the seat to the next player waiting, or to a new practice
-- opponent.
local function seatPractice(n)
 local model,humanoid,body=buildBody(seatOptions.look,seatOptions.name..&quot; &quot;..n)
 humanoid.WalkSpeed=seatOptions.speed
 model:SetAttribute(&quot;GameplayPracticeOpponent&quot;,true)
 local spot=seatOptions.anchor
 model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(spot.Position+Vector3.new(((n-1)%4-1.5)*3,0,math.floor((n-1)/4)*3)))
 local frame,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
 model:PivotTo(model:GetPivot()+Vector3.new(0,spot.Position.Y+spot.Size.Y/2-(frame.Position.Y-size.Y/2),0))
 model.Parent=workspace;body:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
 if seatOptions.look.kind==&quot;humanoid&quot; then animateWalker(model,seatOptions.look.animation) end
 nameplate(model,model.Name,false)
 keepFor(practiceBodies,model,n)
 seatHolders[n]=model
 seatOptions.onSeat(model,n)
end
local function leaveSeat(n)
 local holder=seatHolders[n];seatHolders[n]=nil
 if seatOptions.onLeave then seatOptions.onLeave(holder,n) end
 if not holder:IsA(&quot;Player&quot;) then practiceBodies[holder]=nil;holder:Destroy() end
end
local function seatOf(actor) for n=1,seatOptions.count do if seatHolders[n]==actor then return n end end;return nil end
local function takeSeat(player)
 if seatOf(player) then return end
 local free
 for n=1,seatOptions.count do if seatHolders[n]==nil then free=n;break end end
 if not free then for n=1,seatOptions.count do if not seatHolders[n]:IsA(&quot;Player&quot;) then free=n;leaveSeat(n);break end end end
 if not free then toast(player,&quot;All seats are taken: you join as soon as someone leaves&quot;);return end
 seatHolders[free]=player
 if roster then roster.join(player) end
 seatOptions.onSeat(player,free)
end
local function freeSeat(player)
 local n=seatOf(player)
 if not n then return end
 leaveSeat(n)
 for _,waiting in Players:GetPlayers() do
  if waiting~=player and not seatOf(waiting) then seatHolders[n]=waiting;seatOptions.onSeat(waiting,n);return end
 end
 seatPractice(n)
end
-- A practice opponent knocked out (or fallen out of the world) stays down until the next round, which seats a new one.
local function refillPracticeSeats()
 if not seatOptions then return end
 for n=1,seatOptions.count do
  local holder=seatHolders[n]
  if not holder:IsA(&quot;Player&quot;) and not (holder.Parent and living(holder)) then leaveSeat(n);seatPractice(n) end
 end
end
local function steerPracticeOpponents()
 while true do
  task.wait(.2)
  for n=1,seatOptions.count do
   local body=seatHolders[n]
   if body and practiceBodies[body] and body.Parent and living(body) then
    local target=seatOptions.think(body,n)
    if type(target)==&quot;string&quot; or typeof(target)==&quot;Instance&quot; then target=targetPart(target,&quot;tools.seats think for &quot;..body.Name).Position end
    if target~=nil and not finiteVector(target) then error(&quot;tools.seats think for &quot;..body.Name..&quot; must return a Vector3, an anchor name, a BasePart, a Model with parts or nil; got &quot;..tostring(target)) end
    if target then steerToward(body,target) else body:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;):MoveTo(body.HumanoidRootPart.Position) end
   end
  end
 end
end
function tools.seats(options)
 if seatOptions then error(&quot;tools.seats called twice&quot;) end
 if type(options)~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&quot;tools.seats needs {count,name,anchor,onSeat}; got &quot;..typeof(options)) end
 local count=options.count
 if type(count)~=&quot;number&quot; or count%1~=0 or count&lt;2 or count&gt;16 then error(&quot;tools.seats count must be a whole number 2..16; got &quot;..tostring(count)) end
 if type(options.name)~=&quot;string&quot; or #options.name==0 or #options.name&gt;40 then error(&quot;tools.seats name must be short text such as 练习对手; got &quot;..tostring(options.name)) end
 local spot=targetPart(options.anchor,&quot;tools.seats anchor&quot;)
 local look=options.look or {kind=&quot;humanoid&quot;}
 checkLook(look)
 local speed=options.speed==nil and 12 or bounded(options.speed,&quot;practice opponent speed&quot;,30)
 if type(options.onSeat)~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;tools.seats onSeat must be a function(actor,seat); got &quot;..type(options.onSeat)) end
 if options.onLeave~=nil and type(options.onLeave)~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;tools.seats onLeave must be a function(actor,seat); got &quot;..type(options.onLeave)) end
 if options.think~=nil and type(options.think)~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;tools.seats think must be a function(opponent,seat); got &quot;..type(options.think)) end
 seatOptions={count=count,name=options.name,anchor=spot,look=look,speed=speed,onSeat=options.onSeat,onLeave=options.onLeave,think=options.think}
 for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do takeSeat(player) end
 for n=1,count do if seatHolders[n]==nil then seatPractice(n) end end
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(freeSeat)
 if seatOptions.think then task.spawn(steerPracticeOpponents) end
end
-- The one way in for a new player, in a fixed order: the state and start values, then the seat, then the rest. Roblox
-- promises no order among one signal&apos;s connections and ran the newest first: tools.seats&apos; onSeat came before
-- tools.players&apos; join (round 17 q2: no state yet, no kart made; q9: the start values then wrote the team set in onSeat
-- back to 候补, and the match never kicked off). The rest each start in their own thread, as their own connections
-- did: a save still loading does not hold up the round.
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
 if roster then roster.join(player) end
 if seatOptions then takeSeat(player) end
 for _,joined in playerJoins do task.spawn(joined,player) end
end)
-- Rounds, only for rules with rounds, knock-outs or a time limit (the removed components ran rounds unasked and called
-- a draw every 75 s). First round: q18 started no new round 32 s after one ended, q20 wrote its own falling out, q3&apos;s
-- second player missed the match in 3 of 8 runs, q4 kept its own time limit. Only resetRound (restartRound calls it)
-- is a top-level local: the toolbox is near Luau&apos;s 200 locals a function.
local resetRound
do
 local round
 local function roundState(player,state) player:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_RoundState&quot;,state) end
 local function showTimeLeft(seconds)
  round.timeLeft=seconds
  if seconds then for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do player:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_RoundTimeLeft&quot;,seconds) end end
 end
 local function survivors()
  local list={} for _,player in round.entrants do if round.alive[player] then table.insert(list,player) end end
  return list
 end
 local wonTexts={last=&quot;You are the last one standing&quot;,time=&quot;You lasted until the time ran out&quot;,game=&quot;You won this round&quot;}
 local function endRound(reason,winners)
  round.phase=&quot;ended&quot;
  for _,player in round.entrants do
   local won=table.find(winners,player)~=nil
   roundState(player,&quot;ended&quot;)
   tools.settle(player,won,won and wonTexts[reason] or round.alive[player] and (reason==&quot;time&quot; and &quot;Time is up: not finished&quot; or &quot;This round is over&quot;) or &quot;You are out&quot;)
  end
  if round.onEnd then round.onEnd(winners,reason) end
  if round.next then tools.restartAfter(round.next) end
 end
 local function putOut(player)
  if round.phase==&quot;playing&quot; and round.alive[player] then round.alive[player]=nil;roundState(player,&quot;out&quot;);toast(player,&quot;You are out: wait for the next round&quot;) end
 end
 -- Two or more took part: it ends with one left, or none; one alone: once they are out.
 local function endRoundIfDecided()
  if round.phase~=&quot;playing&quot; then return end
  local left=0 for _ in round.alive do left+=1 end
  if left==0 then endRound(&quot;out&quot;,{}) elseif left==1 and round.field&gt;1 then endRound(&quot;last&quot;,survivors()) end
 end
 local function playRound(number)
  for n=round.countdown,1,-1 do
   if round.number~=number then return end
   if n==3 then playSound(&quot;countdown&quot;) end
   for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do toast(player,tostring(n)) end
   task.wait(1)
  end
  if round.number~=number then return end
  local present=Players:GetPlayers()
  if #present&lt;round.minPlayers then round.phase=&quot;waiting&quot;;for _,player in present do roundState(player,&quot;waiting&quot;) end;return end
  round.phase=&quot;playing&quot;;round.entrants=present;round.field=#present;round.alive={}
  local endsAt=round.limit and workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+round.limit
  for _,player in present do round.alive[player]=true;roundState(player,&quot;playing&quot;);toast(player,&quot;Go!&quot;) end
  if round.onStart then round.onStart(table.clone(present)) end
  while true do
   task.wait(.1)
   if round.number~=number or round.phase~=&quot;playing&quot; then return end
   if round.fallY then
    for _,player in round.entrants do local body=root(player);if body and body.Position.Y&lt;round.fallY then putOut(player) end end
    endRoundIfDecided()
   end
   if endsAt and round.phase==&quot;playing&quot; then
    showTimeLeft(math.max(0,math.ceil(endsAt-workspace:GetServerTimeNow())))
    -- survivorsWin=false: a challenge not finished in time is lost.
    if round.timeLeft==0 then endRound(&quot;time&quot;,round.survivorsWin and survivors() or {}) end
   end
  end
 end
 -- Deferred: on Play again the game&apos;s onRestart runs before the new round starts.
 local function startCountdown()
  if round.phase~=&quot;waiting&quot; or #Players:GetPlayers()&lt;round.minPlayers then return end
  round.phase=&quot;countdown&quot;
  for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do roundState(player,&quot;countdown&quot;) end
  task.defer(playRound,round.number)
 end
 local function watchBody(player,body)
  local humanoid=body:WaitForChild(&quot;Humanoid&quot;,10)
  if humanoid then humanoid.Died:Connect(function() putOut(player);endRoundIfDecided() end) end
 end
 local function joinRound(player)
  player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(body) watchBody(player,body) end)
  if player.Character then task.spawn(watchBody,player,player.Character) end
  if round.timeLeft then player:SetAttribute(&quot;TB_RoundTimeLeft&quot;,round.timeLeft) end
  roundState(player,round.phase==&quot;countdown&quot; and &quot;countdown&quot; or &quot;waiting&quot;)
  if round.phase==&quot;playing&quot; then toast(player,&quot;A round is on: you join the next one&quot;) end
 end
 local function leaveRound(player)
  local index=table.find(round.entrants,player)
  if index then table.remove(round.entrants,index) end
  round.alive[player]=nil
  endRoundIfDecided()
 end
 function resetRound()
  if not round then return end
  round.number+=1;round.phase=&quot;waiting&quot;;round.entrants={};round.alive={}
  for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do roundState(player,&quot;waiting&quot;) end
  showTimeLeft(round.limit)
  startCountdown()
 end
 local roundOptionNames={countdown=true,limit=true,fallY=true,next=true,minPlayers=true,survivorsWin=true,onStart=true,onEnd=true}
 function tools.round(options)
  if round then error(&quot;tools.round called twice&quot;) end
  if type(options)~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&quot;tools.round needs options such as {limit=60,fallY=-20}; got &quot;..type(options)) end
  for key in options do if not roundOptionNames[key] then error(&quot;tools.round has no option &quot;..tostring(key)..&quot;; it takes countdown, limit, fallY, next, minPlayers, survivorsWin, onStart and onEnd&quot;) end end
  local countdown=options.countdown==nil and 3 or options.countdown
  if type(countdown)~=&quot;number&quot; or countdown%1~=0 or countdown&lt;0 or countdown&gt;30 then error(&quot;tools.round countdown must be whole seconds 0..30; got &quot;..tostring(countdown)) end
  local limit,fallY,nextIn=options.limit,options.fallY,options.next
  if limit~=nil and (type(limit)~=&quot;number&quot; or not (limit&gt;=1 and limit&lt;=3600)) then error(&quot;tools.round limit must be seconds 1..3600; got &quot;..tostring(limit)) end
  if fallY~=nil and (type(fallY)~=&quot;number&quot; or not (math.abs(fallY)&lt;=100000)) then error(&quot;tools.round fallY must be a height in studs such as -20; got &quot;..tostring(fallY)) end
  if nextIn~=nil and (type(nextIn)~=&quot;number&quot; or not (nextIn&gt;=0 and nextIn&lt;=60)) then error(&quot;tools.round next must be seconds 0..60 until the next round; got &quot;..tostring(nextIn)) end
  local minPlayers=options.minPlayers==nil and 1 or options.minPlayers
  if type(minPlayers)~=&quot;number&quot; or minPlayers%1~=0 or minPlayers&lt;1 or minPlayers&gt;100 then error(&quot;tools.round minPlayers must be a whole number 1..100; got &quot;..tostring(minPlayers)) end
  if options.survivorsWin~=nil and type(options.survivorsWin)~=&quot;boolean&quot; then error(&quot;tools.round survivorsWin must be true or false; got &quot;..tostring(options.survivorsWin)) end
  for _,name in {&quot;onStart&quot;,&quot;onEnd&quot;} do if options[name]~=nil and type(options[name])~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;tools.round &quot;..name..&quot; must be a function; got &quot;..type(options[name])) end end
  round={countdown=countdown,limit=limit,fallY=fallY,next=nextIn,minPlayers=minPlayers,survivorsWin=options.survivorsWin~=false,onStart=options.onStart,onEnd=options.onEnd,number=0,phase=&quot;waiting&quot;,entrants={},alive={},field=0,timeLeft=limit}
  for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do joinRound(player) end
  table.insert(playerJoins,function(player) joinRound(player);startCountdown() end)
  Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(leaveRound)
  startCountdown()
 end
 function tools.eliminate(player)
  if not round then error(&quot;tools.eliminate needs tools.round first&quot;) end
  if typeof(player)~=&quot;Instance&quot; or not player:IsA(&quot;Player&quot;) then error(&quot;tools.eliminate needs a player of the round (practice opponents are not in it); got &quot;..tostring(player)) end
  putOut(player);endRoundIfDecided()
 end
 -- The game&apos;s goal reached (q4: five chests found in time).
 function tools.endRound(winners)
  if not round then error(&quot;tools.endRound needs tools.round first&quot;) end
  if round.phase~=&quot;playing&quot; then error(&quot;tools.endRound ends a round being played; the round is &quot;..round.phase) end
  if typeof(winners)~=&quot;table&quot; then error(&quot;tools.endRound needs a list of the winning players, {} for none; got &quot;..typeof(winners)) end
  for _,player in winners do if not table.find(round.entrants,player) then error(&quot;tools.endRound winners must be players taking part in this round; got &quot;..tostring(player)) end end
  endRound(&quot;game&quot;,table.clone(winners))
 end
end
function tools.onRestart(callback) table.insert(restartCallbacks,callback) end
-- Play again (button or R, player is who pressed it) and a next round the game starts by itself (tools.restartAfter,
-- player nil) are one restart, which closes every settlement panel and its R. 11-01 final q18 called its own reset 12 s
-- after the settlement: the new round began under the old &quot;再来一局 [R]&quot; corner, and R stayed bound.
local pendingRestart
local function restartRound(player)
 pendingRestart=nil
 -- A new round starts from nothing the toolbox kept: coins, xp, items, shots, roles, built spots, taken pickups,
 -- vehicles away from their spots, balls away from kick-off.
 local kept={} for actor in privateStates do table.insert(kept,actor) end
 table.clear(privateStates);for _,actor in kept do publish(actor) end
 table.clear(placements);table.clear(cooldowns)
 bringPickupsBack();local boatRiders=vehiclesBack();table.clear(usedPrompts)
 -- Each team attacks its opening goal again.
 for ball,entry in balls do tools.resetBall(ball);if entry.goals then entry.swapped=false;writeKickGoals(entry) end end
 -- A new round starts on level 1 (q5&apos;s game stayed on level 3 after R); the unlocked levels and the save are kept.
 if levelList then
  for actor,state in levelStates do
   state.current=1;publishLevel(actor);placeAtLevel(actor,1)
   task.spawn(saveLevels,actor)
   if levelEnter then levelEnter(actor,1) end
  end
 end
 refillPracticeSeats()
 resetZonesAndDoors()
 restartPlayers()
 resetShopsAndAreas()
 resetRound()
 resetDigSpots()
 resetMoversAndHazards()
 for _,callback in restartCallbacks do callback(player) end
 -- Detaching a boat hands the character back to its client. Its old seated physics can overwrite the server&apos;s
 -- spawn teleport, so send the final destination after all restart callbacks, to this same character only.
 for rider,body in boatRiders do
  if rider.Character==body then feedbackEvent:FireClient(rider,&quot;boat-reset&quot;,body,body:GetPivot()) end
 end
 feedbackEvent:FireAllClients(&quot;restart&quot;)
end
-- A later call replaces an earlier one; Play again pressed before the time is up cancels it.
function tools.restartAfter(seconds)
 seconds=bounded(seconds,&quot;restartAfter seconds&quot;,60)
 if #restartCallbacks==0 then error(&quot;tools.restartAfter(&quot;..seconds..&quot;) needs tools.onRestart first: it runs that reset when the time is up&quot;) end
 local timer={};pendingRestart=timer
 task.delay(seconds,function() if pendingRestart==timer then restartRound(nil) end end)
end
restartEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
 local now=os.clock();if now-(restartedAt[player] or -math.huge)&lt;1 then return end;restartedAt[player]=now
 if #restartCallbacks==0 then error(&quot;Play again pressed by &quot;..player.Name..&quot; but the game never called tools.onRestart&quot;) end
 restartRound(player)
end)

 local function engineMember(instance,key)
  local value=instance[key]
  if type(value)==&quot;function&quot; then return function(_,...) return value(instance,...) end end
  return value
 end
 local function guardedPath(path,options)
  return setmetatable({},{__index=function(_,key)
   if key==&quot;ComputeAsync&quot; then return function(_,from,target)
    if not computeReachablePath(path,from,target,options) then
     error(&quot;Path unreachable: target &quot;..tostring(target)..&quot; from &quot;..tostring(from)..&quot;; no reachable standing point within 12 studs&quot;,2)
    end
   end end
   return engineMember(path,key)
  end})
 end
 local navigation=setmetatable({
  CreatePath=function(_,options) return guardedPath(PathfindingService:CreatePath(options),options) end,
  FindPathAsync=function(_,from,target)
   local path=PathfindingService:FindPathAsync(from,target)
   if path.Status~=Enum.PathStatus.Success and not computeReachablePath(path,from,target) then
    error(&quot;Path unreachable: target &quot;..tostring(target)..&quot; from &quot;..tostring(from)..&quot;; no reachable standing point within 12 studs&quot;,2)
   end
   return guardedPath(path)
  end,
 },{__index=function(_,key) return engineMember(PathfindingService,key) end})
 local program=script.Parent:FindFirstChild(&quot;GameplayProgram&quot;)
 if program then
  local start=require(program)
  if type(start)~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;GameplayProgram must return a function; got &quot;..type(start)) end
  local environment=getfenv(start)
  local engine=setmetatable({},{__index=function(_,key)
   if key==&quot;GetService&quot; or key==&quot;FindService&quot; then return function(_,name)
    if name==&quot;PathfindingService&quot; then return navigation end
    return game[key](game,name)
   end end
   if key==&quot;PathfindingService&quot; then return navigation end
   return engineMember(game,key)
  end,__newindex=function(_,key,value) game[key]=value end})
  setfenv(start,setmetatable({game=engine},{__index=environment}))
 end
