			FG_CoinsEarned = 0,
			FG_Won = false,
			FG_Choice = 1,
			FG_Scout = false,
			FG_Raider = false,
			FG_Brute = false,
		},
		state = function()
			return { choice = 1, lastSwing = -100, firstTower = nil }
		end,
		leaderboard = &quot;FG_EnemiesDefeated&quot;,
		spawn = &quot;player_spawn&quot;,
		onJoin = function(player)
			tools.award(player, 40)
			player:SetAttribute(&quot;FG_GateHealth&quot;, health)
			player:SetAttribute(&quot;FG_Wave&quot;, wave)
			player:SetAttribute(&quot;FG_WavesCleared&quot;, cleared)
		end,
		onSpawn = function(player)
			tools.giveTool(player, {
				id = &quot;hammer&quot;,
				kind = &quot;melee&quot;,
				name = &quot;Defense Hammer&quot;,
				onUse = function(actor, use)
					local state = tools.playerState(actor)
					if not state or not running or os.clock() - state.lastSwing &lt; 0.7 then
						return
					end
					state.lastSwing = os.clock()
					for _, target in use.targets do
						if enemies[target] then
							tools.damageEnemy(target, 15, actor)
							break
						end
					end
				end,
			})
		end,
	})
	local function broadcast(attr, value)
		for _, actor in tools.actors() do
			actor:SetAttribute(attr, value)
		end
	end
	local function pay(actor, amount, earned)
		local balance = tools.award(actor, amount)
		actor:SetAttribute(&quot;FG_Coins&quot;, balance)
		if earned then
			actor:SetAttribute(
				&quot;FG_CoinsEarned&quot;,
				(actor:GetAttribute(&quot;FG_CoinsEarned&quot;) or 0) + amount
			)
		end
	end
	local function endMatch(won)
		if not running then
			return
		end
		running = false
		for _, actor in tools.actors() do
			actor:SetAttribute(&quot;FG_Won&quot;, won)
		end
		tools.endRound(won and participants or {})
	end
	local function activateTower(record)
		tools.tower(record.model, {
			range = 24,
			damage = record.kind.damage * (1 + 0.5 * (record.level - 1)),
			rate = record.kind.rate,
			owner = record.owner,
		})
	end
	local function upgradeTower(player, record)
		if not record or record.owner ~= player then
			tools.feedback(player, &quot;Build your own tower first.&quot;)
			return
		end
		if record.level &gt;= 3 then
			tools.feedback(player, &quot;Already level 3.&quot;)
			return
		end
		local price = record.level == 1 and 15 or 25
		tools.upgrade(player, record.id, price, function()
			record.level += 1
			-- Replacing the firing model stops its old tower controller.
			local old = record.model
			local replacement = record.kind.model:Clone()
			replacement:PivotTo(old:GetPivot())
			replacement.Parent = old.Parent
			old:Destroy()
			record.model = replacement
			activateTower(record)
			tools.sign(replacement, record.kind.name .. &quot; • Lv &quot; .. record.level)
			player:SetAttribute(
				&quot;FG_TowerUpgrades&quot;,
				(player:GetAttribute(&quot;FG_TowerUpgrades&quot;) or 0) + 1
			)
			tools.feedback(player, &quot;Tower upgraded!&quot;, &quot;score&quot;)
		end)
		player:SetAttribute(&quot;FG_Coins&quot;, tools.state(player).coins)
	end
	local pads = { first, coop, flame, longshot }
	-- Two additional small build pads complete the six-pad defense line.
	for index, base in { flame, longshot } do
		local pad = tools.part({
			name = &quot;Extra build pad&quot;,
			size = Vector3.new(4, 0.2, 4),
			at = base.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, -9),
			color = &quot;#52a7a3&quot;,
			material = &quot;Wood&quot;,
			solid = true,
		})
		table.insert(pads, pad)
	end
	local occupied = {}
	for index, pad in pads do
		tools.sign(pad, &quot;Build / Upgrade • E&quot;)
		tools.prompt(pad, {
			action = &quot;Build / Upgrade&quot;,
			object = &quot;Tower&quot;,
			ready = function(player)
				local state = tools.playerState(player)
				if not state then
					return false, &quot;Please wait&quot;
				end
				local record = occupied[index]
				if record then
					if record.owner ~= player then
						return false, &quot;Another defender&apos;s tower&quot;
					end
					if record.level == 3 then
						return false, &quot;Maximum level&quot;
					end
					local price = record.level == 1 and 15 or 25
					return tools.state(player).coins &gt;= price, &quot;Upgrade: &quot; .. price .. &quot; coins&quot;
				end
				local choice = types[state.choice]
				return tools.state(player).coins &gt;= choice.cost,
					choice.name .. &quot;: &quot; .. choice.cost .. &quot; coins&quot;
			end,
		}, function(player)
			local state = tools.playerState(player)
			if not state then
				return
			end
			if occupied[index] then
				upgradeTower(player, occupied[index])
				return
			end
			local kind = types[state.choice]
			local built = tools.place(player, pad, kind.cost, function(spot)
				local model = kind.model:Clone()
				local _, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
				model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(spot.Position + Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2 + 0.2, 0)))
				model.Parent = workspace
				return model
			end)
			if built then
				local record = {
					model = built,
					owner = player,
					kind = kind,
					level = 1,
					id = &quot;pad_&quot; .. index,
				}
				occupied[index] = record
				table.insert(towers, record)
				if not state.firstTower then
					state.firstTower = record
				end
				activateTower(record)
				tools.sign(built, kind.name .. &quot; • Lv 1&quot;)
				player:SetAttribute(
					&quot;FG_TowersBuilt&quot;,
					(player:GetAttribute(&quot;FG_TowersBuilt&quot;) or 0) + 1
				)
				player:SetAttribute(&quot;FG_Coins&quot;, tools.state(player).coins)
				tools.feedback(player, kind.name .. &quot; built!&quot;, &quot;score&quot;)
			end
		end)
	end
	tools.sign(upgradeSpot, &quot;First tower upgrade • 15 / 25 coins&quot;)
	tools.prompt(upgradeSpot, {
		action = &quot;Upgrade&quot;,
		object = &quot;Your first tower&quot;,
		ready = function(player)
			local state = tools.playerState(player)
			local record = state and state.firstTower
			if not record then
				return false, &quot;Build a tower first&quot;
			end
			if record.level &gt;= 3 then
				return false, &quot;Maximum level&quot;
			end
			local cost = record.level == 1 and 15 or 25
			return tools.state(player).coins &gt;= cost, &quot;Need &quot; .. cost .. &quot; coins&quot;
		end,
	}, function(player)
		local state = tools.playerState(player)
		if state then
			upgradeTower(player, state.firstTower)
		end
	end)
	tools.sign(spawn, &quot;Canyon Entrance • Enemies incoming&quot;)
	tools.sign(scoutSpot, &quot;Scout defense line • Hammer&quot;)
	tools.sign(raiderSpot, &quot;Narrow Bend • Hammer&quot;)
	tools.sign(bruteSpot, &quot;Armored enemy defense line&quot;)
	tools.sign(gate, &quot;Canyon Gate • Protect it!&quot;)
	tools.onInput(function(player, name)
		local state = tools.playerState(player)
		if not state then
			return
		end
		local number = name == &quot;select_bolt&quot; and 1
			or name == &quot;select_flame&quot; and 2
			or name == &quot;select_longshot&quot; and 3
			or nil
		if number then
			state.choice = number
			player:SetAttribute(&quot;FG_Choice&quot;, number)
			tools.feedback(player, types[number].name .. &quot; selected&quot;)
		end
	end)
	local stats = {
		scout = { hp = 30, speed = 6, damage = 1, name = &quot;Scout&quot; },
		raider = { hp = 24, speed = 9, damage = 1, name = &quot;Raider&quot; },
		brute = { hp = 60, speed = 5, damage = 2, name = &quot;Brute&quot; },
	}
	local groups = {
		{ &quot;scout&quot;, &quot;scout&quot;, &quot;scout&quot;, &quot;scout&quot;, &quot;scout&quot; },
		{ &quot;raider&quot;, &quot;raider&quot;, &quot;raider&quot;, &quot;raider&quot;, &quot;raider&quot;, &quot;raider&quot; },
		{ &quot;scout&quot;, &quot;scout&quot;, &quot;scout&quot;, &quot;scout&quot;, &quot;scout&quot;, &quot;scout&quot;, &quot;scout&quot; },
		{ &quot;brute&quot;, &quot;brute&quot;, &quot;brute&quot;, &quot;brute&quot;, &quot;brute&quot; },
		{ &quot;brute&quot;, &quot;raider&quot;, &quot;raider&quot;, &quot;brute&quot;, &quot;raider&quot;, &quot;raider&quot;, &quot;brute&quot; },
	}
	local function spawnOne(kind, token)
		local data = stats[kind]
		local model
		model = tools.spawnEnemy({
			name = data.name,
			look = { kind = &quot;creature&quot;, model = looks[kind] },
			position = spawn.Position,
			health = data.hp,
			speed = data.speed,
			damage = 0,
			drop = 0,
			path = {
				first.Position,
				raiderSpot.Position,
				bruteSpot.Position,
				scoutSpot.Position,
				gate.Position,
			},
		}, function(actor)
			if token ~= epoch then
				return
			end
			enemies[model] = nil
			if actor and actor:IsA(&quot;Player&quot;) and tools.playerState(actor) then
				pay(actor, 5, true)
				actor:SetAttribute(
					&quot;FG_EnemiesDefeated&quot;,
					(actor:GetAttribute(&quot;FG_EnemiesDefeated&quot;) or 0) + 1
				)
				if kind == &quot;scout&quot; then
					actor:SetAttribute(&quot;FG_Scout&quot;, true)
				elseif kind == &quot;raider&quot; then
					actor:SetAttribute(&quot;FG_Raider&quot;, true)
				else
					actor:SetAttribute(&quot;FG_Brute&quot;, true)
				end
			end
		end)
		enemies[model] = data
	end
	tools.onRestart(function()
		epoch += 1
		running = false
		health = 10
		wave = 0
		cleared = 0
		for model in enemies do
			model:Destroy()
		end
		table.clear(enemies)
		for _, record in towers do
			record.model:Destroy()
		end
		table.clear(towers)
		table.clear(occupied)
		for _, actor in tools.actors() do
			pay(actor, 40, false)
		end
	end)
	tools.round({
		countdown = 10,
		minPlayers = 1,
		onStart = function(players)
			participants = players
			running = true
			epoch += 1
			local token = epoch
			task.spawn(function()
				for number, group in groups do
					if token ~= epoch or not running then
						return
					end
					wave = number
					broadcast(&quot;FG_Wave&quot;, number)
					for _, actor in tools.actors() do
						tools.feedback(actor, &quot;Wave &quot; .. number .. &quot; incoming!&quot;)
					end
					local spawned = 0
					tools.wave(#group, 2, function(index)
						if token ~= epoch or not running then
							return
						end
						spawnOne(group[index], token)
						spawned += 1
					end)
					repeat
						task.wait(0.25)
						if token ~= epoch or not running then
							return
						end
						for model, data in enemies do
							if model.Parent and tools.atSpot(model, gate, 12) then
								enemies[model] = nil
								model:Destroy()
								health = math.max(0, health - data.damage)
								broadcast(&quot;FG_GateHealth&quot;, health)
								tools.sound(&quot;explosion&quot;, gate)
								if health &lt;= 0 then
									endMatch(false)
									return
								end
							end
						end
					until spawned == #group and next(enemies) == nil
					cleared = number
					broadcast(&quot;FG_WavesCleared&quot;, cleared)
					for _, actor in tools.actors() do
						pay(actor, 15, true)
						tools.feedback(actor, &quot;Wave cleared! +15 coins&quot;, &quot;score&quot;)
					end
					if number == 5 then
						endMatch(true)
						return
					end
					task.wait(8)
				end
			end)
		end,
		onEnd = function(_, reason)
			running = false
			if reason ~= &quot;game&quot; then
				epoch += 1
			end
			for _, actor in tools.actors() do
				tools.settle(
					actor,
					actor:GetAttribute(&quot;FG_Won&quot;) == true,
					string.format(
						&quot;Waves cleared: %d / 5\nEnemies defeated: %d\nCoins earned: %d\nTowers built: %d&quot;,
						cleared,
						actor:GetAttribute(&quot;FG_EnemiesDefeated&quot;) or 0,
						actor:GetAttribute(&quot;FG_CoinsEarned&quot;) or 0,
						actor:GetAttribute(&quot;FG_TowersBuilt&quot;) or 0
					)
				)
			end
		end,
	})
end

local limbs={Head=true,UpperTorso=true,LowerTorso=true,LeftUpperArm=true,LeftLowerArm=true,LeftHand=true,RightUpperArm=true,RightLowerArm=true,RightHand=true,LeftUpperLeg=true,LeftLowerLeg=true,LeftFoot=true,RightUpperLeg=true,RightLowerLeg=true,RightFoot=true}
local function normalAvatarPart(part)
 local model=part.Parent
 local accessory=model and model:IsA(&quot;Accessory&quot;) and part.Name==&quot;Handle&quot;
 if accessory then model=model.Parent end
 local humanoid=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass(&quot;Humanoid&quot;)
 return humanoid and (accessory or humanoid.RootPart==part or part:IsA(&quot;MeshPart&quot;) and limbs[part.Name])
end
local function declaredTrigger(part)
 if not allowInvisible then return false end
 for _,anchor in declaredAnchors do
  local delta=anchor.frame:PointToObjectSpace(part.Position)
  if math.abs(delta.X)&lt;=anchor.size.X/2+2 and math.abs(delta.Y)&lt;=anchor.size.Y/2+2 and math.abs(delta.Z)&lt;=anchor.size.Z/2+2
   and part.Size.X&lt;=anchor.size.X+.1 and part.Size.Y&lt;=anchor.size.Y+.1 and part.Size.Z&lt;=anchor.size.Z+.1 then return true end
 end
 return false
end
local function undeclaredInvisible(part)
 -- TB_PhysicsPart: the toolbox&apos;s own invisible wheels, frames and boat decks (tools.vehicle/tools.boat) and ball spheres (tools.ball). A tool the
 -- toolbox made (tools.giveTool, marked GameplayTool) is its own too: its invisible Handle was reported once equipped
 -- (10-28 final q1: &quot;猎剑.Handle&quot; four times).
 local tool=part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass(&quot;Tool&quot;)
 if not part:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) or baseline[part] or normalAvatarPart(part) or declaredTrigger(part) or part:GetAttribute(&quot;TB_PhysicsPart&quot;) or tool and tool:GetAttribute(&quot;GameplayTool&quot;) then return end
 return part.Transparency&gt;=.5 and (part.CanCollide or part.CanTouch)
end
-- A program may hide a part a moment before turning its collision off: two lines (Transparency=1, then CanCollide=false)
-- or a fade. Look again shortly and report only a part still invisible and solid (10-29 q1: opening &quot;ThornGate&quot;).
local suspected={}
local function inspect(part)
 if suspected[part] or not undeclaredInvisible(part) then return end
 suspected[part]=true
 task.delay(1.5,function()
  suspected[part]=nil
  if part.Parent and undeclaredInvisible(part) then error(&quot;Undeclared invisible collision/touch part:&quot;..part:GetFullName()) end
 end)
end
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
 if not part:IsA(&quot;BasePart&quot;) then return end
 task.delay(.2,function() if part.Parent then inspect(part) end end)
 for _,property in {&quot;Transparency&quot;,&quot;CanCollide&quot;,&quot;CanTouch&quot;,&quot;Size&quot;,&quot;CFrame&quot;} do part:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(function() inspect(part) end) end
end)

if type(start)~=&quot;function&quot; then error(&quot;Server program must return a function&quot;) end
start(tools)
workspace:SetAttribute(&quot;AuthoredGameplayReadyAt&quot;,workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
workspace:SetAttribute(&quot;AuthoredGameplayReady&quot;,true)
